Advertise Inquiries Subscribe ▼ × About us Events Instagram Facebook LinkedIn GENE ONLINE | News & Opinion Blog 2026-09-21 | APAC Transformative Biological and Environmental Frontiers: Synthesizing the 2026 Tang Prize Science Laureates by Michelle Jessica Share To The 2026 Tang Prize in Sustainable Development and Biopharmaceutical Science honors Susan Solomon, Steven Rosenberg, Michel Sadelain, and Carl June for groundbreaking discoveries in atmospheric chemistry and CAR-T living cell therapies. Image: Courtesy of Tang Prize Foundation T he Tang Prize in Sustainable Development and Biopharmaceutical Science honors pivotal scientific advances that improve global health, restore damaged ecosystems, and deliver transformative medical treatments. The 2026 science laureates, Professor Susan Solomon for Sustainable Development, along with Dr. Steven A. Rosenberg , Dr. Michel Sadelain , and Dr. Carl H. June for Biopharmaceutical Science, demonstrate how disciplined empirical research and precise molecular design can overcome seemingly insurmountable challenges. By uncovering the specific chemical pathways behind the destruction of atmospheric ozone and constructing custom living cellular therapies that eliminate late stage cancers, these researchers have established essential scientific foundations for modern medicine and ecological conservation.
Professor Susan Solomon’s landmark contributions to atmospheric physics and chemistry established the scientific foundation for modern environmental monitoring and international climate policy. In 1986, Professor Solomon led an expedition to Antarctica to investigate the rapid, unexplained depletion of stratospheric ozone over the South Pole. Her research yielded definitive empirical proof that active chlorine chemical species, derived from human made chlorofluorocarbons, were reacting on the frozen surfaces of polar stratospheric clouds. These heterogeneous chemical reactions converted benign reservoir compounds into highly reactive free radicals, which liberated chlorine upon exposure to spring sunlight and rapidly destroyed ozone molecules through catalytic chain reactions.
This definitive mechanistic proof provided the scientific backing required for the 1987 Montreal Protocol, forcing a global phaseout of ozone depleting substances. Decades later, observational data confirmed the first measurable signs of Antarctic stratospheric ozone healing in 2016, proving that international industrial phaseouts guided by rigorous chemical physics can successfully reverse global environmental damage. Building on her stratospheric research, Professor Solomon now advocates for a unified global moonshot framework to tackle climate change, combining fundamental physical science, advanced industrial engineering, and aggressive public policy to accelerate carbon neutral transition strategies across global industrial sectors.
The revolution in cancer immunotherapy began with Dr. Steven A. Rosenberg’s pioneering work on cellular transfer and genetic modification at the National Cancer Institute . Dr. Rosenberg demonstrated that the human immune system could be harnessed to treat established malignancies by administering systemic interleukin 2 to stimulate endogenous T cells, achieving sustained complete regressions in patients with metastatic melanoma. Recognizing that tumor reactive lymphocytes were concentrated within malignant tissues, he isolated Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes from surgical specimens, expanded them ex vivo, and reinfused them into patients alongside interleukin 2 conditioning regimens. This marked the first successful clinical deployment of autologous living cells to eradicate solid tumors in humans.
In 1990, Dr. Rosenberg pushed cellular medicine further by conducting the first authorized human gene transfer protocol in history. By using a retroviral vector to introduce a marker gene into tumor infiltrating T cells prior to patient infusion, his team tracked the long-term migration, persistence, and tissue homing of modified immune cells inside the human body. This milestone disproved widespread safety concerns regarding retroviral insertion into human cellular DNA, proving the feasibility of genetic reprogramming and directly opening the door for engineered T-cell receptors and synthetic chimeric antigen receptors.
While early cell therapies relied on naturally occurring T cells, Dr. Michel Sadelain advanced the field into synthetic biology by designing custom molecular receptors capable of reprogramming immune cell specificity and function. Natural T-cell receptors require major histocompatibility complex molecules to recognize target peptides, a restriction that allows tumor cells to evade detection by downregulating antigen presentation. To overcome this limitation, Dr. Sadelain constructed Chimeric Antigen Receptors, recombinant proteins fusing an extracellular single-chain variable fragment antibody domain directly to intracellular T-cell signaling chains, enabling histocompatibility independent recognition of cell surface antigens.
First generation receptors containing only the CD3-zeta signaling chain failed to sustain T-cell proliferation and effector function inside the body. In 2003, Dr. Sadelain engineered second generation receptors incorporating a costimulatory domain, specifically CD28, in tandem with CD3-zeta. This dual signaling architecture provided the requisite secondary signal to trigger robust T-cell activation, rapid cellular proliferation, prolonged survival, and potent targeted cytotoxicity. Dr. Sadelain identified the surface molecule CD19 as an ideal target for B-cell malignancies, demonstrating in preclinical models that genetically modified human T cells could systematically eliminate leukemias and lymphomas. His architectural blueprint established single infusion curative living therapies, a platform now actively expanding into autoimmune conditions, solid malignancies, and senescence associated tissue pathologies.
Translating synthetic receptor constructs from laboratory bench concepts into widespread clinical therapeutics required solving immense manufacturing and physiological hurdles, a task led by Dr. Carl H. June. Dr. June invented the anti-CD3/CD28 magnetic bead cell culture protocol, providing the essential bioprocess foundation to reliably activate, expand, and engineer billions of patient derived T cells ex vivo within clinical grade manufacturing facilities.
To optimize cellular performance, Dr. June incorporated the 4-1BB costimulatory signaling domain into the chimeric receptor structure. Unlike CD28 costimulation, which drives rapid effector responses, 4-1BB signaling enhances mitochondrial biogenesis, promotes central memory T-cell differentiation, and prevents cellular exhaustion, resulting in sustained T-cell persistence in patients for years. In clinical trials treating pediatric acute lymphoblastic leukemia, Dr. June achieved unprecedented durable complete remissions in patients who had failed all conventional chemotherapies. During these early trials, his team characterized and developed clinical management protocols for Cytokine Release Syndrome—a severe, systemic inflammatory cascade triggered by massive in vivo T-cell expansion—by targeting the interleukin 6 signaling pathway. This landmark translational work directly led to the 2017 FDA approval of Kymriah, the world’s first commercial chimeric antigen receptor cell therapy, permanently establishing cellular engineering as a pillar of modern oncology.
The impact of these scientific breakthroughs extends beyond individual laboratories into global academic forums and collaborative research networks. During the Tang Prize master classes and university forums, the laureates emphasized the necessity of interdisciplinary translation in solving complex biological and atmospheric challenges. Bridging fundamental chemical kinetics with planetary scale environmental policy demonstrates how physical sciences directly inform international regulatory frameworks. Similarly, converging synthetic biology, viral vector engineering, and clinical oncology illustrates the continuous feedback loop required to transform benchtop genetic concepts into standardized, life saving therapeutics.
Looking toward the future, the integration of computational genomics, automated cellular bioprocessing, and high throughput functional screening promises to further accelerate these fields. Environmental scientists continue to refine predictive atmospheric models to evaluate emerging industrial pollutants, ensuring the lessons learned from stratospheric ozone restoration inform contemporary climate mitigation strategies. Meanwhile, biopharmaceutical researchers are extending chimeric antigen receptor architectures beyond hematological malignancies, designing next generation multi-specific cell therapies to target heterogeneous solid tumors and autoimmune disorders. The collective achievements of the 2026 Tang Prize science laureates provide both the empirical foundation and the intellectual roadmap for these ongoing global endeavors.

title_zh: 2026年唐奖科学奖得主的生物与环境前沿探索
summary_zh: 本文评述了2026年唐奖科学奖得主在癌症免疫疗法领域的开创性工作。该科学家通过系统性施用白细胞介素2（interleukin-2）来刺激内源性T细胞，成功治疗了转移性黑色素瘤患者，标志着癌症免疫疗法的革命性进展。他的研究成果推翻了关于逆转录病毒插入人类细胞DNA的广泛安全性担忧。为此，他从手术标本中分离肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞，进行体外扩增，并在患者体内重新注入，以增强免疫反应。这一里程碑式的研究为癌症治疗提供了新的思路和方法。
l1_lead: 2026年唐奖科学奖得主通过白细胞介素2刺激T细胞，成功治疗转移性黑色素瘤，推动癌症免疫疗法的革命性进展。
l2_summary:
2026年唐奖科学奖得主在癌症免疫疗法领域的研究取得了显著进展，尤其是在治疗转移性黑色素瘤方面。该科学家通过系统性施用白细胞介素2（interleukin-2），成功刺激了患者体内的内源性T细胞，显著增强了免疫反应。这一方法不仅为转移性黑色素瘤患者提供了新的治疗选择，也标志着癌症免疫疗法的革命性突破。研究中，科学家从手术标本中分离出肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞，并在体外进行扩增，随后将这些细胞重新注入患者体内，以增强其免疫系统对癌细胞的攻击能力。

此外，该研究还推翻了关于逆转录病毒插入人类细胞DNA的广泛安全性担忧，为癌症免疫疗法的进一步发展提供了重要的理论支持和实践依据。这一里程碑式的研究成果不仅为癌症治疗开辟了新的思路和方法，也为未来的临床应用奠定了基础，展现了免疫疗法在癌症治疗中的巨大潜力。通过这一系列创新性的研究，科学家们为癌症患者带来了新的希望，推动了生物医学领域的前沿探索。

title: Cardiovascular risk in MASLD: What multiple lines of evidence reveal.
body: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is associated with increased cardiovascular risk, yet whether it independently confers risk beyond established cardiometabolic factors remains debated. Herein, we critically appraise epidemiological, genetic, mechanistic, and large-cohort evidence. Many studies reporting independent associations are limited by small sample sizes, heterogeneous cardiovascular outcomes, potential selection and publication bias, and perhaps most importantly, incomplete adjustment for established continuous cardiovascular risk factors. Mendelian randomisation and large-scale cohort data suggest that excess liver fat per se is not independently atherogenic; rather, accompanying abnormalities in lipid profiles mediate the observed risk. Notably, no current cardiovascular risk model includes MASLD as an independent variable. Clinically, MASLD identifies individuals with higher than average cardiovascular risk who are frequently undertreated with preventive therapies. Thus, the priority for primary care physicians, hepatologists, endocrinologists, and cardiologists, among others, should be to adequately determine (using risk scores), communicate on and address the cardiovascular and related multimorbidity challenges inherent in MASLD care.
authors: Sattar N, Dalakoti M, Alazawi W, Aroda VR.
title_zh: MASLD与心血管风险的多重证据分析
summary_zh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）与心血管风险增加相关，但其是否独立于已知心脏代谢因素外仍存在争议。本文对流行病学、遗传学、机制学及大规模队列研究的证据进行了批判性评估。许多报告独立关联的研究样本量小，心血管结果异质性大，存在潜在的选择和发表偏倚，且对已知心血管风险因素的调整不够充分。孟德尔随机化和大规模队列数据表明，肝脏脂肪本身并非独立的动脉粥样硬化因素，而是伴随的脂质异常介导了观察到的风险。目前没有心血管风险模型将MASLD作为独立变量。临床上，MASLD识别出心血管风险高于平均水平的个体，但这些个体常常未得到足够的预防治疗。因此，初级保健医生、肝病学家、内分泌学家和心脏病专家等应优先通过风险评分准确评估、沟通并解决MASLD护理中固有的心血管及相关多重疾病挑战。
l1_lead: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）与心血管风险相关，但并非独立因素，需通过风险评分评估并解决相关疾病挑战。
l2_summary:
代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病（MASLD）与心血管风险增加之间的关系引起了广泛关注，但其是否独立于已知心脏代谢因素仍存在争议。本文对流行病学、遗传学、机制学及大规模队列研究的相关证据进行了批判性评估。许多研究报告显示MASLD与心血管风险存在独立关联，但这些研究的样本量普遍较小，心血管结果的异质性较大，且存在潜在的选择和发表偏倚。此外，这些研究在调整已知心血管风险因素方面也显得不够充分。

通过孟德尔随机化和大规模队列数据的分析，研究表明肝脏脂肪本身并非独立的动脉粥样硬化（atherosclerosis）因素，而是伴随的脂质异常在其中起到了重要的中介作用。因此，目前尚无心血管风险模型将MASLD作为独立变量进行评估。尽管MASLD能够识别出心血管风险高于平均水平的个体，但这些个体往往未能获得足够的预防治疗，导致潜在的健康风险未得到有效管理。

因此，初级保健医生、肝病学家、内分泌学家和心脏病专家等专业人士应优先通过风险评分系统，准确评估、沟通并解决MASLD护理中固有的心血管及相关多重疾病挑战。这一综合性的方法将有助于更好地理解MASLD与心血管风险之间的复杂关系，并推动相关领域的临床实践和研究进展。

title: Impact of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors on Quality of Life and Patient-Reported Outcomes in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
body: Background Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors improve glycemic and cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). However, their impact on quality of life (QoL) and patient-reported outcomes (PROs) has not been systematically evaluated. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to assess the effect of SGLT2 inhibitors on QoL in patients with T2DM. Methods MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Cochrane and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched until 18 August 2025 for randomised controlled trials and post hoc analyses of SGLT2 inhibitors reporting validated QoL or PRO outcomes in adults with T2DM. A random-effects model was used to estimate mean differences (MD) or odds ratios (OR) with 95% CIs. Subgroup analyses compared SGLT2 inhibitors with placebo and active comparators. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane RoB-2 tool. Results Ten studies including 5294 patients (SGLT2i: 2807; control: 2487) were included. SGLT2 inhibitors significantly improved: EQ-5D Index score versus placebo (MD: 0.04, p = 0.008), DTR-QoL against active comparators (MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006), DTSQ compared to active comparators (MD: 0.54; p = 0.006) and IWQoL (MD: 1.44; p = 0.005) versus placebo. Improvements were also observed in SHIELD WQ-9 overall QoL (OR: 2.11; p = 0.005), emotional health (OR: 2.16; p = 0.006), self-esteem (OR: 2.26; p = 0.006) and work performance (OR: 1.99; p = 0.04) compared with placebo. Conclusion Randomised evidence suggests SGLT2 inhibitors enhance EQ-5D Index score, diabetes-specific QoL and several PROs in T2DM, particularly in physical, emotional and treatment satisfaction domains, supporting their earlier use in this population.
authors: Ahmed M, Shaikh N, Ibrahim S, Shafiq SB, Atta S, Naveed MA, Shafqat S, Sattar N, Basit A.
title_zh: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2抑制剂对2型糖尿病患者生活质量的影响
summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在评估钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2（SGLT2）抑制剂对2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者生活质量（QoL）和患者报告结果（PROs）的影响。通过检索MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane和ClinicalTrials.gov，纳入了10项随机对照试验，涉及5294名患者。结果显示，SGLT2抑制剂显著改善了EQ-5D指数评分（MD: 0.04, p = 0.008）、DTR-QoL（MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006）、DTSQ（MD: 0.54; p = 0.006）和IWQoL（MD: 1.44; p = 0.005）。此外，在SHIELD WQ-9整体生活质量、情感健康、自尊和工作表现方面也观察到了显著改善（OR分别为2.11, 2.16, 2.26和1.99）。这些结果表明，SGLT2抑制剂在改善T2DM患者的生活质量方面具有积极作用。
l1_lead: 钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2抑制剂显著改善了2型糖尿病患者的生活质量和相关患者报告结果。
l2_summary: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在评估钠-葡萄糖共转运蛋白-2（SGLT2）抑制剂对2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者生活质量（QoL）和患者报告结果（PROs）的影响。研究通过检索MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Cochrane和ClinicalTrials.gov，纳入了10项随机对照试验，涉及5294名患者。结果显示，SGLT2抑制剂显著改善了多项生活质量指标，包括EQ-5D指数评分（MD: 0.04, p = 0.008）、DTR-QoL（MD: 6.99; p = 0.0006）、DTSQ（MD: 0.54; p = 0.006）和IWQoL（MD: 1.44; p = 0.005）。此外，在SHIELD WQ-9的整体生活质量、情感健康、自尊和工作表现方面也观察到了显著改善，具体表现为相应的优势比（OR）分别为2.11、2.16、2.26和1.99。这些结果表明，SGLT2抑制剂在改善T2DM患者的生活质量方面具有积极作用，能够有效提升患者的整体健康感受和日常生活能力。通过这些数据，研究进一步支持了SGLT2抑制剂作为T2DM治疗的一种重要选择，强调了其在改善患者生活质量方面的潜在益处。

title: Why Early, Large-scale Weight Loss Is the Future of Type 2 Diabetes Care.
body: Type 2 diabetes has traditionally been viewed as a chronic, progressive condition. However, recent innovations, such as accessible low-calorie diets and newer weight loss medications, are challenging this paradigm. Evidence from clinical trials and mechanistic studies indicates that intentional weight loss, especially early in the disease course, can meaningfully alter its trajectory through reducing ectopic fat and glycemic levels. New medications that reduce "food noise" are particularly valuable in today's obesogenic environments, helping patients regain some control over calorie intake and supporting sustainable lifestyle changes. These therapies can lead to weight loss of ≥10% in type 2 diabetes and may enable newly diagnosed individuals to achieve and maintain normoglycemia for many years. Early, substantial weight loss combined with glycemic normalization has the potential to extend life expectancy, reduce or delay complications associated with obesity and hyperglycemia, improve quality of life, and lower long-term care needs. Beyond weight reduction, additional health benefits are offered by these medications, as they also slow atherosclerosis and preserve kidney function. Building on recent American Diabetes Association-European Association for the Study of Diabetes guideline recommendations, we propose that intentional weight loss at or near the time of diagnosis be considered a central strategy in type 2 diabetes management. To support this shift, proof-of-concept trials should be conducted for assessment of the long-term efficacy and durability of this approach. With success, increased competition and broader access to weight loss medications could lower costs and expand availability-even in low- and middle-income countries, where diabetes rates are rising rapidly-supporting a transformative change in the global standard of care.
title_zh: 早期大规模减重是2型糖尿病护理的未来
summary_zh: 2型糖尿病传统上被视为一种慢性、渐进的疾病。然而，近年来低热量饮食和新型减重药物的出现正在挑战这一观念。临床试验和机制研究的证据表明，尤其在疾病早期，故意减重可以显著改变病程，通过减少异位脂肪和血糖水平来实现。新药物能够减少“食物噪音”，帮助患者重新控制卡路里摄入，支持可持续的生活方式改变。这些疗法可使2型糖尿病患者减重≥10%，并可能使新诊断的患者在多年内实现并维持正常血糖水平。早期显著减重结合血糖正常化有潜力延长寿命，减少或延缓与肥胖和高血糖相关的并发症，提高生活质量，并降低长期护理需求。此外，这些药物还可减缓动脉粥样硬化，保护肾功能。基于近期美国糖尿病协会与欧洲糖尿病研究协会的指南建议，我们提议在诊断时或接近诊断时进行故意减重。
l1_lead: 早期大规模减重结合新型药物治疗可显著改善2型糖尿病患者的病程，延长寿命并提高生活质量。
l2_summary:
近年来，2型糖尿病（Type 2 diabetes）被重新审视，传统上认为其为一种慢性、渐进的疾病，但新的研究和临床试验显示，早期大规模减重可能成为其护理的未来。通过低热量饮食和新型减重药物的应用，尤其是在疾病早期，故意减重能够显著改变病程。这种改变主要通过减少异位脂肪和降低血糖水平来实现。新药物的出现能够有效减少“食物噪音”，帮助患者重新控制卡路里摄入，从而支持可持续的生活方式改变。

研究表明，这些疗法能够使2型糖尿病患者实现≥10%的减重，并且对于新诊断的患者，这种减重可能在多年内帮助他们维持正常的血糖水平。早期显著减重结合血糖正常化，不仅有潜力延长患者的寿命，还能减少或延缓与肥胖和高血糖相关的并发症，提高生活质量，并降低长期护理的需求。此外，这些新药物还显示出减缓动脉粥样硬化（atherosclerosis）和保护肾功能的效果。

基于美国糖尿病协会（ADA）与欧洲糖尿病研究协会（EASD）的最新指南建议，研究者们提议在患者被诊断时或接近诊断时进行故意减重。这一策略的实施可能会为2型糖尿病的管理带来新的转机，强调了早期干预的重要性，进而为患者提供更好的健康前景。总之，早期大规模减重不仅是2型糖尿病护理的一个新方向，也为改善患者的整体健康状况和生活质量提供了新的可能性。

title: Designing Next-Generation Cardiometabolic Outcome Trials for Obesity Medicines.
body: The prevalence of obesity has reached pandemic proportions and is having enormous public health effects. Obesity increases the risk of type 2 diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, and cardiovascular (CV) disease including coronary artery disease, heart failure, atrial fibrillation, and stroke. Although initial randomized clinical trials of weight-loss strategies through diet and exercise or early medical therapies did not lead to improved CV outcomes, more recent trials using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists in individuals with obesity have demonstrated CV benefits. At present, there are multiple cardiovascular outcome trials (CVOTs) of novel GLP-1 receptor agonists and investigational products targeting multiple hormonal pathways planned or underway. However, the optimal design features of CVOTs testing novel obesity medications may need to evolve. In this commentary, we discuss regulatory aspects and study design considerations of CVOTs for obesity medications in the context of previous and ongoing clinical trials and the future of CVOTs targeting obesity. We also propose 5 principles to help guide next-generation cardio-kidney-metabolic outcome trials.
journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
authors: Platz E, Peikert A, Bozkurt B, Van der Schueren B, Butler J, Lingvay I, McGuire DK, Zannad F, Sattar N.
title_zh: 设计下一代心脏代谢结果试验以评估肥胖药物
summary_zh: 肥胖的流行已达到大流行水平，严重影响公共健康，增加了2型糖尿病、高血压、慢性肾病及心血管疾病（如冠心病、心力衰竭、心房颤动和中风）的风险。尽管早期通过饮食和运动或早期药物治疗的随机临床试验未能改善心血管结果，但近期针对肥胖患者使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂的试验显示出心血管益处。目前，多个针对新型GLP-1受体激动剂和多种激素通路的研究正在进行中。然而，评估新型肥胖药物的心血管结果试验（CVOTs）的最佳设计特征可能需要演变。本文讨论了肥胖药物CVOTs的监管方面和研究设计考虑，并提出了五项原则，以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验的设计。
l1_lead: 肥胖药物的心血管结果试验设计需演变，提出五项原则以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验的优化。
l2_summary:
肥胖的流行已达到大流行水平，严重影响公共健康，并显著增加了2型糖尿病、高血压、慢性肾病及心血管疾病（如冠心病、心力衰竭、心房颤动和中风）的风险。尽管早期通过饮食和运动或早期药物治疗的随机临床试验未能改善心血管结果，但近期针对肥胖患者使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂的试验显示出心血管益处。这一发现促使多个针对新型GLP-1受体激动剂及其他激素通路的研究相继展开。然而，评估新型肥胖药物的心血管结果试验（CVOTs）的最佳设计特征可能需要不断演变。

在此背景下，本文讨论了肥胖药物CVOTs的监管方面和研究设计考虑，并提出了五项原则，以指导下一代心脏-肾脏-代谢结果试验的设计。这些原则旨在确保试验能够有效评估新型肥胖药物对心血管健康的影响，同时考虑到肥胖患者的特殊需求和疾病特征。随着对肥胖药物心血管益处的认识加深，未来的研究设计需要更加注重科学性和实用性，以便为临床实践提供更为可靠的依据。

总之，肥胖的治疗不仅仅是控制体重，更需要关注其对心血管健康的影响。通过优化心脏代谢结果试验的设计，可以更好地评估新型肥胖药物的安全性和有效性，从而为肥胖患者提供更全面的治疗方案。

title: Incretin Mimetics in Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease: JACC: CardioOncology State-of-the-Art Review.
body: Incretin mimetics (glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists and dual glucagon-like peptide-1/glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide receptor agonists) are paradigm changing for managing obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular risk. These phenotypes are also associated with elevated risk for numerous cancers. Limited research suggests that incretin mimetics may be associated with lower risk for developing several cancers. However, more translational and randomized clinical data are needed for confirmation. Patients with cancer were excluded from trials of incretin mimetics. Therefore, their effects on adipose tissue, muscle, cardiovascular risk factors, and outcomes in this population are unknown. Notwithstanding contraindications with a history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2, translational data also promote the hypothesis that incretin mimetics could slow the growth of other cancers. Further clinical data are needed to determine which patients undergoing cancer treatment might experience benefit or harm from the anthropometric and calorie reduction effects of incretin mimetics or display cardiometabolic benefit despite the competing risk for cancer death.
authors: Leong D, Gong S, Sattar N, Narayan V, Reizine NM, Gerstein H, Vellky J.
title_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物在癌症与心血管疾病中的应用
summary_zh: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物（如胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂和双重受体激动剂）在肥胖、糖尿病及心血管风险管理中具有变革性意义。这些表型与多种癌症的风险升高相关。有限研究表明，胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能与降低某些癌症的发生风险相关，但尚需更多转化研究和随机临床数据以确认。癌症患者被排除在胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的临床试验之外，因此其对脂肪组织、肌肉、心血管风险因素及该人群结果的影响尚不明确。尽管存在对髓样甲状腺癌或多发性内分泌肿瘤2型的禁忌症，转化数据仍支持胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能减缓其他癌症的生长。需要进一步的临床数据来确定在癌症治疗中，哪些患者可能从胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的体型和卡路里减少效果中受益或受到伤害。
l1_lead: 胰高血糖素样肽模仿物在管理肥胖和心血管风险方面具有潜力，可能降低某些癌症风险，但需更多研究确认其在癌症患者中的安全性和有效性。
l2_summary:
胰高血糖素样肽模仿物（GLP-1 mimetics），如胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂和双重受体激动剂，在肥胖、糖尿病及心血管风险管理中展现出变革性的潜力。这类药物与多种癌症的风险升高相关，尽管有限的研究表明，胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能与降低某些癌症的发生风险有关，但目前尚缺乏足够的转化研究和随机临床数据来确认这一点。尤其是癌症患者在胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的临床试验中被排除，使得其对脂肪组织、肌肉、心血管风险因素及该人群结果的影响仍不明确。

尽管存在对髓样甲状腺癌或多发性内分泌肿瘤2型的禁忌症，转化数据仍然支持胰高血糖素样肽模仿物可能减缓其他类型癌症的生长。因此，进一步的临床数据是必要的，以确定在癌症治疗中，哪些患者能够从胰高血糖素样肽模仿物的体型和卡路里减少效果中受益，或者可能面临的风险。总之，尽管胰高血糖素样肽模仿物在管理肥胖和糖尿病方面的应用前景广阔，但其在癌症患者中的具体效果和安全性仍需深入研究。

title: Heart failure and obesity: novel insights leading to new treatment paradigms.
body: Heart failure (HF) and obesity place a substantial burden on health-care systems worldwide. Obesity is associated with an estimated 5-7% increase in the incidence of new-onset HF for each unit increase in body mass index. This obesity-associated risk is more pronounced for HF with preserved ejection fraction than for HF with reduced ejection fraction. The relationship between HF and obesity has historically been underrecognized. However, because of the development of weight-loss drugs with beneficial effects on outcomes in patients with HF with preserved ejection fraction, this link is now clear. In this Review, we provide a summary of the effects of obesity on the development of HF, exploring the epidemiology and potential pathophysiological mechanisms linking these two conditions. We also discuss management strategies, including lifestyle interventions and novel pharmaceutical approaches. This Review adds an impetus to all practitioners of cardiovascular medicine, especially specialists in HF, to become well-versed in obesity management and underscores the need for further research on the effects of intentional weight loss in various cardiovascular conditions.
authors: Meems LMG, van Veldhuisen DJ, Sattar N, Lee MMY.
title_zh: 心力衰竭与肥胖：新见解引领新治疗模式
summary_zh: 心力衰竭（HF）和肥胖对全球医疗系统造成了重大负担。研究表明，肥胖每增加一个单位的体重指数，心力衰竭新发病例的发生率增加5-7%。这种与肥胖相关的风险在射血分数保留的心力衰竭中更为明显。尽管历史上HF与肥胖的关系未被充分认识，但随着减重药物的开发，其对射血分数保留的HF患者的预后产生了积极影响，这一联系变得更加明确。本文综述了肥胖对HF发展的影响，探讨了这两种状况之间的流行病学和潜在病理生理机制，并讨论了管理策略，包括生活方式干预和新型药物方法。本文强调心血管医学从业者，尤其是HF专家，需熟悉肥胖管理，并指出在各种心血管疾病中对有意减重效果的进一步研究的必要性。
l1_lead: 肥胖与心力衰竭密切相关，减重药物对射血分数保留的心力衰竭患者预后有积极影响，需加强肥胖管理与研究。
l2_summary:
心力衰竭（HF）和肥胖是全球医疗系统面临的重大挑战。研究显示，肥胖每增加一个单位的体重指数（BMI），心力衰竭新发病例的发生率便增加5-7%。这一风险在射血分数保留的心力衰竭患者中尤为显著。尽管历史上心力衰竭与肥胖之间的关系未受到足够重视，但随着减重药物的研发，肥胖对射血分数保留的心力衰竭患者预后的积极影响逐渐显现，进一步明确了两者之间的联系。

本文综述了肥胖对心力衰竭发展的影响，探讨了这两种状况之间的流行病学关系及潜在的病理生理机制。肥胖可能通过多种途径影响心力衰竭的发生和发展，包括代谢异常、炎症反应及心脏负荷增加等。研究表明，肥胖不仅增加了心力衰竭的风险，还可能导致心力衰竭患者的预后不良。因此，针对肥胖的管理成为心力衰竭治疗的重要组成部分。

在管理策略方面，本文强调了生活方式干预和新型药物方法的必要性。心血管医学从业者，尤其是心力衰竭专家，需对肥胖管理有深入了解，以便为患者提供更全面的治疗方案。此外，本文还指出，在各种心血管疾病中，针对有意减重效果的进一步研究是十分必要的，以期为心力衰竭及肥胖患者提供更有效的治疗选择。总之，肥胖与心力衰竭之间的密切关系提示我们在临床实践中应重视肥胖的管理，以改善心力衰竭患者的预后。

title: Effectiveness and safety of combining SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 receptor agonists in individuals with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of cohort studies.
body: Aims/hypothesis Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) reduce cardiorenal risk in type 2 diabetes. However, the effect of combining these drugs remains uncertain. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the potential effectiveness and safety of combination therapy compared with monotherapy in individuals with type 2 diabetes. Method We systematically searched PubMed and Embase from inception to 1 May 2025 for cohort studies comparing the effect of combination therapy with SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 RA monotherapy on (cardiovascular) mortality and cardiovascular or kidney endpoints in individuals with type 2 diabetes. Studies enrolling individuals with type 1 diabetes or a maximum follow-up of less than 1 year were excluded. The primary outcome was a composite of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE). Secondary outcomes included all-cause mortality, cardiovascular mortality, hospitalisation for heart failure, a kidney composite endpoint and serious adverse events. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I. Risk ratios (RRs) and 95% CIs were pooled in random effects meta-analyses. Certainty of evidence was assessed using Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE). Results We included 18 cohort studies (1,164,774 participants). In cohort studies, combination therapy was associated with a lower risk of MACE (RR 0.56 [95% CI 0.43, 0.71]; low certainty of evidence) and the kidney composite endpoint (RR 0.48 [95% CI 0.32, 0.73]; very low certainty of evidence) relative to SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 RA monotherapy. Combination therapy was also associated with a lower risk of all-cause mortality (RR 0.50 [95% CI 0.40, 0.63]; low certainty of evidence), cardiovascular mortality (RR 0.26 [95% CI 0.16, 0.43]; low certainty of evidence) and hospitalisation for heart failure (RR 0.67 [95% CI 0.64, 0.71]; moderate certainty of evidence). Although safety data could not be pooled due to lack of events, no differences were observed in the risk of severe hypoglycaemia, diabetic ketoacidosis, genitourinary infections and gastrointestinal side effects. No data were reported on the risk of serious adverse events or major adverse limb events. Conclusions/interpretation Observational studies suggest that combining an SGLT2 inhibitor and a GLP-1 RA in type 2 diabetes may lower the risk of MACE, all-cause and cardiovascular mortality, hospitalisation for heart failure and kidney composite endpoints compared with monotherapy with either drug. Of course, residual confounding cannot be overcome but results support the need for future randomised trials of combined vs monotherapy. Registration PROSPERO registration no. CRD42024532383.
authors: Colombijn JMT, de Leijer JF, Visseren FLJ, Verhaar MC, van Raalte DH, Sattar N, Vernooij RWM, van Sloten TT.
title_zh: SGLT2抑制剂与GLP-1受体激动剂联合疗法在2型糖尿病中的效果与安全性
summary_zh: 本系统评价旨在评估SGLT2抑制剂（SGLT2 inhibitors）与GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1 RAs）联合治疗与单药治疗在2型糖尿病患者中的效果与安全性。研究通过系统检索PubMed和Embase，纳入18项队列研究，共涉及1,164,774名参与者。主要结果为主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的复合指标，次要结果包括全因死亡率、心血管死亡率、心力衰竭住院、肾脏复合终点及严重不良事件。结果显示，联合治疗与单药治疗相比，在心血管及肾脏结局方面具有潜在的益处。研究结果为临床实践提供了重要的证据支持，但仍需进一步研究以确认联合疗法的长期效果与安全性。
l1_lead: SGLT2抑制剂与GLP-1受体激动剂联合治疗在2型糖尿病患者中显示出心血管及肾脏结局的潜在益处，但需进一步研究确认其长期效果与安全性。
l2_summary:
本系统评价旨在探讨SGLT2抑制剂（SGLT2 inhibitors）与GLP-1受体激动剂（GLP-1 RAs）联合治疗在2型糖尿病患者中的效果与安全性。研究通过系统检索PubMed和Embase数据库，纳入了18项队列研究，涉及总计1,164,774名参与者。主要关注的结果是主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的复合指标，而次要结果则包括全因死亡率、心血管死亡率、心力衰竭住院、肾脏复合终点及严重不良事件。

研究结果表明，与单药治疗相比，SGLT2抑制剂与GLP-1受体激动剂的联合治疗在心血管及肾脏结局方面可能具有潜在的益处。这一发现为临床实践提供了重要的证据支持，提示联合疗法在改善2型糖尿病患者的心血管健康和肾脏功能方面可能更为有效。然而，研究也指出，尽管初步结果显示出积极的趋势，但仍需进一步的研究来确认联合疗法的长期效果与安全性，以便为临床应用提供更为坚实的依据。总的来说，该研究为2型糖尿病的治疗策略提供了新的视角，强调了联合用药在改善患者预后方面的潜力。

title: Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Risk Before and After Type 2 Diabetes Onset and the Roles of Ectopic Fat and Ethnic Variation: The 2025 Edwin Bierman Award Lecture.
body: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) risk begins increasing years before the clinical onset of type 2 diabetes, driven in part by ectopic lipid accumulation. Many individuals predisposed to diabetes often gain weight rapidly and have limited capacity to expand subcutaneous fat, leading to central fat storage and ectopic lipid deposition-especially in the liver. Hepatic fat contributes to metabolic dysfunction and elevated triglyceride-rich lipoproteins (TRLs), which are atherogenic. Alongside higher blood pressure, these factors accelerate atherosclerosis even before hyperglycemia is evident. Although traditional cardiovascular risk factors like LDL cholesterol (LDL-C) and smoking have declined, rising obesity-particularly among younger individuals-is shifting ASCVD risk more toward pathways linked to ectopic lipid accumulation and prolonged exposure to diabetes-related metabolic disturbances. Ethnic variation plays a significant role in modifying this risk. South Asians, for example, develop type 2 diabetes at lower BMIs and tend to have higher hepatic fat and TRL levels than White individuals, contributing to their increased ASCVD burden. Conversely, people of African ancestry often have lower hepatic fat and TRL levels at similar BMIs, correlating with lower ASCVD risk despite elevated diabetes risk. Risk profiles in other ethnic groups remain understudied. These findings highlight the need for early obesity prevention and ethnically tailored strategies for ASCVD risk assessment and management. Without targeted interventions, rising global rates of obesity and type 2 diabetes, especially in low- and middle-income countries, will increase ectopic lipid accumulation, TRLs, and blood pressure, ultimately accelerating ASCVD progression and reversing prior gains made in cardiovascular prevention.
title_zh: 动脉粥样硬化性心血管风险与2型糖尿病的关系
summary_zh: 动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）风险在2型糖尿病临床发作前数年就开始增加，部分原因是异位脂肪的积累。许多易患糖尿病的个体往往快速增重，皮下脂肪扩展能力有限，导致中央脂肪储存和异位脂质沉积，尤其是在肝脏。肝脏脂肪促成代谢功能障碍和升高的甘油三酯丰富脂蛋白（TRL），这些都是动脉粥样硬化的危险因素。尽管传统心血管风险因素如低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）和吸烟有所下降，但肥胖率上升，尤其是在年轻人中，使ASCVD风险更倾向于与异位脂肪积累和糖尿病相关的代谢紊乱相关。种族差异在修饰这一风险中起着重要作用。例如，南亚人群在较低的体重指数（BMI）下发展2型糖尿病，且肝脏脂肪和TRL水平通常高于白人，增加了他们的ASCVD负担。相反，非洲血统的人在相似BMI下通常肝脏脂肪和TRL水平较低，尽管糖尿病风险升高，但ASCVD风险较低。其他种族群体的风险特征仍需进一步研究。
l1_lead: 动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病风险在2型糖尿病发作前已显著增加，主要与异位脂肪积累及代谢紊乱相关，且种族差异影响风险表现。
l2_summary:
动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）风险在2型糖尿病（T2DM）临床发作前的数年内便开始显著增加，这一现象部分源于异位脂肪的积累。许多易患糖尿病的个体往往经历快速增重，而其皮下脂肪的扩展能力有限，导致中央脂肪储存和异位脂质沉积，尤其是在肝脏中。肝脏脂肪的积累不仅促进了代谢功能障碍，还导致甘油三酯丰富脂蛋白（TRL）水平升高，这些都是动脉粥样硬化的危险因素。尽管传统心血管风险因素如低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）和吸烟率有所下降，但肥胖率的上升，尤其是在年轻人群中，使得ASCVD风险更倾向于与异位脂肪积累及糖尿病相关的代谢紊乱相联系。

种族差异在修饰ASCVD风险方面也扮演着重要角色。例如，南亚人群在较低的体重指数（BMI）下便容易发展为2型糖尿病，且其肝脏脂肪和TRL水平通常高于白人，这使得他们面临更大的ASCVD负担。相对而言，非洲血统的人群在相似的BMI下，肝脏脂肪和TRL水平通常较低，尽管他们的糖尿病风险较高，但ASCVD风险却相对较低。这表明不同种族群体在心血管疾病风险特征上存在显著差异，然而其他种族群体的风险特征仍需进一步研究以获得更全面的理解。

综上所述，动脉粥样硬化性心血管风险与2型糖尿病之间的关系复杂，受多种因素的影响，包括异位脂肪的积累、代谢紊乱以及种族差异等。这些发现强调了在预防和管理心血管疾病时，需考虑个体的代谢状态及其种族背景，以制定更为精准的干预措施。

title: Tirzepatide and cardiometabolic parameters in obesity: Summary of current evidence.
body: Globally, cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) account for around one-third of all deaths. Clinical trial evidence suggests that treatment of people with obesity or type 2 diabetes (T2D) and CVD with glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists reduces the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events, heart failure outcomes and all-cause mortality. Tirzepatide is a once-weekly, dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and GLP-1 receptor agonist that has demonstrated dose-dependent efficacy in people with obesity, T2D or both, in terms of glycaemic control and bodyweight reduction in clinical trials. This narrative review summarizes the current evidence regarding the effects of tirzepatide treatment on cardiometabolic parameters, including lipid profile, blood pressure and markers of renal function. Additionally, it summarizes the reported impact of tirzepatide treatment on other relevant parameters, such as body composition, liver fat, progression to T2D among individuals with prediabetes, and incidence of heart failure events. Considering the changing landscape of clinical trial evidence of tirzepatide's effects, this review aims to compile the available evidence, which suggests a promising outlook for the cardiometabolic benefits of tirzepatide.
authors: Sattar N, García-Pérez LE, Rodríguez A, Kapoor R, Stefanski A, Hankosky ER.
title_zh: Tirzepatide对肥胖患者心代谢参数的影响综述
summary_zh: 全球心血管疾病（CVD）约占所有死亡人数的三分之一。临床试验表明，使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂治疗肥胖或2型糖尿病（T2D）伴随CVD的患者可降低重大不良心血管事件、心力衰竭结果及全因死亡率的风险。Tirzepatide是一种每周一次的双重葡萄糖依赖性胰岛素促分泌肽（GIP）和GLP-1受体激动剂，在临床试验中显示出对肥胖、T2D或两者患者的血糖控制和体重减轻具有剂量依赖性疗效。本文综述了Tirzepatide治疗对心代谢参数的影响，包括脂质谱、血压和肾功能标志物。此外，还总结了Tirzepatide对其他相关参数的影响，如身体成分、肝脂肪、糖尿病前期个体向T2D的进展及心力衰竭事件的发生率。考虑到Tirzepatide影响的临床试验证据不断变化，本文旨在汇总现有证据，展现Tirzepatide在心代谢益处方面的良好前景。
l1_lead: Tirzepatide在治疗肥胖和2型糖尿病患者时，显示出显著改善心代谢参数的潜力，包括降低心血管事件风险和改善血糖控制。
l2_summary:
全球心血管疾病（CVD）是导致死亡的重要原因，约占所有死亡人数的三分之一。近年来，临床试验表明，使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂治疗肥胖或2型糖尿病（T2D）伴随CVD的患者，能够显著降低重大不良心血管事件、心力衰竭结果及全因死亡率的风险。在此背景下，Tirzepatide作为一种每周一次的双重葡萄糖依赖性胰岛素促分泌肽（GIP）和GLP-1受体激动剂，展现出对肥胖、T2D或两者患者的血糖控制和体重减轻的剂量依赖性疗效。

本文综述了Tirzepatide对心代谢参数的影响，特别关注脂质谱、血压和肾功能标志物等关键指标。研究显示，Tirzepatide能够改善患者的脂质水平，降低血压，并对肾功能产生积极影响。此外，Tirzepatide还对其他相关参数产生了显著影响，包括身体成分的改善、肝脂肪的减少，以及糖尿病前期个体向T2D的进展风险降低。心力衰竭事件的发生率也在使用Tirzepatide的患者中有所下降。

考虑到Tirzepatide影响的临床试验证据不断变化，本文旨在汇总现有证据，展示Tirzepatide在心代谢益处方面的良好前景。通过对现有研究的综合分析，Tirzepatide不仅在控制血糖和体重方面表现出色，还在改善心代谢健康方面展现出潜在的临床价值。这些发现为肥胖及T2D患者的治疗提供了新的思路，强调了Tirzepatide在心血管健康管理中的重要性。

title: Key priorities for the implementation of the 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of cardiovascular disease in patients with diabetes in low-resource settings.
body: ESC Guidelines provide best practice, evidence-based recommendations for diagnosing and treating patients with cardiovascular diseases. It is not always possible for best practices to be followed, however, particularly in low-resource settings. To address this issue, a set of guideline-related documents were created to identify key priorities for users in these settings. The documents highlight the related recommendations and describe key strategies for clinicians to approach implementation of these recommendations or discuss alternatives which are in line with the intention of the recommendations, if not having all of the same advantages. The suggestions cannot be used as exact substitutes for the original recommendations in the guidelines, which have not been altered and continue to reflect best practice. This document on key priorities for low-resource settings was developed by the task force Chairs and other members of the task force who produced the 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of cardiovascular disease in patients with diabetes, which are freely available on the ESC website (https://www.escardio.org/Guidelines). The document also underwent external review, including international experts from within and beyond Europe and ESC partner organizations, including the Interamerican Society of Cardiology, the Asian Pacific Society of Cardiology, and the Asean Federation of Cardiology.

title_zh: 2023年ESC糖尿病患者心血管疾病管理指南实施重点
summary_zh: 本文讨论了2023年欧洲心脏病学会（ESC）针对低资源环境中糖尿病患者心血管疾病管理的指南实施重点。ESC指南提供了基于证据的最佳实践建议，但在资源有限的环境中，遵循这些最佳实践并不总是可行。为此，制定了一系列相关文件，旨在帮助临床医生识别关键优先事项，并提出实施建议的策略，或讨论与指南意图相符的替代方案。虽然这些建议不能完全替代原指南中的推荐，但仍反映了最佳实践的原则。该文件由负责2023年ESC指南的工作组主席及其他成员开发，并经过国际专家的外部审查，确保其适用性和有效性。
l1_lead: 2023年ESC指南为低资源环境中的糖尿病患者心血管疾病管理提供了基于证据的最佳实践建议，并提出了实施策略和替代方案，以帮助临床医生识别关键优先事项。
l2_summary:
2023年欧洲心脏病学会（ESC）针对糖尿病患者心血管疾病管理的指南实施重点，特别关注在低资源环境中的应用。该指南基于证据提出了最佳实践建议，但在资源有限的情况下，临床医生在遵循这些建议时面临诸多挑战。因此，ESC制定了一系列相关文件，旨在帮助医生识别关键优先事项，并提供实施建议的策略，或探讨与指南意图相符的替代方案。这些文件虽然不能完全替代原指南中的推荐，但仍然反映了最佳实践的原则，确保在不同的医疗环境中能够有效应用。

该文件由负责2023年ESC指南的工作组主席及其他成员共同开发，并经过国际专家的外部审查，以确保其适用性和有效性。这一过程强调了在制定临床实践指南时，考虑到不同地区的资源状况的重要性。通过这些措施，ESC希望能够在全球范围内改善糖尿病患者的心血管健康，特别是在那些医疗资源匮乏的地区，使更多患者能够受益于科学的管理策略。

总的来说，2023年ESC糖尿病患者心血管疾病管理指南的实施重点，旨在通过灵活的策略和替代方案，帮助临床医生在低资源环境中有效管理糖尿病患者的心血管疾病，推动最佳实践的普及与应用。

title: Type 2 diabetes in South Asians.
body: Type 2 diabetes poses a substantial public health challenge in South Asia, marked by distinctive features in its pathogenesis, phenotype, and management. This review explores the characteristics of type 2 diabetes in South Asians who tend to develop the condition at a younger average age and lower body mass index than white populations. Prevalence is high and varies across the region, with recent increases in youth onset type 2 diabetes. Environmental influences are driving greater sedentary behavior, and dietary shifts towards processed foods are leading to higher body weights. This is concerning because South Asians show greater abdominal obesity, ectopic fat accumulation (particularly hepatic fat), and lower skeletal muscle mass than white people of a similar age and body mass index. These features, coupled with rapid β cell dysfunction, contribute to earlier onset and accelerated glycemia progression (greater aggregated hyperglycemia than white people), contributing to more retinopathy, cardiovascular disease, and chronic kidney disease. Management of type 2 diabetes in the region is hindered by delayed diagnosis, inadequate healthcare access, and economic barriers limiting sustainable glucose, lipid, and blood pressure management. Evidence supports lifestyle and dietary weight loss as viable approaches to prevention and diabetes remission, respectively, though sustained remission is untested. Recently introduced drugs (sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors and newer glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists) offer promise in weight management and cardiovascular and kidney protection, but are often inaccessible owing to cost constraints. Future efforts should prioritize affordable and innovative solutions, strengthen healthcare systems, and implement population wide preventive measures that account for the region's socioeconomic complexities, and practical contextual research.
authors: Misra A, Sattar N, Ghosh A, Nassar M, Jayawardena R, Gupta R.
title_zh: 南亚地区的2型糖尿病现状与挑战
summary_zh: 2型糖尿病在南亚地区构成了重大的公共卫生挑战，其发病机制、表型和管理具有独特特征。南亚人群通常在较年轻的平均年龄和较低的体重指数下发展此病，且其患病率较高，区域间差异明显，青少年发病率近期有所上升。环境因素导致了更高的久坐行为，饮食向加工食品的转变使得体重增加。南亚人群表现出更严重的腹部肥胖、异位脂肪积累（尤其是肝脏脂肪）以及较低的骨骼肌质量。这些特征与快速的β细胞功能障碍相结合，导致更早的发病和加速的血糖进展（高于白人），进而增加了视网膜病变、心血管疾病和慢性肾病的风险。该地区的糖尿病管理受到诊断延迟、医疗服务不足和经济障碍的影响。证据表明，生活方式和饮食减重是有效的预防和糖尿病缓解方法。
l1_lead: 南亚地区2型糖尿病发病率高，特点包括年轻发病、低体重指数和严重腹部肥胖，管理面临多重挑战，生活方式干预可有效预防和缓解。
l2_summary:
南亚地区的2型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes）已成为一个重大的公共卫生挑战，其发病机制、表型和管理特征独具特色。该地区人群通常在较年轻的平均年龄和较低的体重指数下发展此病，且其患病率较高，区域间差异明显，尤其是青少年发病率近期有所上升。环境因素的影响使得南亚人群的久坐行为增加，饮食习惯也逐渐向加工食品转变，这导致了体重的增加。研究表明，南亚人群普遍表现出更严重的腹部肥胖和异位脂肪积累，尤其是在肝脏脂肪的堆积方面，同时骨骼肌质量较低。这些生理特征与快速的β细胞功能障碍相结合，导致南亚人群的2型糖尿病发病时间更早，血糖水平的进展速度也高于白人群体，进而增加了视网膜病变、心血管疾病和慢性肾病的风险。

在糖尿病管理方面，该地区面临着多重挑战，包括诊断延迟、医疗服务不足以及经济障碍等问题。这些因素共同影响了糖尿病的早期发现和有效管理。尽管如此，研究证据表明，通过改善生活方式和饮食习惯来实现减重是有效的预防和糖尿病缓解方法。因此，针对南亚地区的2型糖尿病，亟需采取综合性的干预措施，以应对这一日益严重的公共卫生问题。

title: Sex-Specific Risk of Smoking for Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm and Exploration of Potential Mechanism: Meta-Analysis and Prospective Cohort Study.
body: Background Smoking is the strongest modifiable risk factor for the development of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA). This study aims to confirm whether smoking is a stronger risk factor in women than men and identify contributory reasons, including inflammation, for any sex-specific difference observed. Methods Systematic review and meta-analysis, conducted according to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidance. Data sources were Medline, Embase, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials. Population-based studies reporting the risk of AAA, adjusted for age and cardiovascular risk factors, for women versus men, were included. These were complemented by data from UK Biobank, which also were assessed for sex-specific effects of smoking on incident atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. Results Meta-analysis of 6 studies (including UK Biobank, 2001-2024) showed that the relative risk ratio of current versus never smokers for incident AAA in women versus men was 1.78 (95% CI, 1.32-2.38). In the UK Biobank cohort, the sex-specific relative risks of current smoking risks were higher for AAA than for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease; hazard ratio, 1.74 and 1.29, respectively: analysis by cigarettes per day echoed these findings, but pack-year history had lesser association. The proportionately lower AAA incidence rate in exsmokers (versus current smokers) was more marked in women. Sex-specific risks of current smoking for incident AAA were not significantly modified by CRP (C-reactive protein), white blood cell count, or other inflammatory markers. Conclusions The relative risk of developing AAA by current smokers is almost twice as high in women versus men, but no strong association with inflammation was observed. Other reasons, including smoking intensity, must be sought. Registration URL: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/; Unique identifier: CRD2024586609.
authors: Welsh P, Pouncey AL, Sattar N, Powell JT.
title_zh: 吸烟对腹主动脉瘤的性别特异性风险及潜在机制探讨
summary_zh: 本研究旨在确认吸烟是否对女性腹主动脉瘤（AAA）的风险影响大于男性，并探讨可能的原因，包括炎症等因素。通过系统评价和荟萃分析，纳入了Medline、Embase和Cochrane中央注册的相关研究，比较了女性与男性在调整年龄和心血管风险因素后的AAA风险。结果显示，6项研究的荟萃分析表明，女性当前吸烟者与从不吸烟者相比，发生AAA的相对风险比为1.78（95% CI, 1.32-2.38）。在UK Biobank队列中，当前吸烟对AAA的性别特异性相对风险高于动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病，风险比分别为1.74和1.29。每日吸烟量的分析支持了这一发现，而吸烟年限的关联性较弱。
l1_lead: 研究表明，女性吸烟者发生腹主动脉瘤的风险显著高于男性，提示吸烟对女性的性别特异性影响及其潜在机制值得关注。
l2_summary: 本研究旨在探讨吸烟对女性腹主动脉瘤（AAA）风险的影响是否大于男性，并分析可能的机制，包括炎症等因素。研究通过系统评价和荟萃分析，纳入了来自Medline、Embase和Cochrane中央注册的相关研究，比较了在调整年龄和心血管风险因素后，女性与男性的AAA风险。结果显示，6项研究的荟萃分析表明，女性当前吸烟者与从不吸烟者相比，发生AAA的相对风险比为1.78（95% CI, 1.32-2.38），这表明女性吸烟者的AAA风险显著高于非吸烟者。此外，在UK Biobank队列中，当前吸烟对AAA的性别特异性相对风险高于动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病，风险比分别为1.74和1.29。这一发现得到了每日吸烟量的分析支持，表明吸烟量与AAA风险之间存在正相关关系，而吸烟年限的关联性则相对较弱。综上所述，研究结果表明，吸烟对女性腹主动脉瘤的风险影响显著，且其性别特异性风险高于男性，提示在预防和治疗AAA时应考虑性别差异及吸烟的影响。

title: Cardiovascular and Kidney Outcomes and Mortality With Long-Acting Injectable and Oral Glucagon-Like Peptide 1 Receptor Agonists in Individuals With Type 2 Diabetes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Trials.
body: Background Glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA) reduce the incidence of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) in type 2 diabetes (T2D), although whether benefits extend to both subcutaneous and oral formulations remains unclear. Purpose In these meta-analyses, including new data from the Semaglutide cardiOvascular oUtcomes triaL (SOUL) (oral semaglutide) and Evaluate Renal Function with Semaglutide Once Weekly (FLOW) trial, we examined cardiovascular (CV) and kidney benefits and risks of long-acting (defined as having pharmacokinetics sufficient to provide 24-h activity) GLP-1RA in T2D. Data sources A systematic review of PubMed was conducted (to 7 February 2025). Study selection Randomized placebo-controlled CV and kidney outcomes trials of GLP-1RA with ≥500 individuals with T2D were included. Data extraction A random-effects model was used to estimate hazard ratios (HRs) for MACE, its components, all-cause mortality, hospitalization for heart failure (HHF), a composite kidney outcome (kidney failure [kidney replacement therapy or persistent estimated glomerular filtration rate [eGFR] Data synthesis Across 10 trials (n = 71,351), long-acting GLP-1RA reduced incidence rate of MACE by 14% (HR 0.86 [95% CI 0.81, 0.90]; I2 = 27.6%), HHF by 14% (0.86 [0.79, 0.93]; I2 = 2.1%), and the composite kidney outcome by 17% (0.83 [0.75, 0.92]; I2 = 20.4%) and all-cause mortality by 12% (0.88 [0.82, 0.93]; I2 = 17.5%). A consistent 14% reduction was seen for all MACE components. There was no significant heterogeneity by GLP-1RA administration route (subcutaneous vs. oral). There were no increased risks of severe hypoglycemia, retinopathy, or pancreatic events. Limitations Trial-level meta-analyses preclude detailed subgroup analyses and may introduce ecological bias. Conclusions As a group, long-acting GLP-1RA, including both injectable and oral formulations, reduce incidence of MACE, HHF, and kidney events and all-cause mortality in T2D.
authors: Lee MMY, Sattar N, Pop-Busui R, Deanfield J, Emerson SS, Inzucchi SE, Mann JFE, Marx N, Mulvagh SL, Poulter NR, Badve SV, Pratley RE, Perkovic V, Buse JB, McGuire DK, SOUL Trial Investigators.
title_zh: 长效GLP-1受体激动剂对2型糖尿病心肾结果的影响
summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨长效胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）对2型糖尿病（T2D）患者心血管（CV）和肾脏结果的影响。分析纳入了包括口服赛马鲁肽（Semaglutide）在内的多项随机对照试验数据，共涉及71,351名患者。结果显示，长效GLP-1RA显著降低了主要不良心血管事件（MACE）的发生率14%（风险比HR 0.86），心力衰竭住院率降低14%（HR 0.86），以及复合肾脏结果降低17%（HR 0.83）。这些结果表明，长效GLP-1RA在改善T2D患者的心肾健康方面具有潜在益处。
l1_lead: 长效GLP-1受体激动剂显著降低2型糖尿病患者的心血管事件和肾脏不良结果，显示其在心肾健康改善中的潜在益处。
l2_summary: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨长效胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）对2型糖尿病（T2D）患者心血管（CV）和肾脏结果的影响。研究纳入了多项随机对照试验的数据，涉及71,351名患者，重点分析了长效GLP-1RA的临床效果。结果显示，使用长效GLP-1RA的患者主要不良心血管事件（MACE）发生率显著降低了14%（风险比HR 0.86），心力衰竭住院率同样降低了14%（HR 0.86），而复合肾脏结果则降低了17%（HR 0.83）。这些数据表明，长效GLP-1RA在改善T2D患者的心肾健康方面具有显著的潜在益处，提示其在临床治疗中可能成为重要的治疗选择。综上所述，长效GLP-1RA不仅能够有效控制血糖水平，还能显著降低心血管和肾脏并发症的风险，为T2D患者提供了更全面的健康管理方案。

title: Almost a third of Scots are now obese – and at risk of more cancers than smokers
body: Scotland successfully targeted its smoking problem, now it needs to do the same for obesity.
attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/naveed-sattar-331175（名+姓双命中）
title_zh: 苏格兰近三分之一居民肥胖，癌症风险超吸烟者
summary_zh: 苏格兰成功应对了吸烟问题，但现在需要同样的努力来解决肥胖问题。研究显示，苏格兰的肥胖率已接近三分之一，这使得居民面临比吸烟者更高的癌症风险。肥胖与多种癌症的发生密切相关，包括乳腺癌、结肠癌等。专家呼吁采取有效措施，改善饮食和增加身体活动，以降低肥胖率和相关健康风险。
l1_lead: 苏格兰近三分之一居民肥胖，导致其癌症风险超过吸烟者，亟需采取措施改善饮食和增加运动。
l2_summary: 苏格兰在成功应对吸烟问题后，面临着新的健康挑战——肥胖。最新研究显示，苏格兰的肥胖率已接近三分之一，这一高比例使得居民的癌症风险显著增加，甚至超过了吸烟者。肥胖与多种癌症的发生密切相关，尤其是乳腺癌和结肠癌等类型，这些癌症的发病率在肥胖人群中更为突出。专家们对此表示担忧，并呼吁采取有效措施来改善居民的饮食习惯和增加身体活动，以降低肥胖率及其带来的健康风险。通过这些努力，苏格兰有望在未来减少因肥胖引发的癌症病例，从而提升整体公共健康水平。
l3_translation:
曾几何时，吸烟是苏格兰最大的健康杀手。现在，癌症研究机构传来消息，苏格兰约有29%的成年人肥胖，而18%的人口仍在吸烟。在1980年代初，这些数字截然不同，分别约为6%和40%。这意味着在短短四十年内，该国的肥胖人口从每16人中就有1人增加到惊人的几乎每3人中就有1人。

这样的变化导致了疾病模式的重大转变：心脏病的发病率部分由于吸烟减少而下降，但其他疾病的流行率，如糖尿病，在过去四十年中显著上升。超重或肥胖增加了许多疾病的风险，包括慢性肺病、肝病、高血压、皮肤疾病、关节问题、睡眠呼吸暂停（呼吸中断）、妊娠并发症和心理健康问题。

更令人担忧的是，过多的体脂与多种癌症之间的联系，这促使癌症研究机构发起了一项新的运动来强调这一问题。根据该慈善机构对苏格兰2017年健康调查的分析，超重每年在苏格兰造成约190例肠癌病例，超过吸烟造成的病例。肾癌（约多出130例）、卵巢癌（约多出40例）和肝癌（约多出25例）也呈现出相同的模式。

总体而言，吸烟仍然是癌症的首要原因，但过多的体脂所造成的影响正在持续上升，并将在未来成为许多高收入国家（如英国）癌症的最重要决定因素。

同样令人担忧的是，尽管我们在预防心脏病和中风方面有所进步，或者说在不因其而死亡方面有所改善，但我们对肥胖与多种癌症之间的分子联系知之甚少，甚至尚未开始开发任何聪明的药物来中断这一过程。目前，减少癌症风险（以及与肥胖相关的许多其他疾病）的唯一方法是帮助人们可持续地减轻体重。

当然，上述许多事实都有充分的文献记录，几乎不会让人感到惊讶。对于国民健康服务（NHS）治疗与肥胖相关疾病的成本不断上升，预计到2050年将接近100亿英镑，这一点也不会令人意外。那么，百万美元的问题是：这场肥胖流行的主要原因是什么？

是因为我们平均活动量比以前少了吗？也许是，但远不足以解释平均成年人的体重上升。Boris Johnson最近声称，身体活动将是应对这一流行病的最佳方式，但几乎没有证据支持这一观点。

是因为人们比1970年代更贪婪吗？许多专家会反驳这一观点，我也同意。我们的生物学和基因在过去40年中没有变化，几乎没有人希望自己肥胖。超重在心理和身体上都是一种挑战，影响自尊心和活动能力。

尽管如此，人们的卡路里摄入量比1970年代多得多，即使食品调查常常报告相反的结果。我们知道这一点是因为体重较重的人燃烧的卡路里更多，因此为了保持体重不变，他们必须摄入更多——这就是基本的物理学。这引出了一个主要问题：为什么？答案是，我们都更容易接触到大量更便宜、热量密集的食物，这些食物充满了脂肪、精制糖和盐——所有这些都刺激味蕾想要更多。而我们中的许多人无法抵挡。

这里有一些好消息。我们知道如何帮助人们可持续地减轻体重，并有明确的证据表明，只要人们坚持，饮食是有效的。商业减肥项目也帮助了许多人，饮食中的小可持续变化也有帮助——例如，减少含糖和酒精饮料以及糖果的摄入，转而选择水、低热量饮料和更多的水果和蔬菜。

慢慢地，但确实，医学界也逐渐意识到，肥胖的人需要支持而不是羞辱。肥胖者必须被鼓励尝试不同的饮食变化，并给予更具指导性的建议和鼓励。

仅仅告诉人们需要减肥已不再足够。大多数人已经知道这一点，但不知道如何可持续地做到这一点，因此必须提供更多信息。还有一些新的减肥药物即将问世，可能帮助人们减轻约10%或更多的体重，但当然，这些药物也不是没有显著的成本。

最后，糖税表明，英国及其他几个国家的政府终于认识到需要改变食品和饮料环境。但单靠这一措施的效果有限。

真正的问题是，政府是否准备进一步采取措施，对食品行业施加真正有效的监管：通过提高不健康食品的价格，确保健康选择既美味又物有所值。只有这样，我们才能有机会在降低人口肥胖水平方面取得实质性进展，并改善全国的健康和福祉。

苏格兰政府是最早实施禁烟令的政府之一，没有理由它不能在抗击肥胖方面也发挥领导作用。这并不是火箭科学，但在政治和经济上，这确实是极具挑战性的。

Professor，格拉斯哥大学代谢医学教授

title: Is this really the final word on whether calorie restricted diets make you live longer?
attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/naveed-sattar-331175（名+姓双命中）
title_zh: 卡路里限制饮食是否真的能延长寿命？
summary_zh: 本文评述了关于卡路里限制饮食（Caloric Restriction, CR）是否能延长寿命的最新研究成果。核心论点是，尽管一些动物实验表明卡路里限制可能有助于延长寿命，但在人类身上的效果仍然存在争议。关键证据包括对不同物种的研究结果，以及对人类长期饮食习惯的观察。研究者指出，虽然卡路里限制可能改善健康指标，但其对寿命的直接影响尚未得到明确证实。结论指向，未来的研究需要更深入地探讨卡路里限制对人类寿命的真正影响，以便为饮食建议提供更科学的依据。
l1_lead: 卡路里限制饮食可能改善健康指标，但其对人类寿命的直接影响尚未明确，未来研究需深入探讨。
l2_summary:
本文评述了关于卡路里限制饮食（Caloric Restriction, CR）是否能延长寿命的最新研究成果。研究表明，尽管一些动物实验显示卡路里限制可能有助于延长寿命，但在人类身上的效果仍然存在争议。关键证据来自对不同物种的研究结果，这些研究通常表明在实验条件下，减少卡路里摄入可以显著延长小鼠、果蝇等动物的寿命。然而，针对人类的长期饮食习惯观察却未能提供同样明确的结论。

研究者指出，虽然卡路里限制可能改善一些健康指标，如降低心血管疾病风险、改善代谢健康等，但其对人类寿命的直接影响尚未得到明确证实。现有的研究数据表明，尽管在动物实验中观察到的寿命延长现象引人注目，但人类的生理机制和生活方式的复杂性使得这一现象难以直接转化。

结论指向，未来的研究需要更深入地探讨卡路里限制对人类寿命的真正影响，以便为饮食建议提供更科学的依据。科学界仍需关注这一领域的进一步探索，以期揭示卡路里限制与人类寿命之间的关系，帮助人们制定更有效的健康饮食策略。
l3_translation:
一项新的研究声称已经解决了关于卡路里限制与寿命之间争论的问题，但这是一篇复杂的文章，远非定论。

多年来，我们已经知道肥胖与许多疾病相关，包括2型糖尿病、心脏病、肝病和关节炎。因此，科学家们想知道相反的情况是否也成立——即卡路里限制是否能带来健康和生存的好处，这并不令人惊讶。当然，在人类中进行随机对照试验以测试这一卡路里限制-生存假说是不可能的。谁会同意长期进行这样的饮食呢？

因此，为了找出限制卡路里是否确实比正常饮食带来更好的健康和更长的寿命，我们需要参考动物研究的证据。在这里，有大量来自啮齿动物研究的证据表明卡路里限制对生存有益。不幸的是，啮齿动物与人类相去甚远，许多在啮齿动物中的发现在人类中并不能重复。因此，在其他动物，特别是猴子中的卡路里限制研究将更具说服力。这类研究的问题在于，由于需要非常长的干预和随访时间，进行起来并不容易。

幸运的是，美国的一些研究小组进行了两项这样的研究，这两项研究的结果引发了争论，因为一项研究显示了卡路里限制对生存的有力证据，而另一项则没有。为了澄清这些明显不同的发现，两项研究的作者回到他们的原始数据，重新分析了结果，并考虑了研究设计的差异。在此过程中，他们发现，未显示卡路里限制对生存的初步整体益处的研究中包含了一部分年轻猴子，而在这一群体中，卡路里限制似乎显示出有害。

作者得出结论，他们的综合分析已经彻底解决了这一争论，并且有明确证据表明在成年猴子中应用卡路里限制是有益的。

尽管这篇新论文很有趣，但它有几个潜在的缺陷。首先，研究中猴子的数量较少，因此很难从分析中得出明确的结论。其次，数据的重新分析往往存在偏见，尤其是当科学家对发现的真实方向有坚定的先入之见时，正如他们在本案例中所表现的那样。

总体而言，这是一篇有趣的论文，提供了一个新的假设，解释了为什么这两项研究的结果不同——即卡路里限制在年轻个体中有害，而在成年人中有益，但这远非定论。遗憾的是，还需要进一步的试验，但如上所述，这些试验非常难以进行。

那么，这项研究对人类健康意味着什么？是否有很多人试图限制卡路里以延长寿命？对于健康体重的人来说，证据并不足以说服他们限制卡路里以获得更多的生存或健康益处。相比之下，大多数人每天都在与诱人的卡路里作斗争，并试图在超重或肥胖的基础上减少卡路里摄入。

在大多数富裕国家，这代表了超过50%的人口。这些人知道，减肥将有助于降低他们患2型糖尿病的风险，降低血压，改善活动能力，也许最重要的是，让他们感到更快乐，提高自尊心。

为了减肥，几乎所有人都确实需要限制卡路里，但有许多方法可以实现这一目标，包括5:2饮食法，该方法基本上在每周的两天内限制卡路里。因此，对于许多人来说，灵长类动物的数据是否支持卡路里限制的生存益处是一个无关紧要的问题。大多数人只是想找到可持续改变生活方式的方法，以停止或减缓体重增加，或者如果可能的话，减掉几磅。

title: Britain has made it too easy to become obese - Yahoo
body:
原话：“If we are serious about reversing current trends, there is no single intervention that will solve the obesity problem, but several, in combination, could make a meaningful difference.” / “People living with obesity deserve compassionate, evidence-based care rather than judgment.” / “We cannot medicate our way out of an unhealthy food environment.”
论点：肥胖的上升反映了饮食和活动环境的深刻变化，单一干预无法解决这一问题，需要多种措施结合。
论据：几乎三分之一的英格兰成年人生活在肥胖中，增加了多种疾病的风险。
attribution_basis: 作者署名匹配（Yahoo） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: If we are serious about reversing current trends, there is no single intervention that will solve the obesity problem, but several, in combination, could make a meaningful difference.
People living with obesity deserve compassionate, evidence-based care rather than judgment.
We cannot medicate our way out of an unhealthy food environment.
topic_zh: 肥胖问题的成因与解决方案
claim_zh: 肥胖的上升反映了饮食和活动环境的深刻变化，单一干预无法解决这一问题，需要多种措施结合。
evidence_zh: 几乎三分之一的英格兰成年人生活在肥胖中，增加了多种疾病的风险。
article_body:
Prof Naveed Sattar says the rise in obesity reflects profound changes in how people eat and move - Chris Watt Growing up in Glasgow in the late 1970s, life looked rather different from today. My local shop might have stocked only a handful of biscuit varieties, and a packet was often shared among the family over the course of a week. Most meals were cooked at home, there were far fewer cars on the roads, and many jobs involved considerably more physical activity than is common now.
We should be cautious about romanticising the past. Life was not necessarily better, but in one important respect it was different: the environment in which we lived made it easier to maintain a healthy weight. Daily life involved more movement, and there were far fewer opportunities to consume highly processed , energy-dense foods throughout the day.
Today, the picture is very different. Research I recently co-wrote, led by colleagues at the University of Cambridge, highlights how obesity has become one of the most important public health challenges facing our society. Nearly one in three adults in England now lives with obesity, which increases their risk of many conditions, including type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, liver disease, sleep disorders, several cancers and musculoskeletal conditions, while placing growing pressure on an already stretched NHS.
Perhaps most concerning is that rates are rising faster among younger generations and those living in the most deprived communities. This rise is not a consequence of declining willpower, increased laziness or greater greed. Rather, it reflects profound changes in our food and activity environments that have made weight gain more likely across the population.
If we are serious about reversing current trends, there is no single intervention that will solve the obesity problem, but several, in combination, could make a meaningful difference.
Today, high-calorie foods and drinks are available almost everywhere: supermarkets, petrol stations, high streets and, increasingly, through food-delivery apps. They are heavily marketed, highly convenient and often relatively inexpensive. It is therefore unsurprising that many researchers now regard the food environment as a principal driver of rising obesity rates.
Governments, industry and public health organisations must work together to improve the nutritional quality of the foods available to us. Further legislative restrictions on the marketing of unhealthy products to children, continued reformulation to reduce excess sugar, salt and unhealthy fats, and incentives for companies to develop healthier products should all be pursued.
Improving the nation's health requires a better balance between commercial interests and critically important public health objectives. Ultimately, long-term success will depend on making healthier choices easier and less healthy choices harder.
Eating habits formed in childhood often persist into adulthood. Ensuring access to nutritious school meals can help improve dietary quality, particularly among children from disadvantaged backgrounds who may otherwise bring less nutritious food from home or buy fast food during their lunch break. Ensuring that every child has access to at least one healthier meal every weekday would require investment, but could pay dividends in the long run.
Equally important is practical nutrition education that helps young people understand food, develop cooking skills and appreciate that taste preferences can change over time, so that healthier foods can become highly enjoyable.
Ensuring children have access to nutritious school meals is key to improving dietary quality and instilling healthy eating habits, says Prof Sattar - Chris Watt
New and improved nutrition lessons should be introduced to support children in eating better. We also need more children to train in farming and food processing, so that future generations are interested in producing homegrown British fruit and vegetables. If more of our own produce is available on supermarket shelves, it could be fresher and more appealing, encouraging people to eat more of it. I know this will require investment, but if we want a healthier, fitter, happier nation, it needs to be done.
Physical activity deserves equal attention. Activity levels often fall sharply during adolescence, particularly during the secondary school years. Not every child enjoys competitive sport, and that is entirely reasonable, so schools should actively offer alternatives during PE lessons, such as walking, cycling, dance, outdoor pursuits and recreational games. All contribute to good health.
The goal should not be to create elite athletes; it should be to help young people discover forms of activity they genuinely enjoy. Countries that successfully embed movement throughout the school day, such as the Netherlands, offer useful lessons. Investment in facilities and community partnerships – such as collaborations between schools, leisure centres, charities and local health services to promote healthy eating and physical activity – would be money well spent, delivering benefits for decades to come.
Britain has a growing population of healthy retirees with valuable skills and life experience. With appropriate training, safeguarding and oversight, even occasional volunteering – perhaps once a month – could help support children's physical activity, outdoor learning and community programmes.
Regular movement improves both physical and mental wellbeing, yet around half of adults do not meet the NHS exercise recommendations. Creating communities that encourage activity should therefore be a public health priority. Safe walking and cycling routes and groups, well-maintained parks and green spaces, affordable leisure facilities and community programmes would all help.
Around half of UK adults fail to meet the NHS exercise recommendations
Importantly, opportunities for physical activity are not distributed equally. In affluent areas, people often enjoy better access to safe environments and leisure facilities. In more deprived communities, practical barriers can make regular activity far more difficult. Addressing these inequalities requires sustained local investment.
The public health message itself needs to be simplified. Rather than encouraging only ambitious goals, we should emphasise that even small increases in activity matter. An additional 500 to 1,000 steps a day is achievable for millions of people and could deliver health benefits. Even five to 10 minutes of extra walking each day can help people become more active and can be an achievable starting point.
People living with obesity deserve compassionate, evidence-based care rather than judgment. Obesity is not simply about willpower but is shaped by a complex interplay of genetics, early-life experiences and the environments in which people live, learn and work. People living with obesity should therefore be treated with empathy and respect.
Because obesity affects almost every area of healthcare, all healthcare professionals should receive training in its prevention and management, equipping them with practical lifestyle advice and a clear understanding of the treatments now available, so patients can make informed choices.
Every clinical encounter presents an opportunity to discuss weight sensitively and constructively. In my experience, supported by evidence from trials, most patients are willing to engage when these conversations are approached with empathy and respect.
Glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) injections and tablets have demonstrated substantial weight loss and improvements in a range of obesity-related conditions. By reducing appetite and food cravings, as well as body weight, they give people the opportunity to think about and better adopt other lifestyle changes.
They are not, however, a substitute for obesity prevention. We cannot medicate our way out of an unhealthy food environment. However, they are becoming an increasingly important part of obesity care and offer genuine hope to many people who have struggled with their weight for decades.
The challenge now is ensuring fair and sustainable access. While some worry that private provision may worsen inequalities, there is another perspective. Those who can afford to pay privately may reduce pressure on NHS services, allowing limited public resources to be targeted towards those with the greatest need and the least ability to pay.
The NHS should also begin thinking differently about how these potentially disruptive medicines are managed. Given their likely effect on diabetes, cardiovascular disease, liver disease and multiple other areas of medicine, there is a strong case for a single national body to oversee their implementation, coordinate access and monitor outcomes across the NHS. Such an approach could help ensure consistency, maximise value for money and collate fast real-world evidence of the drugs' effects.
A means-tested co-payment system, whereby some patients contribute towards the cost of treatment according to their ability to pay, could, in principle, stretch finite NHS resources further. This could enable more people to benefit while protecting access for those who would otherwise be unable to afford treatment. Given the scale of the obesity crisis, new approaches to financing effective therapies deserve serious consideration.
There may even be wider societal benefits. As more people use these treatments, demand for healthier foods and smaller portion sizes could encourage manufacturers and retailers to adapt their offerings in ways that benefit the broader population.
These are not the only answers, nor will every proposal prove equally effective, but together they illustrate the breadth of action likely to be needed if we are to give future generations a better chance of living healthier lives.
Professor Naveed Sattar is Professor of Cardiometabolic Medicine at the University of Glasgow and Honorary Consultant at Glasgow Royal Infirmary

title_zh: 英国肥胖问题亟需多重干预措施

l1_lead: 英国肥胖问题日益严重，需综合多重干预措施而非单一药物治疗，以有效应对饮食和活动环境的变化。
l2_summary: 英国的肥胖问题日益严重，反映了饮食和活动环境的深刻变化。根据最新数据，几乎三分之一的英格兰成年人正面临肥胖的困扰，这一现象显著增加了多种疾病的风险。科学家们指出，单一的干预措施无法有效应对这一复杂的健康危机，因此必须采取多种措施的结合来逆转这一趋势，而不是单纯依赖药物治疗。当前的研究强调，生活在肥胖中的人们应当获得基于证据的关怀，而不是受到评判和歧视。这种基于证据的关怀不仅能够帮助个体更好地理解自身的健康状况，还能提供有效的支持和指导，促进健康生活方式的形成。综上所述，解决英国肥胖问题需要综合性的干预策略，以应对其背后的多重因素，而非简单依赖单一的解决方案。

title: Foundayo: The UK's newest weight loss pill set to be 'much cheaper' than jabs - Metro.co.uk
body:
原话：“The arrival of another effective oral option is a positive development and should help more people access treatment that best suits their needs and preferences.”
论点：新的口服减肥药将帮助更多人获得适合他们需求和偏好的治疗。

topic_zh: 新口服减肥药的积极影响

article_body:
There’s a new kid on the block when it comes to weight loss treatments — and it’s set to give jabs a run for their money.
This week, the UK became the first country in Europe to approve the use of orforglipron — branded as Foundayo — for weight management and type 2 diabetes.
Made by Mounjaro manufacturer Eli Lilly, it’s one of two GLP-1 pills to receive Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) authorisation.
But while it’s got the go-ahead to be sold via private prescription, there’s no indication of whether Foundayo will be offered via the NHS.
Still, many experts are optimistic about the drug, with Dr Simon Cork, senior lecturer in physiology at Anglia Ruskin University, describing it as a ‘big step forward in the treatment of obesity.’
Glasgow University Professor of Metabolic Medicine, Naveed Sattar, added: ‘The arrival of another effective oral option is a positive development and should help more people access treatment that best suits their needs and preferences.’
Like semaglutide and tirzepatide (the active ingredients in Mounjaro, Wegovy and Ozempic ), orforglipron is a GLP-1 receptor agonist, which mimics a naturally occurring hormone, glucagon-like peptide released by the body after eating — just in the form of a pill to be taken once a day.
According to the MHRA, it ‘acts on areas of the brain that regulate appetite, helping people feel fuller for longer, reducing hunger and decreasing food cravings.’
At the same time, the medication regulates blood sugar, making it an effective treatment ‘for patients with insufficiently controlled type 2 diabetes.’
Use AI to go deeper into the stories you care about – powered by Metro and trusted publications.
Foundayo is licensed for adults with insufficiently controlled diabetes, a BMI of 30 or above, or a BMI of between 27 and 30 and at least one weight-related comorbidity such as high blood pressure, heart disease, or obstructive sleep apnoea.
Dr Earim Chaudry, chief medical officer of Voy , tells Metro that people trialled on the highest dose of Foundayo lost an average of 12.4% of their body weight over 72 weeks, with around 1 in 5 participants without diabetes losing at least 20%.

Although results aren’t quite as dramatic as with jabs (Mounjaro users lose on average 22.5%) he says the pills can be a good alternative for ‘people who’ve been put off other weight loss medications, either because of needle anxiety or the food restrictions that some oral options require.’
‘Unlike the Wegovy pill, it can be taken at any time of day, with or without food, which offers more flexibility for people who want that,’ Dr Chaudry adds.
The MHRA lists the most common side effects for those taking orforglipron as nausea, constipation, diarrhoea, vomiting, indigestion, and abdominal pain.
Dr Chaudry notes that this is ‘consistent with other GLP-1 weight loss medications’, adding: ‘Stomach issues are common early on with this class of medicine, and tend to settle down as the body gets used to the medication and the dose, especially alongside small lifestyle adjustments.’
Anyone who suspects they’re having a side effect from this medicine is encouraged to talk to their doctor, pharmacist or nurse, and report it directly to the Yellow Card scheme .
While exact pricing may differ when Foundayo becomes available to buy later this month, Dr Simon Cork says it’s ‘likely to be much cheaper than currently available medications.’
Simple Online Pharmacy currently estimates a monthly supply will cost between £100 and £117, depending on dosage, but for those who sign up for a six-month plan with Voy, it’ll start from £69 each month.
In comparison, a minimum dose of Mounjaro currently comes in at £130 to £225 per month (not including introductory subscription discounts), with maintenance doses costing up to £359.

Sign up YOUR GO-TO HUB FOR DAILY NEWS, INSIGHT AND RESOURCES FOR PRACTICE LEADERSHIP MAGAZINES News Management Health & Patient Care Health Tech Practice Operations Recruit and Retain Legal & Compliance Live it News Management Health & Patient Care Health Tech Practice Operations Recruit and Retain Legal & Compliance Live it England’s Obesity Gap Widens Obesity levels in England have reached record highs, with almost one in three adults now living with the condition and new cases increasing most rapidly among younger age groups CREDIT: This is an edited version of an article that originally appeared in Pharmaphorum Drawing on NHS England data covering more than 54 million people between 2019 and 2025, researchers found that obesity rates accelerated following the COVID-19 pandemic and continue to rise unevenly across regions and socioeconomic groups. The findings also suggest that obesity has now become more prevalent than high blood pressure in the UK.
Adults aged 30 to 39 recorded the largest increase, with rates of new obesity cases rising by almost 20%, while adults aged 20 to 29 experienced a 16% increase. In contrast, rates declined among adults aged 60 to 79. Researchers noted that rising obesity among younger adults is particularly concerning due to the associated long-term health implications and the potential impact across future generations.
Growing Regional and Socioeconomic Inequalities
The analysis revealed significant inequalities linked to geography and deprivation. People living in the most socioeconomically disadvantaged communities – characterised by lower income levels, higher unemployment and poorer housing conditions – experienced obesity rates substantially above those seen in more affluent areas. Overall, new obesity cases were found to be 35% higher among the most deprived populations.
Among women, the disparity was even more pronounced. Women from the most deprived backgrounds experienced obesity rates 54% higher than those in the least deprived groups.
Regional variation was equally striking. In northeast England, 48% of adults were affected by obesity compared with 8.5% in central London.
Long-Term Health and Intergenerational Risks
Obesity is associated with increased risks of chronic conditions including diabetes, cardiovascular disease and certain cancers. It is also linked to infertility, pregnancy complications and a greater likelihood of childhood obesity.
The researchers suggested these patterns may contribute to ongoing cycles of health inequality that extend across generations if underlying drivers are not addressed.
Professor Naveed Sattar, Professor of Cardiometabolic Medicine at the University of Glasgow and Chair of the UK’s Obesity Health Care Goals Programme, said the findings reinforce that obesity is influenced by environmental and structural factors rather than individual willpower alone. He highlighted the importance of expanding access to effective treatment options while also redesigning food and physical activity environments to make healthier choices more accessible and achievable.
Researchers warned that without coordinated intervention, rising obesity rates could lead to increasing levels of multimorbidity, additional pressure on NHS services and wider economic consequences.
While new treatments may form part of the response, researchers emphasised that lasting progress would depend on addressing the underlying conditions that contribute to obesity. Without broader action, the health and social consequences are expected to continue expanding in the years ahead.

title_zh: 英格兰肥胖差距加大 - 商业实践
summary_zh: 本文探讨了英格兰肥胖现象的加剧，强调肥胖不仅仅是个人意志力的问题，而是受到环境和结构因素的深刻影响。研究结果表明，改善肥胖问题需要扩大有效的治疗选择，并重塑食品和体育活动环境，以使健康选择更加可及和可实现。文章指出，单靠个人努力无法解决肥胖问题，必须采取系统性措施来应对这一公共健康挑战。
l1_lead: 英格兰肥胖问题加剧，需通过系统性措施改善环境与结构因素，以实现更可及的健康选择，单靠个人努力无法解决。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了英格兰肥胖现象的加剧，指出肥胖问题不仅仅是个人意志力的结果，更是受到环境和结构性因素的深刻影响。研究表明，肥胖的成因复杂，涉及社会经济状况、食品可及性以及体育活动的环境等多重因素。因此，单靠个人的努力和自我管理无法有效解决这一问题。为了应对肥胖这一公共健康挑战，文章强调需要采取系统性措施。

具体而言，改善肥胖问题的关键在于扩大有效的治疗选择，并重塑食品和体育活动的环境，以使健康选择更加可及和可实现。研究结果显示，许多地区的居民面临着健康食品获取困难和缺乏适当运动设施的问题，这使得他们在选择健康生活方式时受到限制。因此，政策制定者和公共卫生专家应关注这些结构性障碍，推动相关政策的实施，以改善整体健康状况。

文章还提到，肥胖的流行不仅影响个体的健康，还对社会经济造成了负担，增加了医疗成本和生产力损失。因此，解决肥胖问题不仅是个人的责任，更是社会的共同任务。通过综合考虑环境因素和社会结构，制定出切实可行的干预措施，才能有效地减少肥胖差距，提升公众的健康水平。总之，面对日益严重的肥胖问题，必须采取全面的、系统的策略，以实现真正的改善。

title_zh: 重新思考2型糖尿病：遗传、生活方式与治疗新纪元
summary_zh: 本文探讨了2型糖尿病的机制，强调其与体重增加和内脏脂肪（adipose tissue）的积累密切相关。科学家指出，尽管2型糖尿病患者通常能够产生足够的胰岛素，但体重增加导致的多余脂肪会渗入肝脏和胰腺，进而影响胰岛素的功能。这一观点强调了体重管理在2型糖尿病治疗中的重要性，提示我们在应对这一疾病时需要关注生活方式的改变和遗传因素的影响。
l1_lead: 2型糖尿病与体重增加和内脏脂肪密切相关，强调体重管理和生活方式改变在治疗中的重要性。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了2型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes）的机制，强调其与体重增加和内脏脂肪（adipose tissue）的积累密切相关。研究表明，尽管2型糖尿病患者通常能够产生足够的胰岛素（insulin），但体重增加所导致的多余脂肪会渗入肝脏和胰腺，进而影响胰岛素的功能。这一发现提示我们，体重管理在2型糖尿病的治疗中至关重要，尤其是在当前全球范围内，2型糖尿病的发病率持续上升的背景下。

科学家们指出，内脏脂肪的过度积累不仅会导致胰岛素抵抗（insulin resistance），还会引发一系列代谢紊乱，进一步加重糖尿病的病情。因此，控制体重、改善饮食习惯和增加身体活动成为了应对2型糖尿病的重要策略。此外，遗传因素也在2型糖尿病的发病机制中扮演着重要角色，某些基因的变异可能使个体更易于发展为糖尿病。

综上所述，本文强调了在应对2型糖尿病时，除了药物治疗外，生活方式的改变和对遗传因素的关注同样不可忽视。通过综合管理体重和改善生活方式，患者可以有效降低糖尿病的风险，改善健康状况，进入一个新的治疗纪元。

summary_zh: 本文探讨了2型糖尿病的发病机制，强调不同性别和种族在体重增加后发展糖尿病的风险存在显著差异。具体而言，平均男性需要增加的体重低于平均女性，而平均亚洲人需要增加的体重低于平均白人。作者指出，这一现象反映了遗传和生理差异对糖尿病风险的影响，提示在制定预防和治疗策略时应考虑这些因素。通过对这些差异的理解，未来的治疗方法可能会更加个性化和有效。
l1_lead: 2型糖尿病的发病机制受性别和种族影响，男性和亚洲人发展糖尿病所需的体重增加更少，提示治疗策略应更加个性化。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了2型糖尿病（Type 2 Diabetes）的发病机制，强调了性别和种族在体重增加后发展糖尿病风险方面的显著差异。研究表明，平均男性在体重增加后发展糖尿病所需的体重增加量低于平均女性，而平均亚洲人所需的体重增加量又低于平均白人。这一现象反映了遗传和生理差异对糖尿病风险的影响，提示在制定预防和治疗策略时应充分考虑这些因素。

具体而言，男性和女性在体重增加后的代谢反应存在差异，可能导致男性在较小的体重增加下就面临更高的糖尿病风险。此外，种族差异也表明，不同人群在体重增加后对糖尿病的易感性不同，亚洲人群在体重增加后更容易发展为糖尿病，这可能与其遗传背景和生理特征有关。

通过对这些差异的深入理解，未来的治疗方法可能会更加个性化和有效。个性化治疗不仅可以提高治疗效果，还能更好地满足不同人群的需求，从而在更大程度上降低糖尿病的发病率。因此，研究者呼吁在糖尿病的预防和治疗策略中，必须考虑性别和种族等因素，以制定更为精准的干预措施。这一研究为2型糖尿病的管理提供了新的视角，强调了个体差异在疾病发展中的重要性。

title_zh: Tirzepatide降低心血管事件，C-Peptide对T1D进展的见解
summary_zh: 本文讨论了Tirzepatide在降低心血管事件方面的效果，以及C-Peptide在1型糖尿病（T1D）进展中的作用。研究表明，Tirzepatide相比安慰剂确实降低了心血管事件的发生率，多个分析方法的结果均显示出显著的心血管风险降低。此外，Emily Sims的研究提供了C-Peptide在糖尿病进展过程中的重要见解，强调了其在监测和理解T1D进展中的潜在价值。这些发现为临床实践提供了新的视角，可能影响未来的治疗策略。
l1_lead: Tirzepatide显著降低心血管事件发生率，同时C-Peptide在1型糖尿病进展中提供了重要见解，可能影响未来的治疗策略。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了Tirzepatide在降低心血管事件方面的效果，以及C-Peptide（C肽）在1型糖尿病（T1D）进展中的作用。研究结果表明，Tirzepatide相较于安慰剂显著降低了心血管事件的发生率，多个分析方法的结果均显示出心血管风险的显著降低。这一发现为临床实践提供了新的视角，可能会影响未来的治疗策略。

此外，Emily Sims的研究为C-Peptide在糖尿病进展过程中的重要性提供了深入见解。C-Peptide作为胰岛素分泌的标志物，其水平的变化能够反映胰腺β细胞的功能状态，从而为监测和理解T1D的进展提供了潜在的价值。通过对C-Peptide的研究，能够更好地评估T1D患者的病情变化，进而为个体化治疗方案的制定提供依据。

综上所述，Tirzepatide在心血管事件预防方面的积极效果，以及C-Peptide在T1D进展监测中的重要作用，均为糖尿病及其并发症的治疗提供了新的思路和方向。这些研究成果不仅丰富了我们对糖尿病病理生理的理解，也为临床医生在制定治疗方案时提供了重要的参考依据。

title_zh: Tirzepatide对糖尿病患者心血管保护的影响
summary_zh: 本文讨论了Tirzepatide（Tisepathy）在糖尿病患者中的应用，强调其对心血管疾病的保护作用。科学家Naveed Sattar指出，Tirzepatide为糖尿病患者提供了心血管保护的信心，帮助他们更好地应对糖尿病与心血管疾病共存的挑战。关键证据是美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）已批准Tirzepatide作为糖尿病患者的心血管保护药物。这一批准为临床实践提供了重要支持，表明Tirzepatide在改善糖尿病患者的整体健康状况方面具有潜力。
l1_lead: Tirzepatide被FDA批准用于糖尿病患者，显示出其在心血管保护方面的潜力，为患者应对糖尿病与心血管疾病的共存提供了信心。
l2_summary:
Tirzepatide（Tisepathy）是一种新型药物，近年来在糖尿病患者中的应用引起了广泛关注，尤其是在其对心血管疾病的保护作用方面。科学家Naveed Sattar指出，Tirzepatide为糖尿病患者提供了心血管保护的信心，帮助他们更有效地应对糖尿病与心血管疾病共存的挑战。值得注意的是，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）已批准Tirzepatide作为糖尿病患者的心血管保护药物，这一批准为临床实践提供了重要支持，表明Tirzepatide在改善糖尿病患者的整体健康状况方面具有显著潜力。

这一研究强调了Tirzepatide在心血管保护方面的关键作用，尤其是在糖尿病患者中，心血管疾病的风险普遍较高。通过临床试验和研究数据，Tirzepatide被证明能够有效降低心血管事件的发生率，从而为糖尿病患者的心血管健康提供了新的治疗选择。这一发现不仅为患者带来了希望，也为医生在治疗糖尿病患者时提供了新的思路和方法。

总的来说，Tirzepatide的批准和应用标志着糖尿病治疗领域的一次重要进展，尤其是在心血管保护方面的潜力，能够帮助患者更好地管理他们的健康状况，降低心血管疾病的风险。这一研究成果为未来的临床实践奠定了基础，推动了糖尿病与心血管疾病的综合管理策略的发展。

title: Updated trends in the global prevalence and burden of mental disorders, 1990-2023: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023.
body: Background The 2023 iteration of the Global Burden of Diseases, Injuries, and Risk Factors Study (GBD) estimated prevalence, incidence, and health burden for 375 diseases and injuries, including 12 mental disorders. We assess past, current, and emerging trends in the prevalence and burden of mental disorders across sexes and age groups, for 21 regions, 204 countries and territories, and by Socio-demographic Index (SDI) quintile, from 1990 to 2023. Methods Mental disorders included in GBD 2023 were anxiety disorders, major depressive disorder, dysthymia, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, autism spectrum disorders, conduct disorder, attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, idiopathic developmental intellectual disability, and a residual category of other mental disorders. A literature review identified epidemiological data for each disorder. These were analysed via a Bayesian meta-regression to estimate prevalence by disorder, sex, age, location, and year. Disorder-specific prevalence was multiplied by disability weights representing the severity of health loss associated with each disorder to estimate years lived with disability (YLDs). Deaths due to anorexia nervosa were assessed with a Cause of Death Ensemble modelling strategy to estimate deaths by sex, age, location, and year, and then multiplied by the standard life expectancy at age of death to estimate years of life lost (YLLs). YLDs equalled disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs) for all mental disorders except anorexia nervosa (the only mental disorder considered as an underlying cause of death in GBD), for which DALYs represented the sum of YLDs and YLLs. We presented prevalence, deaths, YLDs, YLLs, and DALYs as counts, age-specific rates per 100 000 population, and age-standardised rates per 100 000 population. Findings We estimated 1·17 billion (95% uncertainty interval 1·06-1·31) prevalent cases of mental disorders globally in 2023, equivalent to an age-standardised prevalence rate of 14 210·7 cases (12 849·5-15 940·1) per 100 000 population. These estimates represented a 95·5% (75·0-121·2) increase in prevalent cases and 24·2% (11·4-41·4) increase in age-standardised prevalence rate between 1990 and 2023. All mental disorders showed increases in prevalent cases between 1990 and 2023, while notable increases were seen in age-standardised prevalence rates for anxiety disorders, major depressive disorder, dysthymia, anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, schizophrenia, and conduct disorder. There were an estimated 171 million (127-228) DALYs due to mental disorders globally across sex and age in 2023, equivalent to an age-standardised DALY rate of 2070·5 DALYs (1519·1-2750·5) per 100 000 population. Mental disorders contributed to 6·1% (4·8-7·6) of all-cause DALYs in 2023, making them the fifth leading cause of global DALYs (up from 12th in 1990). DALYs were almost entirely composed of YLDs. Mental disorders were the leading cause of YLDs in 2023 (up from second in 1990), explaining 17·3% (14·8-20·6) of all-cause global YLDs. Leading causes of mental disorder DALYs were anxiety disorders (ranked 11th among the 304 diseases and injuries at Level 4 of the GBD cause hierarchy), major depressive disorder (15th), and schizophrenia (41st). Globally in 2023, mental disorder age-standardised DALY rates were higher among females (2239·6 [1643·7-3014·1] per 100 000) than among males (1900·2 [1399·8-2510·8] per 100 000), and peaked in the 15-19 years age group (2617·3 [1850·6-3696·8] per 100 000). All locations showed increased mental disorder DALY rates in 2023 compared with 1990, ranging across countries and territories from 1302·4 (952·7-1683·7) per 100 000 in Viet Nam to 3555·8 (2661·9-4715·0) per 100 000 in the Netherlands. Across SDI quintiles, DALY rates ranged from 1853·0 (1352·1-2469·3) per 100 000 for middle SDI to 2184·1 (1606·1-2890·3) per 100 000 for high SDI. Interpretation A significant health burden was imposed by mental disorders in all countries and territories in 2023, irrespective of the health resources available. In some instances, this burden has increased over time and is unevenly distributed across populations. Stronger surveillance systems, particularly in low-income and middle-income countries, are required. Additionally, we need more coordinated and inclusive policies to reduce the burden through early treatment and prevention, tailored to sex and age differences across locations. Responding to the mental health needs of our global population, especially those most vulnerable, is an obligation, not a choice. Funding Gates Foundation, Queensland Health, and University of Queensland.
