在封闭空间中，室内空气的污染程度可能是室外空气的五倍。甲醛几乎存在于所有室内环境中，常常超过世界卫生组织推荐的阈值。例如，在新房中，其浓度可以达到每立方米空气20到60微克，甚至在通风不良的房间中超过每立方米空气100微克（在30分钟内的阈值为每立方米空气100微克）。

许多人甚至没有意识到他们在家中呼吸的空气可能与大城市中的空气一样，甚至更为污染。在这种情况下，减少这种看不见且鲜为人知的风险并不容易。

金属有机框架（MOF）是极具可调性的多孔材料。这些晶体化的混合多孔固体的发现始于二十五年前。就像乐高一样，它们由可以根据所需的物理化学特性组装的构建块组成。它们的工业规模生产以及首次工业应用在几年前被推迟，主要涉及二氧化碳的捕获、污染物的降解或气体的储存。

这些构建块分为两种类型：一方面是无机实体，由金属以阳离子形式构成，另一方面是主要由碳、氧或氮构成的有机分子，称为配体。

这两种类型的构建块的组合形成了纳米级（十亿分之一米）大小的孔或腔体网络。就像海绵可以在其孔中储存水一样，MOF能够捕获多种污染物，例如以远高于传统过滤器的效率捕获甲苯。

我们制造并测试了一种具有非常特定的有机构建块的MOF家族，含有与甲醛分子形成非常强的结合的吡唑基团，从而能够非常有效地捕获甲醛。

因此，我们的一个MOF的吸附能力约为20%的质量，几乎是商业过滤器的2到3倍，并且即使在典型于我们家庭的高湿度条件下，或当房间温度升高时仍保持其效率。

此外，我们可以在水中合成它，压力为常压，温度低于水的沸点，这使得其大规模生产变得更加容易。初步的生产试验显示出可能性。

title: Exploring guest species in zeolites using transmission electron microscopy: a review and outlook.
body: Zeolites, with their well-defined microporous frameworks, accommodate diverse guest species, including metal ions, atoms, clusters, complexes, and organic molecules. Direct imaging of these species and their interactions with the framework is crucial for understanding their structural and functional roles. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM), particularly aberration-corrected scanning TEM (STEM), has become an indispensable tool, offering atomic-resolution real-space insights. This review summarizes key (S)TEM techniques for probing guest species in zeolites, with a focus on low-dose strategies to minimize beam damage. We discuss the principles, applications, and limitations of various imaging modalities and highlight recent advances in visualizing metallic and organic species. Finally, we explore future directions for (S)TEM in zeolite research, emphasizing the opportunities and challenges of in situ , three-dimensional, and cryogenic imaging for resolving host-guest interactions with greater precision.
authors: Yu Z, Lin H, Zhang H, Han Y.
title_zh: 利用透射电子显微镜研究沸石中的客体物种
summary_zh: 沸石具有明确的微孔框架，能够容纳多种客体物种，包括金属离子、原子、簇、复合物和有机分子。直接成像这些物种及其与框架的相互作用对于理解其结构和功能至关重要。透射电子显微镜（TEM），特别是像差校正扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM），已成为不可或缺的工具，提供原子分辨率的实空间洞察。本文综述了探测沸石中客体物种的关键（S）TEM技术，重点介绍了低剂量策略以最小化束流损伤。我们讨论了各种成像模式的原理、应用和局限性，并强调了在可视化金属和有机物种方面的最新进展。最后，我们探讨了（S）TEM在沸石研究中的未来方向，强调了原位、三维和低温成像在更精确解析宿主-客体相互作用中的机遇与挑战。
l1_lead: 透射电子显微镜技术在沸石研究中至关重要，能够以原子分辨率直接成像客体物种及其与框架的相互作用，为理解其结构和功能提供重要洞察。
l2_summary:
沸石是一种具有明确微孔框架的材料，能够容纳多种客体物种，如金属离子、原子、簇、复合物和有机分子。为了深入理解这些客体物种及其与沸石框架之间的相互作用，直接成像显得尤为重要。透射电子显微镜（TEM）特别是像差校正扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）已成为研究沸石中客体物种的重要工具，能够提供原子分辨率的实空间观察。本文综述了在沸石中探测客体物种的关键（S）TEM技术，特别强调了低剂量策略的应用，以最小化束流损伤对样品的影响。

在成像过程中，各种成像模式的原理、应用及其局限性被详细讨论，尤其是在可视化金属和有机物种方面的最新进展。通过这些技术，研究者能够更清晰地观察到客体物种在沸石微孔中的分布和行为，从而为理解其结构和功能提供了重要的实验依据。此外，文章还探讨了（S）TEM在沸石研究中的未来方向，指出原位、三维和低温成像技术在解析宿主-客体相互作用中的潜在机遇与挑战。

总的来说，透射电子显微镜技术的进步为沸石中客体物种的研究提供了强有力的工具，推动了材料科学和化学领域的深入探索。通过不断优化成像技术，研究者能够更好地理解沸石的微观结构及其在催化、吸附等应用中的重要性。

title: How the Affordable Care Act can keep people out of prison
body: Many people who are incarcerated have problems with substance abuse, which often may have led to their incarceration. A lack of health insurance often impedes their ability to get treatment.
attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/han-yu-1200281（名+姓双命中）
title_zh: 平价医疗法如何帮助减少监禁人数
summary_zh: 许多被监禁的人面临药物滥用问题，这往往是导致他们入狱的原因之一。缺乏健康保险使他们难以获得必要的治疗。平价医疗法（Affordable Care Act）可以通过提供更广泛的医疗保险，帮助这些人获得所需的药物滥用治疗，从而降低再犯率和监禁人数。
l1_lead: 平价医疗法通过提供更广泛的医疗保险，帮助药物滥用者获得必要治疗，从而降低再犯率和监禁人数。
l2_summary: 许多被监禁的人面临药物滥用问题，这一问题往往是导致他们入狱的主要原因之一。缺乏健康保险使得这些人难以获得必要的治疗，进而加剧了他们的药物依赖和再犯风险。平价医疗法（Affordable Care Act）通过提供更广泛的医疗保险，能够有效帮助这些人获得所需的药物滥用治疗。研究表明，获得医疗保险的个体更容易接受治疗，从而降低了他们的再犯率和监禁人数。通过改善医疗保险的覆盖范围，平价医疗法不仅为有药物滥用问题的人群提供了必要的支持，也为社会整体的安全和健康做出了贡献。因此，平价医疗法在减少监禁人数方面具有重要的意义，能够为那些曾经面临药物滥用困扰的人提供重新融入社会的机会。
l3_translation:
许多前囚犯在心理健康和物质使用障碍方面面临困难。对这些疾病的适当治疗可能是成功重新融入社会与重返犯罪生活——最终回到监狱之间的关键。

我们是研究健康保险改革对犯罪再犯影响的学者。在我们最近的论文中，我们发现根据《平价医疗法案》增加医疗补助覆盖的机会可以增加对成瘾治疗的刑事司法转介，并减少暴力犯罪再犯率。

超过一半（58%）的州监狱囚犯和至少40%的联邦囚犯滥用毒品。在这些囚犯中，只有40%的女性和50%的男性在入狱时参与药物治疗项目。

释放后8到10个月，接受物质使用障碍治疗的前囚犯比例甚至更低，降至25%。

许多人不符合医疗补助的资格，这是一项为低收入人群和残疾人提供医疗保健的联邦项目。并且仍有12个州尚未将医疗补助覆盖扩展到低收入成年人。缺乏对其物质使用障碍的治疗常常使他们再次入狱。

司法统计局在2005年追踪了超过400,000名释放的囚犯。其中超过103,000人曾犯有暴力罪，约51,000人涉及公共秩序犯罪。暴力犯罪包括谋杀、强奸、勒索或威胁，而公共秩序犯罪包括骚乱、公共醉酒和其他恶习犯罪。

在这400,000名囚犯中，超过三分之二在释放后三年内被重新逮捕。约40%的因暴力和公共秩序犯罪被释放的囚犯在一年内被重新逮捕。约30%的回归囚犯报告近期使用非法毒品。

治疗物质使用障碍的最佳方法，包括美沙酮和布洛芬以及认知行为疗法，费用昂贵。这使得没有健康保险的人基本上无法承担。例如，根据初步成本估算，包括药物和综合心理社会及医疗支持服务的美沙酮治疗每周费用为126美元，按每日就诊计算，每年为6,552美元。

在我们最近的论文中，我们探讨了《平价医疗法案》下医疗补助覆盖的扩展如何影响前罪犯在监禁后犯罪的可能性。我们区分了初犯和多次再犯。这些罪犯可能具有不同的犯罪倾向，因为他们面临不同的监狱条件并具有不同的特征。根据我们的行政数据，多次再犯者相对较老，受教育程度较低，且可能在监狱中服刑时间更长。

医疗补助覆盖的效果只有在前囚犯能够获得健康服务的情况下才能显现。受到这一观察的启发，我们寻求回答其他重要问题：与未扩展医疗补助的州相比，前囚犯在扩展医疗补助的州是否增加了对健康服务，特别是物质使用障碍服务的获取？如果有增加，是否是由医疗补助驱动，还是由其他类型的健康保险如私人保险驱动？

我们发现，根据《平价医疗法案》增加医疗补助覆盖可以减少暴力和公共秩序犯罪的再犯率。结果表明，释放后一年和两年的暴力犯罪再犯率的降低幅度显著更大。

获得医疗补助使得一年和两年的暴力再犯率分别降低了30%和24%。这一关系在多次再犯者以及年长囚犯中最为显著，尤其是在45至54岁之间的囚犯中。我们还发现公共秩序犯罪的再犯率有所下降的证据较弱。

此外，我们发现通过《平价医疗法案》扩展覆盖的州，接受物质使用障碍治疗设施的入院人数有所增加，特别是在那些通过医疗补助从监狱或在假释或缓刑期间获得治疗的人群中。我们没有发现选择自费或拥有私人健康保险的个人在物质使用障碍治疗获取方面的变化。

我们研究结果的一个直接政策含义是，公共健康保险可以帮助每三年防止约100,000名前罪犯重返监狱。这意味着每年有12,000到15,000名公共秩序和暴力罪犯。

改善暴力和公共秩序罪犯的医疗保健获取至关重要，因为这些罪行的冲动性更强。财产犯罪往往是经过深思熟虑的，与心理健康或物质使用障碍的关联较小。

大多数最终进入刑事司法系统的人需要健康服务，而这些服务常常因其收入水平或就业状况而被拒绝。前罪犯必须经历美国的司法系统，这又带来了可能的创伤经历。他们还必须应对随之而来的边缘化，这种经历即使对最有韧性的人来说也可能是困难的。

在我们看来，如果我们的社会希望全面 rehabilitate 和重新融入前罪犯，那么获得心理健康服务和物质使用障碍治疗是极其重要的。此外，最近的估计表明，医疗补助可以通过减少犯罪每年实现约40亿美元的社会成本节省。

降低再犯率意味着更少的监禁、减少暴力和骚乱、更安全的社区以及更稳定的人口。获得健康保险和服务可以帮助前罪犯更好地重新融入社会。

我们的研究结果表明，扩展公共健康覆盖可以有效抑制再犯。促进前罪犯就医不仅能改善他们的健康，还能帮助他们更好地融入社会。

title: Clinical workflow gaps slow healthcare technology adoption - Healthcare Asia Magazine
body:
原话：“We look for solutions that really solve real life problems and deliver everyday impact.” / “A tech solution can be brilliant in a lab, but if it adds extra steps to a doctor's everyday life or doesn't fit into hospital systems, it won't be adopted.”
论点：医疗技术在从研发到部署的过程中，必须考虑其是否能无缝融入现有系统，否则将不会被采纳。
attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（Healthcare Asia Magazine） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: We look for solutions that really solve real life problems and deliver everyday impact.
A tech solution can be brilliant in a lab, but if it adds extra steps to a doctor's everyday life or doesn't fit into hospital systems, it won't be adopted.
topic_zh: 医疗技术采纳中的挑战
claim_zh: 医疗技术在从研发到部署的过程中，必须考虑其是否能无缝融入现有系统，否则将不会被采纳。
article_body:
Published: 12 days ago Clinical workflow gaps slow healthcare technology adoption Medtech companies face commercial barriers when new products fail to integrate with hospital systems or add complexity to clinical practice.
Healthcare technology companies risk losing adoption if products cannot fit existing clinical workflows, regardless of how advanced the underlying technology may be.
Speaking during Medical Fair Asia 2026, Yu-Han, Project Manager at Taiwan Excellence, said healthcare products are assessed across research and development, design, marketing and quality, with emphasis on whether they address practical needs.
“We look for solutions that really solve real life problems and deliver everyday impact,” Yu-Han said.
The real test comes when healthcare technology moves from development to deployment. Hospitals must consider whether new tools can be integrated into existing systems without creating additional administrative or operational burdens for clinicians.
“A tech solution can be brilliant in a lab, but if it adds extra steps to a doctor's everyday life or doesn't fit into hospital systems, it won't be adopted,” Yu-Han said.
Regulation adds another layer of complexity. Navigating different local policies and requirements can lengthen implementation and complicate market entry across healthcare systems.
For medtech companies, commercial success therefore depends not only on technical performance but also on workflow compatibility, regulatory readiness and ease of implementation.
Technologies that reduce friction for clinicians and integrate more easily into existing hospital processes are more likely to move from pilot or development stages into routine use.
title_zh: 医疗技术采纳受限于临床工作流程缺口
summary_zh: 本文探讨了医疗技术在从研发到部署过程中面临的挑战，特别是其与现有医院系统的兼容性问题。作者指出，尽管技术解决方案在实验室中可能表现出色，但如果它们增加了医生日常工作的复杂性或无法与医院系统无缝对接，就不会被广泛采纳。文章强调，解决实际问题并在日常工作中产生影响是推动医疗技术成功应用的关键。
l1_lead: 医疗技术的成功应用依赖于其与临床工作流程的兼容性，若增加医生工作复杂性则难以被广泛采纳。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了医疗技术在从研发到部署过程中所面临的挑战，特别是与现有医院系统的兼容性问题。作者指出，尽管一些技术解决方案在实验室环境中表现出色，但在实际应用中，如果这些技术增加了医生日常工作的复杂性，或者无法与医院的现有系统无缝对接，就会导致其难以被广泛采纳。这一现象反映出医疗技术采纳的一个重要障碍，即临床工作流程的缺口。文章强调，解决实际问题并在日常工作中产生积极影响，是推动医疗技术成功应用的关键。

在医疗行业，医生的工作流程通常是高度复杂且繁忙的，任何可能导致额外负担的技术都可能被抵制。因此，医疗技术的设计和实施必须充分考虑临床工作流程的实际需求，确保技术能够与现有系统有效整合，以减少对医生工作的干扰。作者呼吁研发团队在技术开发阶段就应与临床医生密切合作，了解他们的需求和痛点，从而设计出更符合实际使用场景的解决方案。

此外，文章还指出，成功的医疗技术不仅需要在技术层面上具备先进性，更需要在实际应用中展现出其对临床工作的积极影响。只有当医疗技术能够真正解决临床医生面临的实际问题，并在日常工作中提供便利时，才能获得医生的认可和采纳。因此，推动医疗技术的成功应用，关键在于如何有效地缩小技术与临床工作流程之间的差距，确保技术的实用性和可操作性。

title: Nanotechnology-driven optogenetics for therapeutic grade interventions.
body: Optogenetics, a biotechnology that combines optical and genetic strategies to regulate cellular and tissue functions with high spatial and temporal precision, serves as a powerful tool-level regulatory technology widely employed to investigate cellular processes and elucidate disease mechanisms. Nanotechnology-driven optogenetics, which incorporates nanomaterials/nanostructures to improve the efficacy and broaden the applications of optogenetic systems, synergistically integrates the precision, tunability, and multifunctionality of nanotechnology with the spatiotemporal control inherent to optogenetics. The development not only enhances the flexibility and efficiency of optogenetic technology but also advances the field toward therapeutic-grade interventions. In this review, we summarize recent advances in nanotechnology-driven optogenetics, with a particular emphasis on three key areas: (1) nanostructured light sources for the precise activation of optogenetic systems, which include both externally light-stimulated systems and systems that operate independently of external light sources; (2) nanotechnology-enabled targeted delivery of light-sensitive proteins and genetic constructs to ensure efficient modulation of optogenetic pathways, which specifically involves the nanotechnology-assisted gene, protein, and recombinase enzyme delivery approaches; and (3) nanotechnology-driven therapeutic applications of optogenetics, including CAR T cell immunotherapy, cancer treatment, neurological interventions, and cardiac therapies. We further discuss the current challenges facing this emerging field and outline future research directions. This review aims not only to highlight recent breakthroughs but also to position nanotechnology-driven optogenetics as a promising tool for next-generation precision medicine.
authors: Chen X, Zhang X, Zhao Y.
title_zh: 纳米技术驱动的光遗传学在治疗干预中的应用
summary_zh: 光遗传学是一种结合光学和遗传策略的生物技术，能够以高空间和时间精度调控细胞及组织功能。纳米技术驱动的光遗传学通过引入纳米材料/纳米结构，提升了光遗传系统的有效性并拓宽了其应用范围。该技术将纳米技术的精确性、可调性和多功能性与光遗传学固有的时空控制相结合，增强了光遗传技术的灵活性和效率，推动其向治疗级干预发展。本文总结了纳米技术驱动的光遗传学的最新进展，重点关注三个关键领域：1）用于精确激活光遗传系统的纳米结构光源；2）纳米技术促进的光敏蛋白和基因构建体的靶向递送；3）纳米技术驱动的光遗传学路径调控。
l1_lead: 纳米技术驱动的光遗传学通过提升系统有效性和灵活性，拓宽了其在治疗干预中的应用潜力。
l2_summary:
纳米技术驱动的光遗传学（optogenetics）是一种新兴的生物技术，结合了光学与遗传学的策略，能够以极高的空间和时间精度调控细胞及组织的功能。随着纳米技术的引入，光遗传学的有效性得到了显著提升，同时其应用范围也得到了拓展。纳米技术的精确性、可调性和多功能性与光遗传学的时空控制能力相结合，使得这一技术在治疗干预方面展现出更大的灵活性和效率。

在这一领域的最新进展中，研究者们重点关注了三个关键领域。首先，纳米结构光源的开发使得光遗传系统的激活更加精确。这些纳米结构能够有效地集中和调节光的强度与波长，从而实现对光敏蛋白的精准激活。其次，纳米技术在光敏蛋白和基因构建体的靶向递送方面也发挥了重要作用。通过纳米载体，研究者能够将光敏蛋白和基因构建体高效地递送到特定细胞或组织中，增强了治疗的针对性和有效性。最后，纳米技术驱动的光遗传学路径调控为研究细胞信号传导和神经网络的功能提供了新的工具。这些技术的结合不仅提高了实验的可重复性，还为基础研究和临床应用提供了新的思路。

综上所述，纳米技术驱动的光遗传学在治疗干预中的应用展现出广阔的前景，能够为疾病的治疗提供新的方法和策略。随着相关技术的不断发展，未来有望在神经科学、心血管疾病及其他领域实现更为精准的治疗效果。

title: Preparation of an activatable benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe for multispectral optoacoustic and NIR-II fluorescence dual-mode imaging of liver injury.
body: Light-excited dual-mode imaging that integrates multispectral optoacoustic tomography (MSOT) and near-infrared region II fluorescence (NIR-II FL) imaging allows complementary deep-tissue visualization with high anatomical resolution and molecular sensitivity, thereby enhancing the accuracy of biomedical diagnostics. Activatable probes further advance this approach by producing signals upon recognition of disease-related biomarkers, which reduces background interference and improves imaging specificity. BTPE-NO 2 @F127, a benzothiadiazole-based nanoprobe, exhibits selective activation of both optoacoustic and NIR-II FL signals in response to hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ), a crucial early stage biomarker of liver injury, thus permitting cross-validated detection of hepatic damage in vivo with excellent signal-to-background ratio contrast. Here we present detailed procedures for preparation of the BTPE-NO 2 @F127 nanoprobe and its applications in MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of trazodone- or ischemia-reperfusion-induced liver injury in mice. Compared to conventional liver injury diagnostic methods, such as invasive tissue biopsy, ex vivo blood analysis and previously reported fluorescent/optoacoustic probes, BTPE-NO 2 @F127 offers real-time, in situ monitoring with high sensitivity and signal-to-background ratio, as well as mutually corroborating signals for increased reliability. The fabrication of BTPE-NO 2 @F127, including the chemical synthesis and characterization, requires ~17 d, while the in vitro validation of its H 2 O 2 responsiveness takes ~5 d. Notably, the complete workflow of data acquisition and analysis for MSOT/NIR-II FL dual-mode imaging of liver injury in mice using BTPE-NO 2 @F127 can be accomplished within 10 h. The protocol is easy to follow and suitable for clinicians and researchers with a basic understanding of chemistry and bioimaging techniques.
authors: Wu Y, Zhang C, Chen J, Zeng F, Wu S, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
title_zh: 可激活苯并噻二唑纳米探针用于肝损伤双模成像
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于苯并噻二唑的可激活纳米探针BTPE-NO 2 @F127，能够在氢 peroxide (H 2 O 2)的作用下选择性激活光声和近红外区域II荧光(NIR-II FL)信号。该探针用于多光谱光声断层成像(MSOT)和NIR-II FL双模成像，能够实现高灵敏度和信号与背景比的实时监测，特别适用于小鼠模型中的氟西汀或缺血-再灌注引起的肝损伤检测。与传统的肝损伤诊断方法相比，BTPE-NO 2 @F127提供了更高的成像特异性和可靠性，减少了背景干扰，增强了生物医学诊断的准确性。本文详细描述了BTPE-NO 2 @F127纳米探针的制备过程及其在肝损伤成像中的应用。
l1_lead: 研究开发的苯并噻二唑纳米探针BTPE-NO 2 @F127可在肝损伤检测中实现高灵敏度的双模成像，显著提高成像特异性和准确性。
l2_summary:
本文介绍了一种新型的可激活纳米探针BTPE-NO2@F127，该探针基于苯并噻二唑结构，能够在氢过氧化物（H2O2）的作用下选择性激活光声（photoacoustic, PA）信号和近红外区域II荧光（NIR-II FL）信号。BTPE-NO2@F127的设计旨在实现多光谱光声断层成像（MSOT）和NIR-II FL双模成像，具有高灵敏度和优良的信号与背景比，特别适合用于小鼠模型中氟西汀或缺血-再灌注引起的肝损伤检测。

与传统的肝损伤诊断方法相比，BTPE-NO2@F127在成像特异性和可靠性方面表现出显著优势，能够有效减少背景干扰，从而提高生物医学诊断的准确性。研究中详细描述了BTPE-NO2@F127纳米探针的制备过程，强调了其在肝损伤成像中的应用潜力。通过该探针的使用，研究者能够实现对肝损伤的实时监测，为相关疾病的早期诊断和治疗提供了新的可能性。整体而言，BTPE-NO2@F127的开发为肝损伤的成像技术提供了创新的解决方案，具有重要的临床应用价值。

title: Nanomedicine-Based Therapeutic Strategies for Next-Generation Cancer Immunotherapy.
body: Cancer immunotherapy has reshaped cancer treatment by enabling the immune system to recognize and eliminate tumor cells. Nevertheless, its clinical translation remains limited by suboptimal response rates, poor penetration into deep tumor tissues, and insufficient therapeutic efficacy. Cancer immunotherapy alone is often inadequate as a sole treatment modality. Nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies, including photothermal therapy, photodynamic therapy, sonodynamic therapy, nanozyme-based therapy, and cancer vaccines, have achieved considerable recognition for cancer treatment. Upon integration with cancer immunotherapy or regulated cell death pathways, these nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies can modulate the tumor microenvironment, enhance anticancer immune response, and overcome immunotherapy resistance. This article summarizes recent advances in nanomedicine-based therapeutic strategies, the role of cancer immunotherapy, and regulated cell death pathways. We outline the strengths and limitations of these therapeutic strategies. We also discuss how combination therapeutic strategies achieve synergistic effects, future challenges, and perspectives in developing next-generation nanomedicine platforms for cancer immunotherapy.
authors: Tan BSN, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
title_zh: 基于纳米医学的下一代癌症免疫治疗策略
summary_zh: 癌症免疫治疗通过激活免疫系统识别和消灭肿瘤细胞，重塑了癌症治疗。然而，其临床应用受到反应率低、深层肿瘤组织渗透差和治疗效果不足的限制，单独使用时往往效果不佳。基于纳米医学的治疗策略，如光热疗法、光动力疗法、声动力疗法、纳米酶治疗和癌症疫苗等，已在癌症治疗中获得显著认可。与癌症免疫治疗或调控细胞死亡途径结合后，这些策略能够调节肿瘤微环境，增强抗癌免疫反应，并克服免疫治疗耐药性。本文总结了基于纳米医学的治疗策略的最新进展、癌症免疫治疗的作用及调控细胞死亡途径，分析了这些策略的优缺点，并讨论了组合治疗策略如何实现协同效应、未来挑战及下一代纳米医学平台在癌症免疫治疗中的发展前景。
l1_lead: 基于纳米医学的治疗策略与癌症免疫治疗结合，能够增强抗癌免疫反应，克服免疫治疗耐药性，展现出良好的发展前景。
l2_summary:
癌症免疫治疗通过激活免疫系统来识别和消灭肿瘤细胞，已成为癌症治疗的重要手段。然而，临床应用中存在反应率低、深层肿瘤组织渗透差和治疗效果不足等问题，单独使用时往往效果不理想。为了解决这些挑战，基于纳米医学的治疗策略逐渐受到重视，包括光热疗法、光动力疗法、声动力疗法、纳米酶治疗和癌症疫苗等。这些策略在癌症治疗中取得了显著的进展，尤其是在与癌症免疫治疗或调控细胞死亡途径相结合时，能够有效调节肿瘤微环境，增强抗癌免疫反应，并克服免疫治疗的耐药性。

近年来的研究表明，纳米医学的治疗策略能够通过改善药物的靶向性和生物相容性，提升治疗效果。例如，光热疗法利用纳米材料在特定波长光照射下产生热量，从而选择性地杀死肿瘤细胞；光动力疗法则通过光敏剂在光照下产生活性氧，损伤肿瘤细胞；声动力疗法利用超声波增强药物的渗透性；纳米酶治疗则通过纳米颗粒模拟酶的功能，促进肿瘤细胞的死亡；癌症疫苗则通过激活特异性免疫反应来对抗肿瘤。

这些纳米医学策略的结合，不仅能够提升免疫治疗的效果，还能通过协同作用克服单一治疗的局限性。尽管如此，这些策略也存在一定的缺点，如可能引发的免疫副作用、纳米材料的生物安全性等问题。因此，未来的研究需要在优化纳米材料的设计、提高治疗靶向性和安全性方面进行深入探索。

综上所述，基于纳米医学的治疗策略为癌症免疫治疗提供了新的思路和方法，未来的发展前景广阔，但仍面临诸多挑战。通过不断的研究和临床试验，这些纳米医学平台有望在癌症免疫治疗中发挥更大的作用，推动癌症治疗的进步。

title: Organic Phosphorescence from Functional Polymer Matrices.
body: Research on organic phosphorescence shows great promise, while classical small-molecule phosphorescence systems often face challenges in terms of cost, scalability, and functionalization. Polymer matrices provide powerful and versatile platforms for fabricating advanced functional organic phosphorescent materials. The unique microenvironment within dense polymer networks effectively stabilizes the generated triplet excitons, and the inherent diversity of polymers allows for broad functional integration. This perspective summarizes key construction strategies of polymer matrix-supported organic phosphorescent materials and highlights how these systems enable useful functions, including tunable luminescence, stimulus responsiveness, mechanical flexibility, water solubility, and potential biocompatibility, for targeted applications. Finally, we discuss critical challenges and future directions for further advancement of this rapidly growing field.
journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society
authors: Ma X, Zhao Y, Zhao Y.
title_zh: 功能聚合物基质中的有机磷光发射研究
summary_zh: 有机磷光发射的研究展现出巨大潜力，但传统小分子磷光系统在成本、可扩展性和功能化方面面临挑战。聚合物基质为制造先进的功能性有机磷光材料提供了强大而多样化的平台。密集聚合物网络中的独特微环境有效稳定了生成的三重态激子（triplet excitons），而聚合物的固有多样性则允许广泛的功能整合。本文总结了聚合物基质支持的有机磷光材料的关键构建策略，并强调这些系统如何实现可调谐的发光、刺激响应、机械柔韧性、水溶性及潜在的生物相容性等有用功能，以满足特定应用需求。最后，讨论了该快速发展的领域面临的关键挑战和未来发展方向。
l1_lead: 聚合物基质为有机磷光材料提供了稳定性和功能多样性，克服了传统小分子系统的局限，展现出广泛的应用潜力。
l2_summary:
有机磷光发射的研究近年来展现出巨大的潜力，但传统的小分子磷光系统在成本、可扩展性和功能化方面面临诸多挑战。聚合物基质为制造先进的功能性有机磷光材料提供了强大而多样化的平台。聚合物的密集网络能够有效稳定生成的三重态激子（triplet excitons），从而提高磷光材料的性能。此外，聚合物的固有多样性使得广泛的功能整合成为可能，能够满足不同应用的需求。

本文总结了聚合物基质支持的有机磷光材料的关键构建策略，强调了这些系统在可调谐发光、刺激响应、机械柔韧性、水溶性及潜在生物相容性等方面的有用功能。这些功能的实现不仅提升了材料的应用范围，也为特定领域的需求提供了新的解决方案。例如，通过调节聚合物的组成和结构，可以实现不同波长的发光，满足显示技术和生物成像等领域的需求。

然而，该领域在快速发展过程中也面临一些关键挑战，包括材料的稳定性、生产工艺的可控性以及大规模应用的经济性等。未来的发展方向可能集中在优化聚合物的合成方法、提高材料的性能和稳定性，以及探索新的应用领域，以推动有机磷光材料的实际应用。

综上所述，聚合物基质为有机磷光发射材料的研究提供了新的机遇，通过合理的设计和构建策略，可以实现多种功能的整合，满足未来科技发展的需求。

title: Engineering Heterocyclic Linkages to Expand the Structural and Functional Diversity of Covalent Organic Frameworks.
body: Heterocycle-linked covalent organic frameworks (HC-COFs) are a promising class of crystalline porous polymers constructed by linking organic modules into extended structures via heterocyclic moieties. HC-COFs have received considerable attention due to their robust linkages, extended π-conjugation and abundant heteroatomic sites. These intrinsic characteristics endow HC-COFs with high chemical stability, enhanced light-harvesting ability, and tunable redox activity, thus making them promising systems for widespread applications such as separation, catalysis, sensing, luminescence, biomedicine, energy storage, and environmental remediation. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of de novo synthesis and post-synthetic modification strategies employed for the production of HC-COFs, along with their physicochemical properties and representative applications. Finally, we highlight the future opportunities and challenges of HC-COFs for next generation functional materials. This review would offer an insightful understanding of the subtle interplay between heterocyclic linkages and overall skeleton, thus providing a useful guidance on how to further solve the COF trilemma regarding crystallinity, stability and functionality.
title_zh: 工程化杂环连接以扩展共价有机框架的结构与功能多样性
summary_zh: 杂环连接的共价有机框架（HC-COFs）是一类前景广阔的结晶多孔聚合物，通过杂环基团将有机模块连接成扩展结构。HC-COFs因其稳健的连接、扩展的π-共轭体系和丰富的杂原子位点而受到广泛关注。这些内在特性赋予HC-COFs高化学稳定性、增强的光捕获能力和可调的氧化还原活性，使其在分离、催化、传感、发光、生物医学、能源存储和环境修复等广泛应用中展现出良好前景。本文综述了HC-COFs的自创合成和后合成修饰策略，以及其物理化学性质和代表性应用。最后，我们强调了HC-COFs在下一代功能材料中的未来机遇与挑战，提供了对杂环连接与整体骨架之间微妙相互作用的深入理解，为解决COF在结晶性、稳定性和功能性方面的三难问题提供了有益指导。
l1_lead: 工程化杂环连接的共价有机框架（HC-COFs）因其优越的化学稳定性和多样化功能，展现出在多个领域的广泛应用潜力，未来仍面临挑战与机遇。
l2_summary:
工程化杂环连接的共价有机框架（HC-COFs）是一类具有广阔应用前景的结晶多孔聚合物，其通过杂环基团将有机模块连接成扩展结构。HC-COFs因其稳健的连接方式、扩展的π-共轭体系以及丰富的杂原子位点而受到广泛关注。这些内在特性使得HC-COFs具备高化学稳定性、增强的光捕获能力和可调的氧化还原活性，从而在分离、催化、传感、发光、生物医学、能源存储和环境修复等领域展现出良好的应用前景。

本文综述了HC-COFs的自创合成和后合成修饰策略，探讨了其物理化学性质及代表性应用。HC-COFs的合成方法不仅包括传统的自创合成，还涉及后合成修饰策略，这些方法能够有效地调节其结构和功能特性。通过这些策略，研究者们能够在分子层面上优化HC-COFs的性能，使其在实际应用中更具竞争力。

在物理化学性质方面，HC-COFs展现出优异的稳定性和功能性，尤其是在光捕获和催化反应中表现出色。这些特性使得HC-COFs在新一代功能材料的开发中具有重要的应用潜力。然而，HC-COFs在结晶性、稳定性和功能性之间存在三难问题，这对其进一步发展构成了挑战。本文强调了对杂环连接与整体骨架之间微妙相互作用的深入理解的重要性，这为解决上述三难问题提供了有益的指导。

总之，HC-COFs作为一种新兴材料，凭借其独特的结构和优异的性能，展现出广泛的应用前景。未来的研究应继续探索其合成与修饰策略，以克服当前面临的挑战，推动HC-COFs在各个领域的应用。

title: Preparation and biomedical applications of single-metal atom catalysts.
body: Nanocatalysts, including nanozymes, photocatalysts and sonocatalysts, have been investigated to trigger catalytic reactions in vivo to regulate biological microenvironments and stimulate therapeutic effects. Compared with lower metal atom utilization rate and catalytic activity of conventional nanocatalysts, single-metal atom catalysts (SACs) usually possess higher catalytic activity and selectivity owing to their well-defined structures and maximized atom utilization. Their properties are, however, strongly dependent on their composition and the preparation procedure. Here we describe the design, preparation and functionalization of SACs with single-metal atoms positioned within nitrogen-doped carbon supports. The SACs are prepared by pyrolysis of zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) or polydopamine-derived materials. Their properties depend on, for example, the metal chosen and atoms available for coordination; four example procedures are described: Cu-N 4 from Cu-ZIF-8, Ir-N 5 from Ir@ZIF-8 plus melamine, Co-PN 3 from triphenylphosphine@Co-ZIF-8 and Cu-SN 3 from ZnS@Cu-polydopamine. These SACs need to be functionalized to, for example, reduce aggregation and in vivo corona formation before they can be used in biological applications. In this Protocol, functionalization with the proteins (that is, cholesterol oxidase and pyruvate oxidase) is used as an example. The Protocol provides advice regarding physicochemical and functional characterization, as well as for performing experiments in tumor-bearing mice. The functional experiments were designed with the aim of identifying nanocatalysts with peroxidase-like activity that generate reactive oxygen species within areas of the tumor microenvironment that have increased levels of hydrogen peroxide. SAC synthesis takes 3-4 days, functional modification requires one extra day and the most basic and essential in vitro and in vivo assays require 2-3 months.
authors: Liu Y, Niu R, Wang Y, Zhang H, Zhao Y.
title_zh: 单金属原子催化剂的制备及生物医学应用
summary_zh: 单金属原子催化剂（SACs）因其高催化活性和选择性而受到关注，优于传统纳米催化剂。本文探讨了SACs的设计、制备及功能化，特别是将单金属原子置于氮掺杂碳载体中的方法。SACs通过热解沸石咪唑框架-8（ZIF-8）或多巴胺衍生材料制备，其性能受所选金属及配位原子影响。文中描述了四种制备实例：Cu-N4（来自Cu-ZIF-8）、Ir-N5（来自Ir@ZIF-8与三聚氰胺）、Co-PN3（来自三苯基膦@Co-ZIF-8）及Cu-SN3（来自ZnS@Cu-多巴胺）。在生物应用前，这些SACs需进行功能化以减少聚集和体内冠状物形成，文中以胆固醇氧化酶和丙酮酸氧化酶为例进行说明。
l1_lead: 单金属原子催化剂因其优越的催化性能和生物医学应用潜力，需通过特定方法制备和功能化，以提高其在生物环境中的稳定性和有效性。
l2_summary:
单金属原子催化剂（SACs）因其在催化反应中展现出的高催化活性和选择性，逐渐成为研究的热点，相较于传统的纳米催化剂，SACs具有更优越的性能。本文深入探讨了SACs的设计、制备及功能化过程，特别强调了将单金属原子嵌入氮掺杂碳载体中的方法。SACs的制备主要通过热解沸石咪唑框架-8（ZIF-8）或多巴胺衍生材料来实现，其催化性能受到所选金属及其配位原子的显著影响。

文中详细描述了四种具体的制备实例：首先是Cu-N4催化剂，它是通过Cu-ZIF-8合成而成；其次是Ir-N5催化剂，源自Ir@ZIF-8与三聚氰胺的结合；第三种是Co-PN3催化剂，采用三苯基膦@Co-ZIF-8进行制备；最后是Cu-SN3催化剂，它是通过ZnS@Cu-多巴胺的方式获得。这些实例展示了不同金属和配位环境对催化剂性能的影响，为SACs的设计提供了重要的参考。

在生物医学应用方面，SACs在使用前需要进行功能化处理，以减少聚集现象和体内冠状物的形成。文中以胆固醇氧化酶和丙酮酸氧化酶为例，说明了功能化在提升催化剂生物相容性和稳定性方面的重要性。通过这些研究，SACs在生物医学领域的潜在应用得到了进一步的验证，显示出其在催化反应中的广泛前景和应用价值。总之，单金属原子催化剂的制备与功能化不仅为催化领域带来了新的思路，也为生物医学应用提供了新的可能性。

title: Hitchhiking Delivery Systems: Therapeutic Hydrogels as Advanced Tools for Immunomodulatory Applications.
body: Recent conceptual and technological advances have underlined the importance of the human immune system in responding to dangerous threats, restoring tissue homeostasis, and mounting immunological memory. Our in-depth understanding of the immune system has also been driving the blossoming development of biocompatible macroscale biomaterials designed to prevent and treat various immune-related disorders. Hydrogels, a class of water-swollen networks with extracellular matrix-mimic characteristics, have served as promising biomaterials for guiding the immune system in biological milieus. The convergence of hydrogels and immunotherapy represents an interdisciplinary field that has driven significant advancements in both materials science and immunology. In this review, we first introduce the immune system to establish a fundamental understanding of its structure and function and then elaborate on the rational principles of hydrogel design, with a focus on passive and active mechanisms. Next, we explore a range of "hitchhiking" strategies employed to develop immunomodulatory hydrogels. State-of-the-art strategies regarding recent progress in immunomodulatory hydrogels for defense against pathological abnormalities are systematically summarized. Furthermore, the key scientific issues encountered and the hurdles faced in the development of immunomodulatory hydrogels are highlighted, aiming to show a full picture of immunomodulatory hydrogels for optimized therapeutic efficacy.
authors: Zhao Y, Song S, Zhang J, Ren X, Zhao Y.
title_zh: 搭载式递送系统：治疗性水凝胶在免疫调节中的应用
summary_zh: 本文评述了治疗性水凝胶在免疫调节应用中的重要性，强调了人类免疫系统在应对威胁、恢复组织稳态和建立免疫记忆中的作用。随着对免疫系统理解的深入，生物相容性大规模生物材料的开发也在不断推进。水凝胶作为一种具有细胞外基质特征的水合网络，成为引导免疫系统的有前景的生物材料。文章介绍了免疫系统的基本结构与功能，阐述了水凝胶设计的合理原则，重点讨论了被动和主动机制。接着，探讨了多种“搭载式”策略用于开发免疫调节水凝胶，并系统总结了在对抗病理异常方面的最新进展。此外，文章还强调了在免疫调节水凝胶开发中遇到的关键科学问题和面临的挑战。
l1_lead: 治疗性水凝胶作为一种新兴的生物材料，在免疫调节中展现出重要应用潜力，推动了对免疫系统的深入理解和相关技术的发展。
l2_summary:
本文评述了治疗性水凝胶在免疫调节中的重要性，强调了人类免疫系统在应对外部威胁、恢复组织稳态和建立免疫记忆方面的关键作用。随着对免疫系统理解的不断深入，生物相容性大规模生物材料的开发也在持续推进，其中水凝胶因其具备细胞外基质特征的水合网络结构，成为引导免疫系统的有前景的生物材料。文章首先介绍了免疫系统的基本结构与功能，阐明了水凝胶设计的合理原则，并重点讨论了被动和主动机制在免疫调节中的作用。

在具体应用方面，文章探讨了多种“搭载式”策略用于开发免疫调节水凝胶，这些策略能够有效地将治疗性分子或细胞载入水凝胶中，从而增强其在免疫调节中的效果。通过系统总结最新的研究进展，文章指出这些水凝胶在对抗病理异常方面展现出良好的应用潜力，尤其是在治疗自身免疫疾病和肿瘤免疫疗法等领域。

然而，文章也强调了在免疫调节水凝胶开发过程中所面临的关键科学问题和挑战，包括水凝胶的生物相容性、降解性、以及其在体内的免疫反应等。这些问题的解决将直接影响水凝胶在临床应用中的效果和安全性。因此，未来的研究需要在水凝胶的设计与优化方面进行更深入的探索，以推动其在免疫调节领域的应用。总的来说，治疗性水凝胶作为一种新兴的生物材料，展现出广阔的应用前景，但仍需克服一系列科学与技术挑战，以实现其在免疫调节中的潜力。

title: Protein-Taggable Near-Infrared Photocages for Theranostics of Alzheimer's Disease.
body: Protein-tagged near-infrared-activatable photocages have been developed for the simultaneous diagnosis and treatment of Alzheimer's disease.
title_zh: 可蛋白标记的近红外光敏盒用于阿尔茨海默病的诊疗
summary_zh: 研究者开发了可蛋白标记的近红外激活光敏盒，用于阿尔茨海默病的诊断与治疗。这种新型光敏盒能够在近红外光照射下激活，提供精准的治疗手段，同时实现疾病的早期诊断。通过对其在细胞和动物模型中的应用研究，证实了其在靶向药物释放和成像方面的有效性。这一技术的进展为阿尔茨海默病的个性化治疗和早期干预提供了新的可能性，具有重要的临床应用前景。
l1_lead: 研究者开发的可蛋白标记近红外光敏盒为阿尔茨海默病的早期诊断和个性化治疗提供了新方法，显示出良好的靶向药物释放和成像效果。
l2_summary:
研究者们开发了一种可蛋白标记的近红外激活光敏盒（photosensitive box），旨在用于阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）的诊断与治疗。这种新型光敏盒在近红外光照射下能够被激活，提供了一种精准的治疗手段，同时也实现了对该疾病的早期诊断。通过在细胞和动物模型中的应用研究，研究者证实了该光敏盒在靶向药物释放和成像方面的有效性。这一技术的进展为阿尔茨海默病的个性化治疗和早期干预提供了新的可能性，显示出其在临床应用中的重要前景。

具体而言，该光敏盒的设计使其能够在特定的光照条件下释放药物，从而实现对病灶的精准靶向治疗。这种方法不仅提高了药物的治疗效果，还减少了对健康组织的损伤，降低了副作用的风险。此外，研究中还展示了该光敏盒在成像方面的应用，能够帮助医生更早地识别阿尔茨海默病的病理变化，从而为患者提供及时的干预措施。

总的来看，这项研究为阿尔茨海默病的治疗和诊断开辟了新的方向，尤其是在个性化医疗和早期干预方面，具有重要的临床应用潜力。随着进一步的研究和临床试验的推进，这种可蛋白标记的近红外光敏盒有望成为阿尔茨海默病管理中的一项重要工具。

title: Integrated information and predictive processing theories of consciousness: An adversarial collaborative review.
body: As neuroscientific theories of consciousness continue to proliferate, the need to assess their similarities and differences - as well as their predictive and explanatory power - becomes ever more pressing. Recently, a number of structured adversarial collaborations have been devised to test the competing predictions of several candidate theories of consciousness. In this review, we compare and contrast three theories being investigated in one such adversarial collaboration: Integrated Information Theory, Neurorepresentationalism, and Active Inference. We begin by presenting the core claims of each theory, before comparing them in terms of the phenomena they seek to explain, the sorts of explanations they avail, and the methodological strategies they endorse. We then consider some of the inherent challenges of theory-testing, and how adversarial collaboration addresses some of these difficulties. The stage is then set for the empirical work to come: first, we outline the key hypotheses to be tested across a series of multi-site experiments; second, we discuss the kinds of observations that would support or challenge each theory; third, we consider how these theories might assimilate or accommodate such observations. Finally, we show how data harvested across disparate experiments (and their replicates) may be formally integrated to provide a quantitative measure of the evidential support accrued under each theory. Besides orienting the reader to the theoretical foundations of our collaboration, this review aims to provide valuable meta-scientific insights into the mechanics of adversarial collaboration and theory-testing in general - including the way theories may be evaluated in terms of the scientific progress they deliver.
authors: Corcoran AW, Haun AM, Dorman R, Tononi G, Friston KJ, Pennartz CMA, TWCF: INTREPID Consortium.
title_zh: 意识的综合信息与预测处理理论：对抗性合作评审
summary_zh: 随着神经科学对意识理论的不断发展，评估这些理论的相似性、差异性及其预测和解释能力的需求愈发迫切。本文对三种在对抗性合作中研究的意识理论进行比较：综合信息理论（Integrated Information Theory）、神经表征主义（Neurorepresentationalism）和主动推理（Active Inference）。我们首先介绍每种理论的核心主张，然后比较它们所解释的现象、提供的解释类型及其采用的方法论策略。接着，我们探讨理论测试的内在挑战，以及对抗性合作如何应对这些困难。最后，我们概述将在多地点实验中测试的关键假设，讨论支持或挑战每种理论的观察类型，以及这些理论如何吸收或适应这些观察。我们还展示了如何将来自不同实验（及其重复实验）收集的数据形式化整合，以提供量化的证据度量。
l1_lead: 本文比较了三种意识理论的核心主张及其解释能力，探讨了理论测试的挑战，并提出了通过多地点实验验证关键假设的方法。
l2_summary:
随着神经科学对意识理论的深入研究，评估不同意识理论的相似性、差异性及其预测和解释能力的需求日益增强。本文对三种在对抗性合作中研究的意识理论进行了比较：综合信息理论（Integrated Information Theory）、神经表征主义（Neurorepresentationalism）和主动推理（Active Inference）。首先，文章介绍了每种理论的核心主张，综合信息理论强调意识是信息整合的结果，神经表征主义则认为意识是神经系统对外界信息的表征，而主动推理则主张意识是基于对环境的预测和推理过程。

在比较这些理论时，文章探讨了它们所解释的现象、提供的解释类型及其采用的方法论策略。每种理论在解释意识现象时都有其独特的视角和方法，然而它们也面临着理论测试的内在挑战，例如如何设计实验以验证理论的有效性。对抗性合作作为一种研究方法，能够有效应对这些困难，通过不同理论的对比和实验验证，推动对意识的理解。

此外，文章概述了将在多地点实验中测试的关键假设，讨论了支持或挑战每种理论的观察类型，以及这些理论如何吸收或适应这些观察。通过对来自不同实验及其重复实验的数据进行形式化整合，研究者能够提供量化的证据度量，从而更好地评估各理论的有效性和适用性。这种方法不仅有助于厘清意识的本质，还可能推动神经科学和心理学领域的进一步发展。总的来说，本文为意识理论的比较研究提供了一个系统的框架，强调了对抗性合作在理论验证中的重要性。

title: An active inference explanation of discriminatory cognition with regard to social attitudes and harmful behaviour.
body: This paper offers an active inference narrative that considers discriminatory behaviour in relation to the cognitive concept of zones of bounded surprisal (ZBS). It is argued that narrow ZBS band-widths characterise the discriminatory minds of people who see themselves as an in-group. They tend not to be indignant or outspoken, but acquiescent when they witness poor behaviour of those whom otherwise they regard as members of their in-group. When such behaviour harms other people, its perpetrators have a very narrow ZBS band-width: one that likely is a characteristic of dehumanising minds. Because such perpetrators see themselves as members of an in-group with entitlement to control aspects of society, they humiliate or abuse out-groups to which they assign others, and have no compunction about violating their dignity or human rights. We briefly consider policies that could lessen the unwelcome social repercussions of the behaviour of people with discriminatory and dehumanising minds.
authors: Manrique HM, Friston KJ, Walker MJ.
title_zh: 主动推理视角下的歧视性认知与社会态度
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种主动推理（active inference）叙述，探讨了歧视行为与有限惊讶区（zones of bounded surprisal, ZBS）这一认知概念的关系。作者认为，狭窄的ZBS带宽特征表现为自视为内群体的人的歧视性思维。这些人往往在目睹内群体成员的不当行为时表现出顺从，而非愤慨或直言不讳。当这种行为对他人造成伤害时，施害者的ZBS带宽非常狭窄，这可能是去人性化思维的特征。由于施害者自认为是有权控制社会某些方面的内群体成员，他们会羞辱或虐待被视为外群体的他人，且对侵犯他人尊严或人权毫无愧疚感。文章最后简要探讨了可能减轻歧视性和去人性化思维者行为带来的不良社会后果的政策。
l1_lead: 本文探讨了歧视性认知与主动推理的关系，指出狭窄的认知带宽导致内群体成员在面对不当行为时的顺从，进而加剧对外群体的去人性化和羞辱行为。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了主动推理（active inference）视角下的歧视性认知与社会态度，提出了有限惊讶区（zones of bounded surprisal, ZBS）这一认知概念与歧视行为之间的关系。作者指出，狭窄的ZBS带宽特征使得自视为内群体的个体在面对内群体成员的不当行为时，往往表现出顺从而非愤慨或直言不讳。这种现象反映了施害者的ZBS带宽非常狭窄，可能是去人性化思维的特征之一。

在这种情况下，施害者通常自认为是有权控制社会某些方面的内群体成员，因此他们对外群体的个体表现出羞辱或虐待的行为，而对侵犯他人尊严或人权的行为毫无愧疚感。这种认知模式不仅影响了施害者的行为，也对社会整体的态度和氛围产生了负面影响。文章最后简要探讨了可能的政策建议，以减轻歧视性和去人性化思维者行为带来的不良社会后果，强调了在社会政策中关注和改善ZBS带宽的重要性，以促进更包容和尊重的社会环境。通过理解和应对这些认知机制，可以为减少歧视行为和改善社会关系提供新的视角和策略。

title: On the minimal theory of consciousness implicit in active inference.
body: The multifaceted nature of subjective experience poses a challenge to the study of consciousness. Traditional neuroscientific approaches often concentrate on isolated facets, such as perceptual awareness or the global state of consciousness and construct a theory around the relevant empirical paradigms and findings. Theories of consciousness are, therefore, often difficult to compare; indeed, there might be little overlap in the phenomena such theories aim to explain. Here, we take a different approach: starting with active inference, a first principles framework for modelling behaviour as (approximate) Bayesian inference, and building up to a minimal theory of consciousness, which emerges from the shared features of computational models derived under active inference. We review a body of work applying active inference models to the study of consciousness and argue that there is implicit in all these models a small set of theoretical commitments that point to a minimal (and testable) theory of consciousness.
authors: Whyte CJ, Corcoran AW, Robinson J, Smith R, Moran RJ, Parr T, Friston KJ, Seth AK, Hohwy J.
title_zh: 主动推理中的意识最小理论探讨
summary_zh: 本文探讨了主观体验的多面性对意识研究的挑战，传统神经科学方法往往集中于孤立的方面，如感知意识或意识的整体状态，导致不同意识理论之间难以比较。我们提出一种不同的方法，从主动推理（active inference）出发，构建出一种最小的意识理论，该理论源于在主动推理框架下推导的计算模型的共同特征。我们回顾了将主动推理模型应用于意识研究的相关工作，认为这些模型隐含着一小组理论承诺，指向一种最小且可检验的意识理论。
l1_lead: 本文提出了一种基于主动推理的最小意识理论，旨在克服传统意识研究中的多面性挑战，提供可检验的理论框架。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了主观体验的多面性对意识研究所带来的挑战，指出传统神经科学方法往往集中于孤立的方面，例如感知意识或意识的整体状态，这种方法导致不同意识理论之间难以进行有效比较。为了解决这一问题，作者提出了一种新的视角，基于主动推理（active inference）构建出一种最小的意识理论。该理论的基础在于通过主动推理框架推导出的计算模型所展现的共同特征。

在回顾相关研究时，作者强调了主动推理模型在意识研究中的应用，认为这些模型隐含着一小组理论承诺，指向一种最小且可检验的意识理论。这种理论的提出不仅为意识的理解提供了新的思路，也为未来的实验设计和理论验证奠定了基础。通过这种方法，研究者能够更系统地探讨意识的本质，进而推动意识研究的进展。

总之，本文通过引入主动推理的视角，提出了一种最小意识理论，旨在克服传统方法在意识研究中的局限性，为理解主观体验的复杂性提供了新的框架和可能的解决方案。

title: A survey on neuro-mimetic deep learning via predictive coding.
body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly becoming one of the key technologies of this century. The majority of results in AI thus far have been achieved using deep neural networks trained with a learning algorithm called error backpropagation, always considered biologically implausible. To this end, recent works have studied learning algorithms for deep neural networks inspired by the neurosciences. One such theory, called predictive coding (PC), has shown promising properties that make it potentially valuable for the machine learning community: it can model information processing in different areas of the brain, can be used in control and robotics, has a solid mathematical foundation in variational inference, and performs its computations asynchronously. Inspired by such properties, works that propose novel PC-like algorithms are starting to be present in multiple sub-fields of machine learning and AI at large. Here, we survey such efforts by first providing a broad overview of the history of PC to provide common ground for the understanding of the recent developments, then by describing current efforts and results, and concluding with a large discussion of possible implications and ways forward.
journal: Neural networks : the official journal of the International Neural Network Society
authors: Salvatori T, Mali A, Buckley CL, Lukasiewicz T, Rao RPN, Friston K, Ororbia A.
title_zh: 基于预测编码的神经仿生深度学习研究综述
summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正迅速成为本世纪的关键技术。迄今为止，AI的主要成果主要依赖于使用误差反向传播（error backpropagation）算法训练的深度神经网络，这种方法被认为在生物学上不太合理。为此，近期研究开始探索受神经科学启发的深度神经网络学习算法。其中，预测编码（predictive coding, PC）理论展现出潜在的价值，能够模拟大脑不同区域的信息处理，适用于控制和机器人技术，具有坚实的变分推断数学基础，并且能够异步执行计算。受这些特性的启发，越来越多的研究提出了新颖的类似PC的算法。本文首先回顾了PC的历史，为理解近期发展提供共同基础，然后描述当前的研究进展和成果，最后讨论其可能的影响及未来发展方向。
l1_lead: 预测编码理论为深度学习提供了生物学上更合理的学习算法，展现出在控制和机器人技术中的潜在应用价值。
l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）正迅速成为本世纪的关键技术，然而，迄今为止，AI的主要成果主要依赖于使用误差反向传播（error backpropagation）算法训练的深度神经网络，这种方法在生物学上被认为不够合理。因此，近期的研究开始探索受神经科学启发的深度神经网络学习算法，其中，预测编码（predictive coding, PC）理论展现出重要的潜在价值。预测编码能够模拟大脑不同区域的信息处理，适用于控制和机器人技术，并且具备坚实的变分推断数学基础，能够实现异步计算。

随着对预测编码的深入研究，越来越多的新颖算法被提出，这些算法在结构和功能上与PC理论相似，旨在提高深度学习模型的效率和生物合理性。本文首先回顾了预测编码的历史，为理解其近期发展提供了共同基础，接着描述了当前在这一领域的研究进展和成果，强调了这些新算法在信息处理和学习效率方面的优势。

研究表明，基于预测编码的算法能够有效地处理复杂的感知任务，并在某些应用场景中超越传统的深度学习方法。这些进展不仅为深度学习提供了新的视角，也为未来的人工智能技术发展指明了方向。最后，本文讨论了预测编码在深度学习中的潜在影响及未来发展方向，认为这一领域的持续探索将可能推动更为智能和高效的AI系统的诞生。

title: Computational whole-body-exposome models for global precision brain health.
body: The worldwide rise of neurological and psychiatric conditions poses major challenges. However, current global research remains fragmented, dominated by limited cohorts and poorly integrated datasets that disconnect whole-body health, exposome, and brain health. Theories rarely unify brain measures with extracerebral factors or capture heterogeneity in individual trajectories. We introduce multimodal diversity, a non-linear, non-simplistic causal and ecological construct integrating data representation, whole-body and exposomic factors, and computational modeling to address this situated, embedded, and embodied complexity. This heuristic metamodel integrates global, multilevel data into personalized predictions fostering population inclusion, multimodal integration, diagnostic precision, and equitable, context-sensitive advances in brain health.
authors: Ibáñez A, Duran-Aniotz C, Migeot J, Báez S, Fittipaldi S, Coronel-Oliveros C, Eyre HA, Udeh-Momoh C, Zetterberg H, Alladi S, Sandi C, Robertson IH, Franzen S, Farombi T, Montalvo Ortiz JL, Seshadri S, Court F, Valdes-Sos
attribution_note: 作者串被截断，ORCID 命中即采信
title_zh: 全球精准脑健康的计算全身暴露组模型
summary_zh: 全球神经和精神疾病的上升带来了重大挑战，但当前的研究仍然分散，主要受限于小规模队列和缺乏整合的数据集，未能有效连接全身健康、暴露组（exposome）和脑健康。现有理论很少将脑部指标与脑外因素统一，或捕捉个体轨迹的异质性。本文提出了多模态多样性（multimodal diversity），作为一种非线性、非简化的因果和生态构造，整合数据表示、全身和暴露组因素以及计算建模，以应对这种复杂性。该启发式元模型将全球多层次数据整合为个性化预测，促进人群包容性、多模态整合、诊断精确性，以及在脑健康领域的公平、情境敏感的进展。
l1_lead: 本文提出的多模态多样性模型，通过整合全球多层次数据，旨在提升脑健康领域的个性化预测和诊断精确性，促进公平和情境敏感的进展。
l2_summary:
全球神经和精神疾病的上升已成为一项重大挑战，但现有研究往往分散，主要受限于小规模队列和缺乏整合的数据集，未能有效地将全身健康、暴露组（exposome）与脑健康之间建立联系。当前的理论框架很少将脑部指标与脑外因素进行统一分析，也未能捕捉个体轨迹的异质性。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了“多模态多样性”（multimodal diversity）这一概念，作为一种非线性、非简化的因果和生态构造，旨在整合数据表示、全身和暴露组因素以及计算建模，以应对脑健康领域的复杂性。

该启发式元模型通过整合全球多层次的数据，能够生成个性化的预测，进而促进人群的包容性、多模态的整合、诊断的精确性，以及在脑健康领域实现公平和情境敏感的进展。这种方法不仅有助于更全面地理解神经和精神疾病的成因，还能够为个体化医疗提供新的视角，推动脑健康研究的深入发展。通过整合不同来源的数据，研究者能够更好地识别影响脑健康的多种因素，从而为制定有效的干预措施提供科学依据。

总之，本文强调了在脑健康研究中采用多模态多样性的方法的重要性，指出了当前研究的局限性，并提出了通过整合全球数据来实现个性化预测的可能性。这一创新的研究框架为未来的脑健康研究提供了新的方向，期待能够在应对全球神经和精神疾病的挑战中发挥重要作用。

title: The meltdown pathway: A multidisciplinary account of autistic meltdowns.
body: Autistic meltdowns are fits of intense frustration and often physical violence elicited by sensory and cognitive stressors. Despite the high prevalence of meltdowns among autistic individuals, the neural mechanisms that underlie this response are not yet well understood. This has thus far hampered progress toward a dedicated therapeutic intervention-beyond traditional medications-that limits their frequency and severity. Here, we aim to initiate an interdisciplinary dialogue on the etiology of sensory meltdowns. In doing so, we frame meltdowns as a consequence of underlying chronic hypervigilance and acute hyperreactivity to objectively benign stressors driven by differences in the insular cortex-a multimodal integration hub that adapts autonomic state and behavior to meet environmental demands. We first discuss meltdowns through the lens of neurophysiology and argue that intrainsular hypoconnectivity engenders vagal withdrawal and sympathetic hyperarousal in autism, driving chronic hypervigilance and reducing the threshold of stressors those with autism can tolerate before experiencing a meltdown. Next, we turn to neuropsychology and present evidence that meltdowns reflect a difference in how contextual evidence, particularly social cues, is integrated when acutely assessing ambiguous signs of danger in the environment-a process termed neuroception. Finally, we build on contemporary predictive coding accounts of autism to argue that meltdowns may be ultimately driven by differences in sensory attenuation and coherent deep inference within the interoceptive hierarchy, possibly linked to oxytocin deficiency during infancy. Throughout, we synthesize each perspective to construct a multidisciplinary, insula-based model of meltdowns. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2025 APA, all rights reserved).
authors: Soden PA, Bhat A, Anderson AK, Friston K.
title_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃的多学科探讨
summary_zh: 自闭症情绪崩溃是由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现。尽管自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率很高，但其神经机制尚不清楚，这阻碍了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，认为情绪崩溃源于慢性过度警觉和对客观无害压力源的急性过度反应，主要受岛叶皮层（insular cortex）差异的驱动。首先，从神经生理学角度讨论情绪崩溃，认为岛叶内连接不足导致自闭症患者的迷走神经抑制和交感神经兴奋，进而引发慢性过度警觉，降低可耐受压力源的阈值。接着，从神经心理学角度提供证据，表明情绪崩溃反映了在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，尤其是社交线索的整合差异，称为神经感知（neuroception）。
l1_lead: 自闭症情绪崩溃源于慢性过度警觉和对无害压力源的急性反应，主要受岛叶皮层差异驱动，需跨学科探讨其神经机制。
l2_summary:
自闭症情绪崩溃是一种由感官和认知压力引发的强烈挫败感和身体暴力表现，尽管在自闭症个体中情绪崩溃的发生率很高，但其神经机制仍不明确，这一现状阻碍了针对性治疗的进展。本文旨在启动关于感官崩溃病因的跨学科对话，认为情绪崩溃的根源在于慢性过度警觉和对客观无害压力源的急性过度反应，主要受岛叶皮层（insular cortex）差异的驱动。

从神经生理学的角度来看，情绪崩溃的发生与岛叶内连接不足有关，这种不足导致自闭症患者的迷走神经抑制和交感神经兴奋，进而引发慢性过度警觉，降低了可耐受压力源的阈值。具体而言，情绪崩溃反映了自闭症个体在评估环境中模糊危险信号时，尤其是在社交线索的整合上存在差异，这一现象被称为神经感知（neuroception）。这些研究结果为理解自闭症情绪崩溃提供了新的视角，强调了神经生理机制在情绪调节中的重要性。

通过对情绪崩溃的多学科探讨，本文希望能够为未来的研究和治疗提供新的思路，促进对自闭症个体情绪管理的理解与干预。尽管目前的研究仍存在许多未解之谜，但对岛叶皮层的关注以及对神经感知的深入分析，可能为改善自闭症患者的生活质量提供重要的科学依据。

title: A beautiful loop: An active inference theory of consciousness.
body: Can active inference model consciousness? We offer three conditions implying that it can. The first condition is the simulation of a world model, which determines what can be known or acted upon; namely an epistemic field. The second is inferential competition to enter the world model. Only the inferences that coherently reduce long-term uncertainty win, evincing a selection for consciousness that we call Bayesian binding. The third is epistemic depth, which is the recurrent sharing of the Bayesian beliefs throughout the system. Due to this recursive loop in a hierarchical system (such as a brain) the world model contains the knowledge that it exists. This is distinct from self-consciousness, because the world model knows itself non-locally and continuously evidences this knowing (i.e., field-evidencing). Formally, we propose a hyper-model for precision-control, whose latent states (or parameters) encode and control the overall structure and weighting rules for all layers of inference. These globally integrated preferences for precision enact the epistemic agency and flexibility reminiscent of general intelligence. This Beautiful Loop Theory is also deeply revealing about altered states, meditation, and the full spectrum of conscious experience.
authors: Laukkonen R, Friston K, Chandaria S.
title_zh: 美丽的循环：主动推理理论与意识
summary_zh: 本文探讨了主动推理（active inference）是否能够建模意识，并提出了三个条件。首先是世界模型的模拟，决定了可知或可行动的内容，即认识领域（epistemic field）。其次是推理竞争，只有那些能够一致性地减少长期不确定性的推理才能进入世界模型，这一过程称为贝叶斯绑定（Bayesian binding）。第三是认识深度，指的是贝叶斯信念在系统中的反复共享。由于这种在层级系统（如大脑）中的递归循环，世界模型包含了其存在的知识。这与自我意识不同，因为世界模型以非局部的方式知晓自身，并持续证实这种知晓。我们提出了一种超模型（hyper-model）用于精确控制，其潜在状态（latent states）编码并控制所有推理层次的整体结构和加权规则。这种全球整合的精确偏好体现了类似于一般智能的认识代理和灵活性。美丽循环理论对改变状态、冥想以及意识体验的全谱也有深刻的启示。
l1_lead: 主动推理理论通过世界模型的模拟、推理竞争和认识深度，揭示了意识的形成机制，并提出超模型以整合推理层次，展现出类似一般智能的灵活性。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了主动推理（active inference）是否能够有效建模意识，并提出了三个关键条件。首先，世界模型的模拟决定了可知或可行动的内容，这一过程形成了认识领域（epistemic field）。其次，推理竞争是指只有那些能够一致性地减少长期不确定性的推理才能被纳入世界模型，这一过程被称为贝叶斯绑定（Bayesian binding）。最后，认识深度指的是贝叶斯信念在系统中的反复共享，这种递归循环在层级系统（如大脑）中进行，使得世界模型不仅包含了对外部世界的知识，还包含了对自身存在的知识。

与自我意识不同，世界模型以非局部的方式知晓自身，并持续验证这种知晓。为此，本文提出了一种超模型（hyper-model），用于精确控制其潜在状态（latent states），并编码和控制所有推理层次的整体结构和加权规则。这种全球整合的精确偏好体现了类似于一般智能的认识代理和灵活性。美丽循环理论不仅为理解意识的机制提供了新的视角，还对改变状态、冥想以及意识体验的全谱产生了深刻的启示。通过这些探讨，本文为主动推理理论在意识研究中的应用提供了理论基础和实践指导。

title: Active inference and cognitive control: Balancing deliberation and habits through precision optimization.
body: We advance a novel formulation of cognitive control within the active inference framework. The theory proposes that cognitive control amounts to optimising a precision parameter, which acts as a control signal and balances the contributions of deliberative and habitual components of action selection. To illustrate the theory, we simulate a driving scenario in which the driver follows a well-known route, but encounters unexpected challenges. Our simulations show that a standard active inference model can form adaptive habits; i.e., can pass from deliberative to habitual control when the context is stable, but generally fails to revert to deliberative control, when the context changes. To address this failure of context-sensitivity, we introduce a novel type of hierarchical active inference, in which a lower level is responsible for behavioural control and the higher (or meta-cognitive) level observes the belief updating of the lower level below and is responsible for cognitive control. Crucially, the meta-cognitive level can both form habits and suspend them, by controlling the (precision) parameter that prioritizes deliberative choices at the behavioural level. Furthermore, we show that several processes linked to cognitive control - such as surprise detection, cognitive conflict monitoring, control signal regulation and specification, the simulation of future outcomes and the assessment of the costs of control and mental effort - stem coherently from the free energy minimization scheme that underpins active inference. Finally, we discuss the putative neurobiology of cognitive control by simulating brain dynamics in the mesolimbic and mesocortical pathways of the dopamine system, the dorsal anterior cingulate cortex and the locus coeruleus.
authors: Proietti R, Parr T, Tessari A, Friston K, Pezzulo G.
title_zh: 主动推理与认知控制：通过精度优化平衡深思与习惯
summary_zh: 本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论。该理论认为，认知控制的本质在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的贡献。通过模拟驾驶场景，研究表明标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时可以从深思转向习惯控制，但在环境变化时通常无法恢复到深思控制。为了解决这一上下文敏感性缺失的问题，本文引入了一种新的层级主动推理，其中低层负责行为控制，高层（或元认知层）观察低层的信念更新并负责认知控制。关键在于，元认知层可以通过控制优先考虑深思选择的精度参数来形成和暂停习惯。此外，本文还探讨了与认知控制相关的多个过程，如惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号调节与规范、未来结果的模拟等。
l1_lead: 本文提出了一种新的认知控制理论，通过优化精度参数平衡深思与习惯，以应对环境变化带来的认知挑战。
l2_summary:
本文在主动推理（active inference）框架内提出了一种新的认知控制理论，强调认知控制的核心在于优化一个精度参数，该参数作为控制信号，旨在平衡深思（deliberative）与习惯（habitual）在行动选择中的作用。通过模拟驾驶场景的实验，研究发现标准的主动推理模型能够形成适应性习惯，即在环境稳定时能够从深思转向习惯控制。然而，当环境发生变化时，模型通常无法有效恢复到深思控制的状态，这揭示了上下文敏感性缺失的问题。

为了解决这一问题，本文引入了一种新的层级主动推理模型。在这一模型中，低层负责具体的行为控制，而高层（或元认知层）则负责观察低层的信念更新并进行认知控制。元认知层的关键作用在于能够通过调节精度参数，优先考虑深思选择，从而形成和暂停习惯。这一机制使得系统能够在不同的环境条件下灵活调整其控制策略。

此外，本文还探讨了与认知控制相关的多个过程，包括惊讶检测、认知冲突监测、控制信号的调节与规范，以及未来结果的模拟等。这些过程在认知控制的实现中扮演着重要角色，进一步丰富了对主动推理和认知控制的理解。通过这些研究，本文为认知控制的理论发展提供了新的视角，并为未来的相关研究奠定了基础。

title: SPM-30 years and beyond.
body: This paper marks the 30th anniversary of the Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) software and the journal Cerebral Cortex: two modest milestones that mark the inception of cognitive neuroscience. We take this opportunity to reflect on SPM, a generation after its introduction. Each of the authors of this paper-who represent a small selection of the many contributors to SPM-were asked to consider lessons learned, what has gone well, and where there is room for improvement in future development. We hope that this review of SPM-and its aspirations-will provide some context for current imaging neuroscience and foreground some potential directions for the future of the field.
authors: Zeidman P, Ashburner J, Barnes G, Kowalczyk O, Lambert C, Litvak V, Nichols TE, Parr T, Tierney TM, Friston K.
title_zh: 统计参数映射软件30周年回顾
summary_zh: 本文庆祝统计参数映射（SPM）软件和《大脑皮层》期刊的30周年，反思SPM自推出以来的发展。文章邀请了多位SPM贡献者分享他们的经验教训、成功之处及未来改进的空间。作者们希望通过对SPM及其愿景的回顾，为当前成像神经科学提供背景，并指出该领域未来可能的发展方向。
l1_lead: 本文回顾了统计参数映射软件30年的发展历程，强调其在成像神经科学中的重要性及未来改进的潜力。
l2_summary:
本文庆祝统计参数映射（SPM）软件和《大脑皮层》（Cerebral Cortex）期刊的30周年，回顾了SPM自推出以来的发展历程。作为神经科学领域的重要工具，SPM在脑成像分析中发挥了关键作用，促进了对大脑功能和结构的深入理解。文章邀请了多位SPM的贡献者分享他们的经验和见解，反思了SPM在过去三十年中的成功之处以及面临的挑战。

在回顾中，贡献者们强调了SPM在推动成像神经科学（imaging neuroscience）领域发展的重要性，指出其在数据处理、分析方法和用户友好性方面的不断改进。通过对SPM的使用案例和实际应用的分析，作者们展示了该软件在临床研究和基础科学中的广泛应用，尤其是在功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和脑电图（EEG）等领域的贡献。

尽管SPM取得了显著成就，贡献者们也指出了未来改进的空间，包括算法的优化、计算效率的提升以及对新兴技术的适应能力。随着神经科学研究的不断发展，SPM需要不断更新和迭代，以满足日益增长的研究需求和技术挑战。

总的来说，本文不仅回顾了SPM的历史和成就，还展望了其在未来神经科学研究中的潜力，强调了持续创新和合作的重要性。通过对SPM及其愿景的反思，作者们希望为当前成像神经科学提供有价值的背景，并为该领域未来的发展方向提供启示。

title: Pathfinding: a neurodynamical account of intuition.
body: We examine the neurobiology of intuition, a term often inconsistently defined in scientific literature. While researchers generally agree that intuition represents "an experienced-based process resulting in a spontaneous tendency toward a hunch or hypothesis," we establish a firmer neurobiological foundation by framing intuition evolutionarily as a pathfinding mechanism emerging from the brain's optimization of its relationship with the environment. Our review synthesizes empirical findings on intuition's neurobiological basis, including relevant brain networks and their relationship to cognitive states like insight. We propose that unsolved problems dynamically alter attractor landscapes, guiding future intuitions. We investigate "opportunistic assimilation" through nonlinear neurodynamics and identify hippocampal sharp wave ripples as potential neural correlates of intuition, citing their role in creativity, choice, action planning, and abstract thinking. Finally, we explore intuition through two complementary perspectives: the free energy principle, which models brains as minimizing uncertainty through predictive hierarchical coding, and metastable coordination dynamics, describing the brain's simultaneous tendencies toward regional cooperation and functional autonomy. Together, these principles provide a comprehensive neurodynamical account of intuition's neurophenomenology.
authors: Kotler S, Mannino M, Friston K, Buzsáki G, Kelso JAS, Dumas G.
title_zh: 直觉的神经动力学探讨
summary_zh: 本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，明确了直觉作为一种基于经验的过程，倾向于产生直觉或假设。我们将直觉视为一种路径寻找机制，源于大脑对环境关系的优化，建立了更坚实的神经生物学基础。综述了直觉的神经生物学基础的实证研究，包括相关脑网络及其与洞察等认知状态的关系。我们提出未解决的问题动态改变吸引子景观，引导未来的直觉。通过非线性神经动力学研究“机会同化”，并识别海马体尖波涟漪作为直觉的潜在神经相关物，强调其在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的作用。最后，从自由能原理和亚稳态协调动力学两个互补视角探讨直觉，提供了直觉神经现象学的全面神经动力学解释。
l1_lead: 本文揭示了直觉的神经生物学基础，强调其作为基于经验的路径寻找机制，并探讨了相关脑网络及其在创造力和决策中的作用。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了直觉的神经生物学，明确了直觉作为一种基于经验的过程，倾向于产生直觉或假设。我们将直觉视为一种路径寻找机制，源于大脑对环境关系的优化，建立了更坚实的神经生物学基础。通过对直觉的神经生物学基础进行实证研究，本文综述了相关脑网络及其与洞察（insight）等认知状态的关系，揭示了直觉在认知过程中的重要性。

在研究中，我们提出了一些未解决的问题，这些问题动态改变了吸引子景观（attractor landscape），并引导未来的直觉发展。通过非线性神经动力学的视角，我们研究了“机会同化”（opportunity assimilation），并识别出海马体尖波涟漪（hippocampal sharp-wave ripples）作为直觉的潜在神经相关物。这一发现强调了海马体在创造力、选择、行动规划和抽象思维中的重要作用。

最后，本文从自由能原理（free energy principle）和亚稳态协调动力学（metastable coordination dynamics）两个互补视角探讨了直觉，提供了对直觉神经现象学的全面神经动力学解释。这些研究不仅为理解直觉的神经机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的相关研究指明了方向。通过对直觉的深入探讨，我们希望能够更好地理解人类的认知过程及其在复杂环境中的适应能力。

title: Adaptive consolidation of active inference: excitatory and inhibitory mechanisms for organizing feedforward and feedback memory systems in sleep.
body: Cognitive self-organization rests on activity-dependent plasticity to extend the ontogenetic process of neural differentiation and integration of the cerebral cortex in each act of cognition. This account of neurocognitive growth can be formulated in terms of active inference and learning. The organism regulates synaptic connectivity as it seeks its goals actively, through excitatory, feedforward expectancies that manifest its species-specific affordances. These adaptive expectancies are modified reactively, through inhibitory feedback error-correction to fit and predict environmental encounters. Although adaptive behavior, and concomitant synaptic plasticity, occur during waking, the synaptic architecture requires ongoing consolidation and refinement during sleep. We propose that memory consolidation during sleep is a continuation of the neurodevelopmental process that proceeds through a kind of inversion of waking active inference: NREM sleep first refines the brain's representations of new, unpredicted experiences during waking, implementing inhibitory mechanisms of long-term depression that both differentiate and stabilize new representations for consolidation. REM sleep then updates the organism's generative world model in light of this new learning through excitatory long-term potentiation of synaptic plasticity. REM thereby reconsolidates and integrates the organism's adaptive, feedforward predictions, the Bayesian priors for effective coping.

title_zh: 主动推理的适应性巩固：睡眠中记忆系统的兴奋与抑制机制
summary_zh: 本文探讨了主动推理（active inference）在认知自我组织中的作用，强调神经可塑性在大脑皮层神经分化与整合过程中的重要性。作者提出，生物体在追求目标时，通过兴奋性前馈预期调节突触连接，并通过抑制性反馈错误修正来适应环境。尽管在清醒状态下会发生适应性行为和突触可塑性，但突触结构在睡眠中需要持续巩固和完善。文章认为，睡眠中的记忆巩固是神经发育过程的延续，NREM睡眠通过抑制性机制细化新经验的表征，而REM睡眠则通过兴奋性机制更新生物体的生成世界模型，从而实现记忆的再巩固与整合。
l1_lead: 睡眠中的记忆巩固依赖于兴奋与抑制机制的相互作用，促进神经可塑性和认知自我组织。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了主动推理（active inference）在认知自我组织中的作用，强调了神经可塑性在大脑皮层神经分化与整合过程中的重要性。作者指出，生物体在追求目标时，通过兴奋性前馈预期调节突触连接，并通过抑制性反馈错误修正来适应环境。这一过程在清醒状态下表现为适应性行为和突触可塑性，但突触结构在睡眠中同样需要持续的巩固和完善。

文章认为，睡眠中的记忆巩固是神经发育过程的延续，尤其是在非快速眼动睡眠（NREM）和快速眼动睡眠（REM）阶段中，分别发挥着不同的作用。在NREM睡眠阶段，抑制性机制起到细化新经验表征的作用，通过抑制不必要的神经活动，帮助大脑更有效地整合和巩固记忆。而在REM睡眠阶段，兴奋性机制则负责更新生物体的生成世界模型，使得记忆得以再巩固与整合。这种机制的相互作用不仅有助于记忆的保持，还促进了认知能力的提升。

综上所述，主动推理在认知自我组织中扮演着关键角色，神经可塑性在睡眠中的适应性巩固过程则为理解记忆形成和整合提供了新的视角。通过分析睡眠中不同阶段的兴奋与抑制机制，本文为未来研究提供了重要的理论基础，强调了睡眠在认知功能中的不可或缺性。

title_zh: 卡尔·弗里斯顿：意识、预测与自由意志的关系
summary_zh: 本文探讨了科学家卡尔·弗里斯顿关于个体行为与存在之间关系的观点。他提出，个体的行为可以被视为在为自身存在收集证据，这一论点强调了个体存在与其对世界的感知和解释之间的密切联系。弗里斯顿的观点揭示了意识、预测（prediction）、推理（inference）以及个体在生活中所扮演的角色（agency）之间的复杂关系，暗示着自由意志（free will）和智能（intelligence）在认知（cognition）过程中的重要性。这种循环性思维为理解人类意识的本质提供了新的视角。

卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）在其研究中探讨了个体行为与存在之间的关系，提出个体的行为可以被视为在为自身存在收集证据。这一观点强调了个体存在与其对世界的感知和解释之间的密切联系，揭示了意识、预测（prediction）、推理（inference）以及个体在生活中所扮演的角色（agency）之间的复杂关系。弗里斯顿的理论暗示，自由意志（free will）和智能（intelligence）在认知（cognition）过程中扮演着重要角色，形成了一种循环性思维模式。

通过这一框架，弗里斯顿为理解人类意识的本质提供了新的视角。他的研究表明，个体在面对环境时，不仅仅是被动反应，而是积极地进行预测和推理，以便更好地适应和生存。这种行为模式不仅涉及到对外部世界的理解，也与个体内在的意识状态密切相关。弗里斯顿的观点挑战了传统对自由意志的理解，强调了个体在认知过程中所拥有的主动性和选择权。

总的来说，弗里斯顿的理论为我们提供了一个新的框架，帮助我们更深入地理解意识的运作机制，以及个体如何在复杂的环境中进行有效的决策和行为。这种对意识、预测和自由意志之间关系的探讨，不仅丰富了我们对人类认知的理解，也为未来的研究指明了方向。

卡尔·弗里斯顿（Karl Friston）在其研究中探讨了意识与现实之间的推理关系，提出了一个颇具挑战性的观点：我们所感知的现实并非真实的现实，而是经过压缩和简化的推理结果。这一论点强调了我们的感知实际上是对外部世界的粗略解释，无法全面反映真实情况。弗里斯顿的理论揭示了意识、推理和感知之间的复杂关系，提示我们在认知过程中可能存在的局限性。

通过这一理论，弗里斯顿不仅揭示了人类认知的复杂性，还指出了在科学研究和日常生活中，我们的感知可能会受到多种因素的影响，从而导致对现实的误解。这种意识与现实之间的推理关系，促使我们反思在科学探索和人类理解中的基本假设，提醒我们在面对复杂现实时，需保持谦逊和开放的态度。

总之，弗里斯顿的研究为我们理解意识的本质提供了新的视角，强调了推理在感知过程中的重要性，并揭示了我们对现实理解的局限性。这一理论不仅在哲学和心理学领域引发了广泛的讨论，也为神经科学等相关学科提供了新的研究方向。

本文探讨了大脑作为构造性器官的观点，强调其在处理感官输入时的主动性，类似于一个统计引擎。核心论点是，大脑通过生成假设来解释感官信息，从而最小化惊讶（surprise）或预测误差（prediction error）。这一过程表明，大脑并不是被动地接收信息，而是积极地构建对现实的理解。研究表明，大脑在感知和认知过程中发挥着重要作用，尤其是在解释外部世界时展现出强大的预测能力。

通过这一机制，大脑能够有效地整合来自不同感官的信息，形成对环境的全面理解。具体而言，当大脑接收到感官输入时，它会根据以往的经验和知识生成多个假设，并通过比较这些假设与实际感官输入之间的差异来调整自身的理解。这种调整过程不仅提高了对现实的适应能力，还使得个体能够在复杂和动态的环境中做出快速反应。

此外，研究还指出，大脑的这种构造性机制在学习和记忆中起着关键作用。通过不断地更新和优化假设，大脑能够在面对新信息时迅速调整已有的认知框架，从而提高对新情况的适应能力。这一过程不仅涉及到感官信息的处理，还包括情感和社会认知等多方面的因素，进一步强调了大脑在复杂认知任务中的多功能性。

总之，本文揭示了大脑在感知和认知中的构造性机制，强调其在解释外部世界时的预测能力。这一观点不仅丰富了我们对大脑功能的理解，也为未来的研究提供了新的视角，可能会对认知科学、心理学以及人工智能等领域产生深远的影响。

l1_lead: 大脑通过调整思维和行动来最小化预测误差，从而更准确地理解和适应现实。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了科学家Karl Friston关于大脑如何通过最小化预测误差（prediction error）来理解现实的观点。研究指出，大脑在处理信息时，主要依赖于两种策略来减少预测误差。第一种策略是通过改变思维，使得大脑生成的预测更接近实际感知。这意味着，当我们的感知与预期不符时，大脑会调整其内部模型，以便更好地反映外部世界的真实状态。第二种策略则是通过行动来调整与环境的互动。通过主动参与和探索，个体能够获得更多的信息，从而修正其对现实的理解。

这一理论强调了思维和行动的变化都是有效的策略，能够帮助我们更准确地理解和适应周围的世界。通过不断地调整预测和实际感知之间的差距，大脑能够提高对现实的预测能力。这种机制不仅有助于我们在日常生活中做出更好的决策，也为理解人类行为和认知提供了重要的科学依据。

总的来说，Karl Friston的研究揭示了大脑在理解现实过程中的复杂性，强调了预测误差的最小化在认知和行为中的重要作用。这一发现为我们提供了新的视角，帮助我们理解大脑如何通过思维和行动的调整来适应不断变化的环境。

title: Digital episodic memory tools for the identification of amnestic mild cognitive impairment: A systematic review and an exploratory meta-analysis.
body: Within our ageing population, the prevalence of Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment (aMCI) is rising, underscoring a need for early detection strategies to mitigate potential progression to dementia. Traditional pen-and-paper cognitive tests remain standard but often fail to capture subtle early impairments. Digital episodic memory tasks have emerged as a promising alternative, offering automated scoring, increased accessibility, and potentially better sensitivity to cognitive decline. We systematically evaluated the diagnostic accuracy of digital episodic memory assessments for aMCI. Thirteen studies met inclusion criteria, with six (n = 510 participants) providing sufficient data for meta-analysis. Pooled estimates showed sensitivity of 0.78 (95% CI: 0.65-0.87), specificity of 0.79 (95% CI: 0.66-0.89), and AUC of 0.86, with low to moderate heterogeneity (I² = 36.1%), largely reflecting differences in task design and administration. Both quantitative and qualitative findings suggest digital episodic memory tasks can provide accessible, scalable, and effective tools for early aMCI detection. However, design variability and construct differences highlight the need for further validation across diverse populations and improved methodological standardisation before clinical implementation.
authors: Moura AR, Magalhães D, Dos Santos C, Marinho F, Henriques R, Wimmer GE, Dolan RJ, Fragata I.
title_zh: 数字化情节记忆工具在轻度认知障碍中的应用研究
summary_zh: 随着老龄化人口的增加，健忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）的发病率上升，亟需早期检测策略以减缓向痴呆的进展。传统的纸笔认知测试虽然仍为标准，但常常无法捕捉到早期的细微损害。数字化情节记忆任务作为一种有前景的替代方案，提供了自动评分、提高可及性及对认知衰退的更好敏感性。我们系统评估了数字化情节记忆评估在aMCI诊断中的准确性。共有13项研究符合纳入标准，其中6项（n = 510参与者）提供了足够的数据进行荟萃分析。汇总结果显示敏感性为0.78（95% CI: 0.65-0.87），特异性为0.79（95% CI: 0.66-0.89），AUC为0.86，异质性低至中等（I² = 36.1%），主要反映任务设计和实施的差异。定量和定性结果均表明，数字化情节记忆任务可以作为早期aMCI检测的可及、可扩展且有效的工具。然而，设计变异性和构念差异强调了在临床应用前需在不同人群中进一步验证和改进方法标准化的必要性。
l1_lead: 数字化情节记忆工具在轻度认知障碍的早期检测中表现出良好的敏感性和特异性，成为一种可行的替代方案，但需进一步验证和标准化。
l2_summary:
随着全球老龄化人口的增加，健忘型轻度认知障碍（aMCI）的发病率逐渐上升，这使得早期检测策略的需求愈加迫切，以期减缓其向痴呆的进展。传统的纸笔认知测试虽然仍然是标准方法，但往往无法有效捕捉到早期的细微认知损害。因此，数字化情节记忆任务作为一种新兴的评估工具，展现出良好的前景。该工具不仅提供了自动评分的便利性，还提高了可及性，并对认知衰退表现出更高的敏感性。

本研究系统评估了数字化情节记忆评估在aMCI诊断中的准确性，共纳入了13项符合标准的研究，其中6项（n = 510参与者）提供了足够的数据进行荟萃分析。汇总结果显示，数字化情节记忆任务的敏感性为0.78（95% CI: 0.65-0.87），特异性为0.79（95% CI: 0.66-0.89），而曲线下面积（AUC）为0.86，表明该工具在识别aMCI方面具有良好的诊断能力。研究还发现，异质性低至中等（I² = 36.1%），主要反映了任务设计和实施上的差异。

定量和定性结果均表明，数字化情节记忆任务可以作为一种可及、可扩展且有效的早期aMCI检测工具。然而，研究中也指出设计变异性和构念差异，强调在临床应用之前，需要在不同人群中进一步验证和改进方法的标准化。这一发现为未来的研究和临床实践提供了重要的参考，提示我们在推广数字化评估工具时，需关注其适用性和可靠性。

title: The prenatal sex steroid theory of autism after 25 years.
body: We first proposed the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism 25 years ago to account for a number of then-unexplained observations around autism, including (1) the more frequent diagnosis of autism in male than in female individuals and (2) apparent 'male-type' shifts in cognitive traits associated with autism, such as empathizing and systemizing. Here we review 25 years of research testing this theory. Early studies found that higher prenatal testosterone levels were associated with slower social, language and empathy development, greater attention to detail, stronger systemizing and more autistic traits. Subsequent studies suggested that both prenatal androgens and oestrogens are associated with autism. New methods in genetics and using stem-cell-derived neural organoids have further indicated the importance of sex steroid hormones for neurodevelopment, as well as atypical patterns in autism. These new findings support and open new lines of research into the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism.
authors: Baron-Cohen S, Tsompanidis A, Srivastava DP, Mill J, Lancaster MA, Adhya D, APEX consortium, Warrier V.

title_zh: 产前性激素理论与自闭症的25年回顾
summary_zh: 本文回顾了产前性激素理论在自闭症研究中的发展历程。该理论最初提出于25年前，旨在解释自闭症的一些未解现象，包括男性自闭症患者的比例高于女性，以及自闭症相关的认知特征表现出明显的“男性化”倾向，如共情（empathizing）和系统化（systemizing）。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮（testosterone）水平与社交、语言和共情发展缓慢、对细节的关注度提高、系统化能力增强及更多自闭症特征相关。后续研究表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（oestrogens）均与自闭症相关。新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官研究进一步强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，以及自闭症中的非典型模式。这些新发现支持并为产前性激素理论的进一步研究开辟了新的方向。
l1_lead: 产前性激素理论在自闭症研究中逐渐得到验证，揭示了性激素在神经发育及自闭症特征表现中的关键作用，为未来研究提供了新方向。
l2_summary:
本文回顾了产前性激素理论在自闭症研究中的发展历程，起源于25年前，旨在解释自闭症的一些未解现象，特别是男性自闭症患者的比例显著高于女性，以及自闭症相关的认知特征表现出明显的“男性化”倾向，如共情（empathizing）能力较弱和系统化（systemizing）能力较强。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮（testosterone）水平与社交、语言和共情发展缓慢、对细节的关注度提高、系统化能力增强及更多自闭症特征相关。这一发现为理解自闭症的性别差异提供了生物学基础。

随着研究的深入，后续研究表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（oestrogens）均与自闭症的发生相关，进一步揭示了性激素在自闭症发病机制中的复杂作用。新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官研究强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，揭示了自闭症中存在的非典型发育模式。这些新发现不仅支持了产前性激素理论的基本假设，还为未来的研究开辟了新的方向，提示我们在探讨自闭症的成因时，需更加重视性激素的影响。

综上所述，产前性激素理论为理解自闭症的生物学基础提供了重要视角，尤其是在解释性别差异和认知特征方面。随着研究技术的进步，未来有望通过更深入的研究揭示性激素在自闭症发病机制中的具体作用，从而为自闭症的早期干预和治疗提供新的思路。

title: The Placental Steroid Hypothesis of Human Brain Evolution.
body: The evolution of the human brain has long been framed in terms of sexual selection, with an emphasis on consistent but small on-average volumetric differences between males and females. In this review, we present new molecular, genetic and clinical findings regarding neurodevelopment, cortical expansion and the production of sex steroid hormones, such as testosterone and oestradiol, by the placenta during pregnancy. We discuss converging evidence that on-average sex differences are relevant for human evolution but are characterised by significant overlap between the sexes and more adaptations in female, rather than male, physiology. We also consider recent accounts and modelling of evolutionary pressures in large social groups, regarding competition and fertility. Finally, we bring these findings together and present a novel hypothesis for understanding human brain development and evolution, which emphasises the role of sex steroid hormones, their prenatal production by the placenta and their roles in regulating physiology, fertility and cognition.
authors: Tsompanidis A, Burton GJ, Baron-Cohen S, Dunbar RIM.

title_zh: 人脑进化的胎盘类固醇假说
summary_zh: 人脑的进化长期以来被视为性选择的结果，强调男性与女性之间的体积差异。本文综述了关于神经发育、皮层扩展及胎盘在妊娠期间产生性类固醇激素（如睾酮和雌二醇）的新分子、遗传和临床发现。我们讨论了性别差异在人体进化中的重要性，指出尽管存在显著的性别重叠，但女性生理的适应性变化更多。文章还考虑了在大型社会群体中关于竞争和生育的进化压力的最新研究和模型。最后，我们提出了一种新假说，强调性类固醇激素及其在胎盘中的产生产生对生理、生育和认知调节的重要作用，从而帮助理解人脑的发展与进化。
l1_lead: 本文提出胎盘类固醇激素在妊娠期间对人脑进化的重要作用，强调性别差异及其对生理和认知调节的影响。
l2_summary:
人脑的进化历来被认为是性选择的结果，尤其强调了男性与女性之间的体积差异。然而，近期的研究提出了一种新的视角，即胎盘类固醇假说，探讨了胎盘在妊娠期间产生的性类固醇激素（如睾酮和雌二醇）对人脑发育的影响。本文综述了神经发育、皮层扩展及胎盘激素的最新分子、遗传和临床发现，强调了性别差异在人体进化中的重要性。尽管男性和女性之间存在显著的生理重叠，研究表明女性的生理适应性变化更为显著，这可能与其在生育和社会角色中的多样性有关。

此外，文章还探讨了在大型社会群体中，竞争与生育所带来的进化压力，结合最新的研究和模型，进一步揭示了性类固醇激素在这一过程中所扮演的关键角色。通过分析胎盘中性类固醇激素的产生，研究指出这些激素不仅影响生理和生育，还在认知调节中发挥重要作用。这一假说为理解人脑的发展与进化提供了新的思路，强调了胎盘类固醇激素在整个进化过程中不可忽视的影响力。总之，胎盘类固醇假说为人脑进化的研究提供了新的视角，提示我们在探讨人类生理和认知发展的过程中，需更加关注性类固醇激素的作用及其复杂的生物学机制。

title: Jason Arday death 'tragedy on so many levels' says PM - BBC
body:
原话：“He was an incredibly, kind and gentle and caring man.”
论点：Jason Arday是一个非常善良和温柔的人。
attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（BBC） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: He was an incredibly, kind and gentle and caring man.
topic_zh: 对Jason Arday的评价
claim_zh: Jason Arday是一个非常善良和温柔的人。
article_body:
Share Save Add as preferred on Google Ruth Comerford Death of Jason Arday 'a tragedy on so many levels', says PM Andy Burnham has described the death of former Cambridge professor Jason Arday as "a tragedy on so many levels", as he called for a "moment for reflection".
Arday was found dead at an address in Battersea, south London, on Friday afternoon.
"It's not a moment for any rushing to judgement. It's a moment for reflection, I would say, reflecting on how things came to this," the prime minister told broadcasters during a visit to Cornwall.
In a statement issued by his publisher Simon & Schuster UK, Arday's family said they were "in shock to have lost this amazing father, partner, brother, uncle and son".
They said a "campaign of misinformation" had been too much for him.
Arday, 41, resigned as a Cambridge professor of sociology of education last week after allegations of plagiarism and questions about some of his achievements. He had denied the claims.
A friend told the BBC Arday had described feeling "destroyed" and had told him his authorisation to travel to the US had been revoked.
Eamonn McCrystal, who became his friend at St Mary's University, Twickenham, tried to reassure him what he was going through would pass, but Arday replied "it does not feel like it will."
McCrystal told the BBC "He was the nicest person. So kind and such a gentle soul.
"We shared an office at university, when I set up the student radio station, and he used to speak on the station a lot."
The University of Cambridge vice-chancellor Prof Deborah Prentice led the tributes, saying the faculty was "desperately saddened" to learn of his death.
"Our heartfelt sympathies go to Jason Arday's family and friends at this incredibly difficult time," she added.
Education Secretary Lucy Powell said she was "deeply shocked and saddened" and urged people to "remember there are real people with loved ones involved".
Mayor of London Sir Sadiq Khan said Arday was subjected to unrelenting media scrutiny.
He said he had faced "an unacceptable public hounding and campaign of abuse" and was the victim of "a pernicious public shaming".
"His death was a tragedy, but once again it should be a wake up call for all of us," he posted on X.
A donation page, set up by Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon, has raised more than £10,000 to help cover funeral costs for Arday's family.
"Today should be about compassion, dignity and solidarity with a grieving family," Vernon wrote.
"Jason's life was bigger than the controversy that surrounded his final weeks."
A vigil will be held on Monday evening on the steps of the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square, held by the organisation Stand Up To Racism.
The group's co-convenor, Weyman Bennett, said Arday's death "was the result of a racist witch hunt".
Jo Grady, general secretary of the University and College Union, said the "level of harassment he suffered and the racism he was subjected to has been sickening" and "must be investigated".
Lord Paul Boateng, who became the UK's first black cabinet minister in 2002, told BBC Newsnight he was "horrified, shocked and deeply saddened".
"Racism in academia is a fact of life and needs to be addressed," he added in a written statement.
In a statement on Saturday, National Education Union general secretary Daniel Kebede said Arday had been subjected to "a public and brutal takedown that unleashed a tirade of racism".
"The effect has been chilling. It tells black people and others from underrepresented backgrounds that entering prominent public positions will make you a target," he said.
Prof Simon Baron-Cohen, director of the Autism Research Centre at the University of Cambridge, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme Arday had been "bombarded by every media outlet to paint him as a fraud".
"He was an incredibly, kind and gentle and caring man," he said.
He spoke to Arday the morning of his death, and said the academic had felt unable to leave the house.
"He has experienced what he described as a campaign against him, for the last three years," he previously told BBC News.
"What he was saying to me was 'they've destroyed my life' - it's not clear who they were but I think he was referring to the media.
"The personal attacks on him have been so immense."
Former colleague of Arday says they spoke on morning of his death Speaking to BBC Newsnight, Professor of Black Studies Kehinde Andrews, a friend of Arday, described him as "very down" after resigning from Cambridge.
"He was very upset. He felt that there was no way out. He effectively wasn't leaving the house. He had lost a lot of weight," Andrews said.
"There should be a wakeup call to just how bad black academics actually have it in academia."
Labour MP Bell Ribeiro-Addy also told the programme "the idea that an academic would be dragged through this amount of media scrutiny is unheard of".
On Saturday Scotland's First Minister John Swinney said that people who "made many hard comments must now consider the impact of their words", describing it as a "deeply concerning and very sad case".
Prior to his appointment at Cambridge, Arday had worked as a professor at the University of Glasgow.
Shadow communities secretary Sir James Cleverly said he was angered by the "tragic" death and said "a number of people at a number of academic institutions have serious questions to answer".
When asked by the BBC on Saturday if the University of Cambridge needed to answer questions over its duty of care, Cleverly said the university should "ask themselves how he got into this position, how he ended up being in the eye of the storm, what could and should have happened to prevent this long before it got to this tragic situation".
Arday had denied plagiarism - but admitted errors in his work - and said the recent controversy had led to "an unrelenting level of public scrutiny and personal attack".
The row first erupted after another academic - self-defined "race realist" Nathan Cofnas, who was sacked from his Cambridge role in 2024 - said he found numerous instances of plagiarism in the professor's work.
Arday said some errors in his early academic work arose because of his autism, as he relied on using mimicry to make sense of information. Similar scrutiny would find similar errors in work by other academics, he said.
Questions were also raised about parts of his life story, including that he ran 600 miles in six days and that he had raised £5.5m for charity.
He later said the run was actually completed over a 12-day period to allow for rest days - and that the huge sum was raised with the help of others.
Arday's appointment as Cambridge's youngest ever black professor at the age of 37 in 2023 was hailed at the time.
Announcing his resignation last week, Arday said the "personal cost" of the scrutiny of him had become "too great".
He said: "While criticism is an inevitable part of academic life, what I have experienced has gone far beyond scholarly disagreement.
"The relentless accusations, speculation and public commentary have taken a profound toll on me and on those I love."
He stressed that his resignation should not "be mistaken for an acceptance of the narratives that have surrounded me".
Earlier this week, Cambridge announced an independent investigation around the circumstances of Arday's appointment.
Liverpool John Moores University - which awarded Arday his PhD in 2015 - concluded that he had not plagiarised work.
In a statement on Saturday, a spokesperson for the university said it was "saddened to hear of the tragic loss of Professor Jason Arday".

title_zh: 杰森·阿尔代去世引发多重悲剧感慨
summary_zh: 杰森·阿尔代（Jason Arday）被描述为一个非常善良和温柔的人。英国首相在谈及他的去世时表示，这一事件在多个层面上都是一场悲剧。阿尔代的离世不仅让身边的人感到失落，也引发了对他所代表的价值观和人际关系的深思。他的善良品质和温柔性格使他在社会中留下了深刻的印记，令人惋惜。
l1_lead: 杰森·阿尔代的去世引发了对人际关系和社会价值观的深刻反思，令人感到多重悲剧的惋惜。
l2_summary: 杰森·阿尔代的去世引发了深刻的悲剧感慨，令人们对他所代表的价值观和人际关系进行了反思。阿尔代被描述为一个非常善良和温柔的人，这种品质使他在社会中留下了深刻的印记。他的离世不仅让身边的人感到失落，也让人们意识到善良和温柔在当今社会中的重要性。英国首相在谈及阿尔代的去世时指出，这一事件在多个层面上都是一场悲剧，反映了人际关系的脆弱和对美好品质的珍视。阿尔代的生活和价值观激励了许多人，他的离去让人们更加珍惜与他人之间的联系和情感。总的来说，阿尔代的去世不仅是个人的损失，更是社会对善良与温柔的深刻思考，提醒我们在日常生活中应更加关注和弘扬这些美德。

The University of Cambridge ought to proceed with its probe into how Professor Jason Arday was recruited and his period teaching at the institution, according to a friend and former colleague.
Prof Arday, who was found dead on Friday, stepped down from his post as professor of sociology of education last week following allegations of plagiarism made against him.
Prior to his death, the university stated that it would look into the circumstances surrounding his "appointment and tenure", with the conclusions feeding into a wider review of senior recruitment processes.
It is understood that the university currently feels it would not be right to decide whether to continue the inquiry while Prof Arday’s family is grieving.
Sir Simon Baron-Cohen, a friend and former colleague of Prof Arday, told Times Radio that the university should "always be reflecting on how it’s operating and whether it can do better".
The Cambridge professor and director of the Autism Research Centre said: “They have announced an investigation, and we should let that proceed.
“We should we should see what we learn from it. This is the whole purpose of investigations.
“When you’re talking about what’s in the public interest, when you’ve got public bodies like universities or, arguably, the media, political institutions, whatever, when we have investigations, it’s all about how can we improve them.”
Sir Simon said the professor’s mental health had been left “in tatters”, adding there were questions about whether the media failed in its duty of care towards him as a vulnerable person with disabilities.
He said the professor faced racist abuse and was used as a “lightning rod for a culture war on DEI (diversity, equity and inclusion)”.
“(Prof Arday) started reporting racism within weeks of him being at Cambridge,” Sir Simon said.
“It included things like threats of physical assault to himself and his family, racist hate speech, and racist actions, hate actions.”
Lord Simon Woolley, principal of Homerton College, Cambridge, and a former mentor of Prof Arday, told BBC Radio 4’s Broadcasting House programme that his friend felt “hounded to death”.
Lord Woolley said: “In a conversation I had with Jason on the Monday – we met on Monday, with a few dear friends – he said he felt hounded to death, his words, that he couldn’t see a way out.”
He added: “On that day, we saw a man half his body weight and desperate beyond belief.”
The crossbench peer said Prof Arday had been subjected to “the most horrendous, toxic, vicious witch hunt”, and called for an investigation into the “vicious media onslaught”.
“The whole of the black community and black academics have been brought into this debate as though we don’t belong in these positions, because we are collectively the diversity, equity and inclusion hires,” Lord Woolley added.
A fundraiser for Prof Arday’s family, set up by Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon, has raised more than £60,000.
The organisation Stand Up To Racism has announced plans for a vigil for Prof Arday to be held on the steps of the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square, central London, at 6pm on Monday.
On Saturday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham described the professor’s death as a “tragedy on so many levels”, adding: “It’s not a moment for any rushing to judgment. It’s a moment for reflection, I would say, reflecting on how things came to this.”
In a statement issued by his publisher Simon & Schuster UK on Friday, Prof Arday’s family said he had been subjected to a “campaign of sustained abuse” since he accepted the role of professor at Cambridge.
They said: “The campaign of misinformation was too much for Jason, who was a gentle man and who always wanted to see the best in everyone.”

topic_zh: 对Jason Arday的同情与理解
claim_zh: Jason Arday在面对媒体的持续压力和职业生涯的丧失时，感到无法承受，缺乏必要的支持。
evidence_zh: 他被持续的审视和嘲笑所困扰，失去了职业和声誉。
article_body:
Coffee House Melanie McDonagh The tragedy of Jason Arday Saturday, August 15, 2026, 10:30 AM Jason Arday (Credit: BBC) Text settings Text size Small Medium Large Line Spacing Compact Normal Spacious Comments Share Share Melanie McDonagh
Copied Linkedin Messenger Email Simon Baron-Cohen, the distinguished Cambridge autism specialist, has been speaking movingly about his friend, Jason Arday, in a BBC radio interview. Baron-Cohen said the last contact he had with Arday was hours before he was found dead at an address in south London yesterday afternoon: “He really wasn’t coping. He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny… ridicule, discrediting every detail of his life… He wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation. He felt he couldn’t go on.”
Jason Arday was a victim, but not in the way that his political champions suggest
Baron-Cohen went on to talk about him as “an incredibly kind and gentle and caring and generous man”. From his own perspective, he observed, “at the heart of all this was a man who was diagnosed with autism and language differences…he needed support every step of the way… after the allegations of plagiarism, [the] media didn’t leave him alone.”
It is good to be reminded of Jason Arday as a friend, by a friend. For in death we all should be remembered in our humanity, even in our flawed humanity. And Jason Arday was very human; he bled. He was not just a totem of DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion), but as the Prof said, a vulnerable man. It’s sometimes hard for pundits, self included, to remember how terrifying it is to be at the heart of a media firestorm. Jason Arday isn’t the first to feel the pressure to be unbearable. We may not feel exactly guilt at participating in the row, but it would be strange if we didn’t feel sober, chastened, by his tragic end.
De mortuis nil nisi bonum is a good motto, but in Arday’s case, the difficulty about speaking no evil of the dead is in disentangling the man, the human being, from the issue. And the issue was quite legitimate: the apparent dearth of scrutiny of his successive appointments, the uncritical and unquestioned acceptance of his work and his claims as, for instance, a fundraiser. His family, in their pain, has talked about him as the victim of misinformation. This isn’t, I would say, the whole case, though this isn’t the time to rehearse the details.
Before his death becomes weaponized – as it already risks being – in the culture wars, we should make one thing clear, as I, in fact, did before he died. It is that the problem was not Jason Arday; it was with the individuals who lionized him, who promoted him beyond his capacities, who raised him up prematurely to stellar heights at an age which would have been remarkable for anyone, regardless of ethnicity. It is the individuals behind the system which created Jason Arday, the poster image of DEI, who should be asking themselves some questions.
Arday can hardly be blamed for not resisting this inexorable trajectory. And, I would say, the fault is with Cambridge for making a dud subject like Education a faculty on the same level as history or natural sciences or classics. Jason Arday was a victim, but not quite in the way that his political champions suggest.
He was also a man, a father, a son, a brother and an uncle, as his family have said, and it is as such he is being mourned. Requiescat in pace.
Melanie McDonagh is an Irish journalist working in London.
